उवाच प्रियमित्येवं गृह्णीयाः सिंहवाहिनीम् ॥ 4 ॥

1.6.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasannīlalohitaḥ ..
uvāca bhītaḥ praṇataḥ prāṇeśaṃ prabhumacyutam .. 5 ..
1.6.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहसन्नीललोहितः ॥
उवाच भीतः प्रणतः प्राणेशं प्रभुमच्युतम् ॥ 5 ॥

1.6.s:
śrīmaheśvara uvāca ..
adhunāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prakṛtiṃ prākṛto yathā ..
tvadbhaktyaikavyavahitāṃ dāsyamārgavirodhinīm .. 6 ..
1.6.d:
श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ॥
अधुनाहं न गृह्णामि प्रकृतिं प्राकृतो यथा ॥
त्वद्भक्त्यैकव्यवहितां दास्यमार्गविरोधिनीम् ॥ 6 ॥

1.6.s:
tattvajñānasamācchannāṃ yogadvārakapāṭikām ..
muktīcchādhvaṃsarūpāṃ ca sakāmāṃ kāmavarddhinīm .. 7 ..
1.6.d:
तत्त्वज्ञानसमाच्छन्नां योगद्वारकपाटिकाम् ॥
मुक्तीच्छाध्वंसरूपां च सकामां कामवर्द्धिनीम् ॥ 7 ॥

1.6.s:
tapasyācchannarūpāṃ ca mahāmohakaraṇḍikām ..
bhavakārāgṛhe ghore dṛḍhāṃ nigaḍarūpiṇīm .. .. 8 ..
1.6.d:
तपस्याच्छन्नरूपां च महामोहकरण्डिकाम् ॥
भवकारागृहे घोरे दृढां निगडरूपिणीम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥

1.6.s:
śaśvadvibuddhijananīṃ sadbuddhicchedakāriṇīm ..
śaśvadvibhogasārāṃ ca viṣayecchāvivarddhinīm .. 9..
1.6.d:
शश्वद्विबुद्धिजननीं सद्बुद्धिच्छेदकारिणीम् ॥
शश्वद्विभोगसारां च विषयेच्छाविवर्द्धिनीम् ॥ 9॥

1.6.s:
necchāmi gṛhiṇīṃ nātha varaṃ dehi madīpsitam ..
yasya yadvāñchitaṃ tasmai taddadāti sadīśvaraḥ .. 1.6.10 ..
1.6.d:
नेच्छामि गृहिणीं नाथ वरं देहि मदीप्सितम् ॥
यस्य यद्वाञ्छितं तस्मै तद्ददाति सदीश्वरः ॥ 1.6.10 ॥

1.6.s:
tvadbhaktiviṣaye dāsye lālasā varddhate'niśam ..
tṛptirna jāyate nāma japane pādasevane ..11..
1.6.d:
त्वद्भक्तिविषये दास्ये लालसा वर्द्धतेऽनिशम् ॥
तृप्तिर्न जायते नाम जपने पादसेवने ॥11॥

1.6.s:
tvannāmapañcavaktreṇa guṇaṃ sanmaṅgalālayam ..
svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvadgāyangāyan bhramāmyaham..12..
1.6.d:
त्वन्नामपञ्चवक्त्रेण गुणं सन्मङ्गलालयम् ॥
स्वप्ने जागरणे शश्वद्गायन्गायन् भ्रमाम्यहम्॥12॥

1.6.s:
ākalpakoṭikoṭiṃ ca tadrūpadhyānatatparam ..
bhogecchāviṣayenaiva yoge tapasi manmanaḥ .. 13 ..
1.6.d:
आकल्पकोटिकोटिं च तद्रूपध्यानतत्परम् ॥
भोगेच्छाविषयेनैव योगे तपसि मन्मनः ॥ 13 ॥

1.6.s:
tvatsevane pūjane ca vandane nāma kīrtane ..
sadollasitameṣāṃ ca viratau viratiṃ labhet .. 14 ..
1.6.d:
त्वत्सेवने पूजने च वन्दने नाम कीर्तने ॥
सदोल्लसितमेषां च विरतौ विरतिं लभेत् ॥ 14 ॥

1.6.s:
smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ nāma guṇayoḥ śravaṇaṃ japaḥ ..
tvaccārurūpadhyānaṃ tvatpādasevābhivandanam .. 15 ..
1.6.d:
स्मरणं कीर्त्तनं नाम गुणयोः श्रवणं जपः ॥
त्वच्चारुरूपध्यानं त्वत्पादसेवाभिवन्दनम् ॥ 15 ॥

1.6.s:
samarpaṇaṃ cātmanaśca nityaṃ naivedyabhojanam ..
varaṃ vareśa dehīdaṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam .. 16 ..
1.6.d:
समर्पणं चात्मनश्च नित्यं नैवेद्यभोजनम् ॥
वरं वरेश देहीदं नवधा भक्तिलक्षणम् ॥ 16 ॥

1.6.s:
sārṣṭisālokyasārūpyasāmīpyaṃ sāmyalīnatām ..
vadanti ṣaḍvidhāṃ muktiṃ muktāmuktivido vibho .. 17 ..
1.6.d:
सार्ष्टिसालोक्यसारूप्यसामीप्यं साम्यलीनताम् ॥
वदन्ति षड्विधां मुक्तिं मुक्तामुक्तिविदो विभो ॥ 17 ॥

1.6.s:
aṇimālaghimāprāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā ..
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sarvakāmāvasāyitā .. 18 ..
1.6.d:
अणिमालघिमाप्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ॥
ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च सर्वकामावसायिता ॥ 18 ॥

1.6.s:
sarvajña dūraśravaṇaṃ parakāyapraveśanam ..
vāksiddhiḥ kalpavṛkṣatvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumīśatā .. 19 ..
1.6.d:
सर्वज्ञ दूरश्रवणं परकायप्रवेशनम् ॥
वाक्सिद्धिः कल्पवृक्षत्वं स्रष्टुं संहर्तुमीशता ॥ 19 ॥

1.6.s:
amaratvaṃ ca sarvāgryaṃ siddhayo'ṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ..
yogāstapāṃsi sarvāṇi dānāni ca vratāni ca .. .. 1.6.20 ..
1.6.d:
अमरत्वं च सर्वाग्र्यं सिद्धयोऽष्टादश स्मृताः ॥
योगास्तपांसि सर्वाणि दानानि च व्रतानि च ॥ ॥ 1.6.20 ॥

1.6.s:
yaśaḥkīrtirvacaḥ satyaṃ dharmāṇyanaśanāni ca ..
bhramaṇaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānamanyasurārcanam .. 21 ..
1.6.d:
यशःकीर्तिर्वचः सत्यं धर्माण्यनशनानि च ॥
भ्रमणं सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नानमन्यसुरार्चनम् ॥ 21 ॥

1.6.s:
surārcā darśanaṃ saptadvīpasaptapradakṣiṇam ..
snānaṃ sarvasamudreṣu sarvasvargapradarśanam .. 22 ..
1.6.d:
सुरार्चा दर्शनं सप्तद्वीपसप्तप्रदक्षिणम् ॥
स्नानं सर्वसमुद्रेषु सर्वस्वर्गप्रदर्शनम् ॥ 22 ॥

1.6.s:
brahmatvaṃ caiva rudratvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca paraṃ padam ..
ato'nirvacanīyāni vāñchanīyāni santi vā .. 23 ..
1.6.d:
ब्रह्मत्वं चैव रुद्रत्वं विष्णुत्वं च परं पदम् ॥
अतोऽनिर्वचनीयानि वाञ्छनीयानि सन्ति वा ॥ 23 ॥

1.6.s:
sarvāṇyetāni sarveśa kathitāni ca yāni ca ..
tava bhaktikalāṃśasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 24 ..
1.6.d:
सर्वाण्येतानि सर्वेश कथितानि च यानि च ॥
तव भक्तिकलांशस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥ 24 ॥

1.6.s:
śarvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇastaṃ yogināṃ gurum ..
prahasyovāca vacanaṃ satyaṃ sarvasukhapradam .. 25 ..
1.6.d:
शर्वस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णस्तं योगिनां गुरुम् ॥
प्रहस्योवाच वचनं सत्यं सर्वसुखप्रदम् ॥ 25 ॥

1.6.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca ..
matsevāṃ kuru sarveśa śarvasarvavidāṃvara ..
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvatpūrṇaṃ śaśvadaharniśam .. 26 ..
1.6.d:
॥ श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
मत्सेवां कुरु सर्वेश शर्वसर्वविदांवर ॥
कल्पकोटिशतं यावत्पूर्णं शश्वदहर्निशम् ॥ 26 ॥

1.6.s:
varastapasvināṃ tvaṃ ca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā ..
jñānināṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sureśvara ..27..
1.6.d:
वरस्तपस्विनां त्वं च सिद्धानां योगिनां तथा ॥
ज्ञानिनां वैष्णवानां च सुराणां च सुरेश्वर ॥27॥

1.6.s:
amaratvaṃ labha bhava bhava mṛtyuṃjayo mahān ..
sarvasiddhiṃ ca vedāṃśca sarvajñatvaṃ ca madvarāt ..28..
1.6.d:
अमरत्वं लभ भव भव मृत्युंजयो महान् ॥
सर्वसिद्धिं च वेदांश्च सर्वज्ञत्वं च मद्वरात् ॥28॥

1.6.s:
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ līlayā vatsa paśyasi ..
adyaprabhṛti jñānena tejasā vayasā śiva .. 29 ..
1.6.d:
असंख्यब्रह्मणां पातं लीलया वत्स पश्यसि ॥
अद्यप्रभृति ज्ञानेन तेजसा वयसा शिव ॥ 29 ॥

1.6.s:
parā krameṇa yaśasā mahasā matsamo bhava..
prāṇānāmapadhikastvañca na bhaktastvatparo mama ..1.6.30..
1.6.d:
परा क्रमेण यशसा महसा मत्समो भव॥
प्राणानामपधिकस्त्वञ्च न भक्तस्त्वत्परो मम ॥1.6.30॥

1.6.s:
tvatparo nāsti me preyāṃstvaṃ madīyātmanaḥ paraḥ..
ye tvāṃ nindanti pāpiṣṭhā jñānahīnā vicetanāḥ .. 31 ..
1.6.d:
त्वत्परो नास्ति मे प्रेयांस्त्वं मदीयात्मनः परः॥
ये त्वां निन्दन्ति पापिष्ठा ज्ञानहीना विचेतनाः ॥ 31 ॥

1.6.s:
pacyante kālasūtreṇa yāvaccandradivākarau ..
kalpakoṭiśatānte ca grahīṣyasi śivāṃ śiva .. 32 ..
1.6.d:
पच्यन्ते कालसूत्रेण यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ॥
कल्पकोटिशतान्ते च ग्रहीष्यसि शिवां शिव ॥ 32 ॥

1.6.s:
mamāvyarthaṃ ca vacanaṃ pālanaṃ kartumarhasi ..
tvanmukhānnirgataṃ vākyaṃ na karomyadhuneti ca .. 33 ..
1.6.d:
ममाव्यर्थं च वचनं पालनं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
त्वन्मुखान्निर्गतं वाक्यं न करोम्यधुनेति च ॥ 33 ॥

1.6.s:
madvākyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ ca pālanaṃ tatkariṣyasi ..
gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śambho divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam .. 34 ..
1.6.d:
मद्वाक्यं च स्ववाक्यं च पालनं तत्करिष्यसि ॥
गृहीत्वा प्रकृतिं शम्भो दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥ 34 ॥

1.6.s:
sukhaṃ mahacca śṛṅgāraṃ kariṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ..
na kevalaṃ tapasvī tvamīśvaro matsamo mahān .. 35 ..
1.6.d:
सुखं महच्च शृङ्गारं करिष्यसि न संशयः ॥
न केवलं तपस्वी त्वमीश्वरो मत्समो महान् ॥ 35 ॥
1.6.m: You are not merely an ascetic; you are the great Lord, equal to Me.

1.6.s:
kāle gṛhī tapasvī ca yogī svecchāmayo hi yaḥ ..
duḥkhaṃ ca dārasaṃyoge yattvayā kathitaṃ śiva .. 36 ..
1.6.d:
काले गृही तपस्वी च योगी स्वेच्छामयो हि यः ॥
दुःखं च दारसंयोगे यत्त्वया कथितं शिव ॥ 36 ॥
1.6.m:
At the proper time, he who is self-willed is a householder, an ascetic, and a yogin.
And regarding the sorrow in union with a wife of which you spoke, O Śiva:

1.6.s:
kustrī dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca svāmine na pativratā ..
kule mahati yā jātā kulajā kulapālikā .. 37 ..
1.6.d:
कुस्त्री ददाति दुःखं च स्वामिने न पतिव्रता ॥
कुले महति या जाता कुलजा कुलपालिका ॥ 37 ॥
1.6.m:
a bad woman brings sorrow to her husband, not a devoted wife.
She who is born of a noble family, high-born and a protector of her lineage,

1.6.s:
karoti pālanaṃ snehātsatputrasya samaṃ patim ..
patirbandhuḥ patirbharttā daivataṃ kulayoṣitām .. 38 ..
1.6.d:
करोति पालनं स्नेहात्सत्पुत्रस्य समं पतिम् ॥
पतिर्बन्धुः पतिर्भर्त्ता दैवतं कुलयोषिताम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.6.m:
cherishes her husband with affection just as she would a virtuous son.
The husband is the kinsman, the husband is the sustainer, the deity of women of noble family,

1.6.s:
patito'patito vāpi kṛpaṇaśceśvaro'thavā ..
asatkulaprasūtāyāḥ pitrorduśśīlamiśritāḥ .. 39 ..
1.6.d:
पतितोऽपतितो वापि कृपणश्चेश्वरोऽथवा ॥
असत्कुलप्रसूतायाः पित्रोर्दुश्शीलमिश्रिताः ॥ 39 ॥
1.6.m:
whether he is fallen or unfallen, wretched or a lord.
Women born of a base family, partaking of the bad character of their parents,

1.6.s:
dhruvaṃ tāḥ parabhogyāśca patiṃ nindanti santatam..
āvayoratiriktaṃ ca yā paśyati patiṃ satī .. 1.6.40 ..
1.6.d:
ध्रुवं ताः परभोग्याश्च पतिं निन्दन्ति सन्ततम्॥
आवयोरतिरिक्तं च या पश्यति पतिं सती ॥ 1.6.40 ॥
1.6.m:
are surely to be enjoyed by others and constantly revile their husband.
A virtuous wife who sees her husband as identical to the two of us

1.6.s:
goloke svāminā sārddhaṃ koṭikalpaṃ pramodate ..
bhavitā sā śivā śaivī prakṛtivaiṣṇavī śiva .. 41 ..
1.6.d:
गोलोके स्वामिना सार्द्धं कोटिकल्पं प्रमोदते ॥
भविता सा शिवा शैवी प्रकृतिवैष्णवी शिव ॥ 41 ॥
1.6.m:
delights in Goloka together with her lord for a crore of kalpas.
That Prakṛti will be Śivā, devoted to Śiva, and a Vaiṣṇavī, O Śiva.

1.6.s:
madājñayā ca tāṃ sādhvīṃ grahīṣyasi bhavāya ca ..
prakṛtyā yonisaṃyuktaṃ tvalliṅgaṃ tīrthamṛtkṛtam ..42..
1.6.d:
मदाज्ञया च तां साध्वीं ग्रहीष्यसि भवाय च ॥
प्रकृत्या योनिसंयुक्तं त्वल्लिङ्गं तीर्थमृत्कृतम् ॥42॥
1.6.m:
And by My command, you will accept that virtuous woman for the welfare of the world.
Your liṅga joined with the yoni by Prakṛti, made from the clay of a sacred ford—

1.6.s:
tīrthe sahasraṃ saṃpūjya bhaktyā pañcopacārataḥ ..
sadakṣiṇaṃ saṃyato yaḥ pavitraśca jitendriyaḥ .. 43 ..
1.6.d:
तीर्थे सहस्रं संपूज्य भक्त्या पञ्चोपचारतः ॥
सदक्षिणं संयतो यः पवित्रश्च जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 43 ॥
1.6.m:
he who, restrained, pure, and with senses conquered, worships a thousand [such liṅgas]
at a sacred ford with devotion through the five offerings, accompanied by priestly gifts,

1.6.s:
koṭikalpaṃ ca goloke modate ca mayā saha ..
lakṣaṃ tīrthe pūjayedyo vidhivatsādhudakṣiṇam .. 44 ..
1.6.d:
कोटिकल्पं च गोलोके मोदते च मया सह ॥
लक्षं तीर्थे पूजयेद्यो विधिवत्साधुदक्षिणम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.6.m:
delights with Me in Goloka for a crore of kalpas.
Whoever worships a hundred thousand [liṅgas] at a sacred ford according to rule, with ample priestly gifts,

1.6.s:
na cyutistasya golokātsa bhavedāvayoḥ samaḥ ..
mṛdbhasmagośakṛtpiṇḍaistīrthe vālukayā'pi vā .. 45 ..
1.6.d:
न च्युतिस्तस्य गोलोकात्स भवेदावयोः समः ॥
मृद्भस्मगोशकृत्पिण्डैस्तीर्थे वालुकयाऽपि वा ॥ 45 ॥
1.6.m:
never falls from Goloka; he becomes equal to the two of us.
Having fashioned a liṅga from clay, ashes, lumps of cow-dung, or sand

1.6.s:
kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vasetkalpāyutaṃ divi ..
prajāvānbhūmimānvidvānputravāndhanavāṃstathā.. 46 ..
1.6.d:
कृत्वा लिङ्गं सकृत्पूज्य वसेत्कल्पायुतं दिवि ॥
प्रजावान्भूमिमान्विद्वान्पुत्रवान्धनवांस्तथा॥ 46 ॥
1.6.m:
at a sacred ford and worshipped it once, one dwells in heaven for ten thousand kalpas.
Endowed with offspring, endowed with land, learned, endowed with sons, and wealthy,

1.6.s:
jñānavānmuktimānsādhuḥ śivaliṅgārcanādbhavet ..
śivaliṅgārcanaṃ sthānaṃ mattīrthaṃ tīrthameva tat ..
bhavettatra mṛtaḥ pāpī śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 47 ..
1.6.d:
ज्ञानवान्मुक्तिमान्साधुः शिवलिङ्गार्चनाद्भवेत् ॥
शिवलिङ्गार्चनं स्थानं मत्तीर्थं तीर्थमेव तत् ॥
भवेत्तत्र मृतः पापी शिवलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 47 ॥
1.6.m:
endowed with knowledge, virtuous, and attaining liberation does one become from worship of the Śivaliṅga.
The place where a Śivaliṅga is worshipped is My sacred ford, indeed a true sacred ford.
Even a sinner who dies there goes to the world of Śiva.

1.6.s:
mahādeva mahādeva mahādevetivādinaḥ ..
paścādyāmi mahātrasto nāmaśravaṇalobhataḥ .. 48 ..
1.6.d:
महादेव महादेव महादेवेतिवादिनः ॥
पश्चाद्यामि महात्रस्तो नामश्रवणलोभतः ॥ 48 ॥
1.6.m:
Behind one who chants, 'Mahādeva, Mahādeva, Mahādeva,'
I follow in great haste out of eagerness to hear the name."

1.6.s:
śiveti śabdamuccāryya prāṇāṃstyajati yo naraḥ ..
koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmukto muktiṃ prayāti saḥ .. 49 ..
1.6.d:
शिवेति शब्दमुच्चार्य्य प्राणांस्त्यजति यो नरः ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितात्पापान्मुक्तो मुक्तिं प्रयाति सः ॥ 49 ॥
1.6.m:
The man who utters the word 'Śiva' as he gives up his vital breaths,
freed from sins accumulated across crores of births, attains liberation.

1.6.s:
śivakalyāṇavacanaṃ kalyāṇaṃ muktivācakam ..
yatastatprabhavettena sa śivaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 1.6.50 ..
1.6.d:
शिवकल्याणवचनं कल्याणं मुक्तिवाचकम् ॥
यतस्तत्प्रभवेत्तेन स शिवः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 1.6.50 ॥
1.6.m:
'Śiva' expresses auspiciousness, and auspiciousness denotes liberation.
Because it originates from him, he is proclaimed as Śiva.

1.6.s:
vicchede dhanabandhūnāṃ nimagnaḥ śokasāgare ..
śiveti śabdamuccāryya labhetsarvaśivaṃ naraḥ .. 51 ..
1.6.d:
विच्छेदे धनबन्धूनां निमग्नः शोकसागरे ॥
शिवेति शब्दमुच्चार्य्य लभेत्सर्वशिवं नरः ॥ 51 ॥
1.6.m:
Immersed in an ocean of grief at separation from wealth and kin,
a man who utters the word 'Śiva' obtains all auspiciousness.

1.6.s:
pāpaghne vartate śiśca vaśca muktiprade tathā ..
pāpaghno mokṣado nṝṇāṃ śivastena prakīrtitaḥ .. 52 ..
1.6.d:
पापघ्ने वर्तते शिश्च वश्च मुक्तिप्रदे तथा ॥
पापघ्नो मोक्षदो नॄणां शिवस्तेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 52 ॥
1.6.m:
The syllable 'śi' denotes the destroyer of sin, and 'va' the granter of liberation;
therefore he is proclaimed as Śiva, the destroyer of sins and granter of liberation to men.

1.6.s:
śiveti ca śivaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravarttate ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam .. 53 ..
1.6.d:
शिवेति च शिवं नाम यस्य वाचि प्रवर्त्तते ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पापं तस्य नश्यति निश्चितम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.6.m:
When the auspicious name 'Śiva' is present on someone's tongue,
the sin accumulated by him across crores of births is surely destroyed.

1.6.s:
ityuktvā śūline kṛṣṇo dattvā kalpataruṃ manum ..
tattvajñānaṃ mṛtyujayamavocatsiṃhavāhinīm .. 54 ..
1.6.d:
इत्युक्त्वा शूलिने कृष्णो दत्त्वा कल्पतरुं मनुम् ॥
तत्त्वज्ञानं मृत्युजयमवोचत्सिंहवाहिनीम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.6.m:
Having spoken thus to the wielder of the trident, and having given him the wish-fulfilling tree of a mantra,
knowledge of truth, and victory over death, Kṛṣṇa spoke to the goddess who rides a lion:

1.6.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
adhunā tiṣṭha vatse tvaṃ goloke mama sannidhau ..
kāle bhajiṣyasi śivaṃ śivadaṃ ca śivāyanam .. 55 ..
1.6.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
अधुना तिष्ठ वत्से त्वं गोलोके मम सन्निधौ ॥
काले भजिष्यसि शिवं शिवदं च शिवायनम् ॥ 55 ॥
1.6.m:
"Now remain here, my child, in Goloka in my presence.
In due course you will worship Śiva, who gives auspiciousness and is the abode of auspiciousness.

1.6.s:
tejaḥsu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya varānane ..
saṃhṛtya daityānsarvāṃśca bhavitā sarvapūjitā .. 56 ..
1.6.d:
तेजःसु सर्वदेवानामाविर्भूय वरानने ॥
संहृत्य दैत्यान्सर्वांश्च भविता सर्वपूजिता ॥ 56 ॥
1.6.m:
Manifesting from the splendor of all the gods, O fair-faced one,
and destroying all the Daityas, you will be worshipped by all.

1.6.s:
tataḥ kalpaviśeṣe ca satyaṃ satyayuge sati ..
bhavitā dakṣakanyā tvaṃ suśīlā śambhugehinī .. 57 ..
1.6.d:
ततः कल्पविशेषे च सत्यं सत्ययुगे सति ॥
भविता दक्षकन्या त्वं सुशीला शम्भुगेहिनी ॥ 57 ॥
1.6.m:
Then, in a particular kalpa, truly in the Satya Yuga, O virtuous lady,
you will become Dakṣa's daughter, of good conduct and wife of Śambhu.

1.6.s:
tataḥ śarīraṃ saṃtyajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā ..
menāyāṃ śailabhāryyāyāṃ bhavitā pārvatīti ca .. 58 ..
1.6.d:
ततः शरीरं संत्यज्य यज्ञे भर्तुश्च निन्दया ॥
मेनायां शैलभार्य्यायां भविता पार्वतीति च ॥ 58 ॥
1.6.m:
Then, casting off your body at the sacrificial rite because of the reviling of your husband,
you will be born to Menā, the mountain's wife, as Pārvatī.

1.6.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca vihariṣyasi śambhunā ..
pūrṇaṃ tataḥ sarvakālamamedaṃ tvaṃ labhiṣyasi .. 59 ..
1.6.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं च विहरिष्यसि शम्भुना ॥
पूर्णं ततः सर्वकालममेदं त्वं लभिष्यसि ॥ 59 ॥
1.6.m:
For a thousand divine years you will sport with Śambhu;
then you will obtain this full, eternal abode of mine.

1.6.s:
kāle sarveṣu viśveṣu mahāpūjāsu pūjite..
bhavitā prativarṣe ca śāradī yā sureśvari .. .. 1.6.60 ..
1.6.d:
काले सर्वेषु विश्वेषु महापूजासु पूजिते॥
भविता प्रतिवर्षे च शारदी या सुरेश्वरि ॥ ॥ 1.6.60 ॥
1.6.m:
In due course, worshipped in all the worlds during great festivals,
there will be the autumn worship of you every year, O queen of gods.

1.6.s:
grāmeṣu nagareṣveva pūjitā grāmadevatā ..
bhavatī bhavitetyevaṃ nāmabhedena cāruṇā .. 61 ..
1.6.d:
ग्रामेषु नगरेष्वेव पूजिता ग्रामदेवता ॥
भवती भवितेत्येवं नामभेदेन चारुणा ॥ 61 ॥
1.6.m:
In villages and cities you will be worshipped as the village deity;
you will exist through various charming names.

1.6.s:
madājñayā śivakṛtaistantrairnānāvidhairapi ..
pūjāvidhiṃ vidhāsyāmi kavacaṃ stotrasaṃyutam .. 62 ..
1.6.d:
मदाज्ञया शिवकृतैस्तन्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥
पूजाविधिं विधास्यामि कवचं स्तोत्रसंयुतम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.6.m:
By my command, through the various tantras composed by Śiva,
I will institute the ritual of worship along with the armour and hymn of praise.

1.6.s:
bhaviṣyanti mahāntaśca tavaiva paricārakāḥ ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhāśca phalabhāginaḥ .. 63 ..
1.6.d:
भविष्यन्ति महान्तश्च तवैव परिचारकाः ॥
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां सिद्धाश्च फलभागिनः ॥ 63 ॥
1.6.m:
Great ones will become your very attendants;
they will be accomplished and partake of the fruits of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

1.6.s:
ye tvāṃ mātarbhajiṣyanti puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ..
teṣāṃ yaśaśca kīrtiśca dharmaiśvaryyaṃ ca varddhate .. 64 ..
1.6.d:
ये त्वां मातर्भजिष्यन्ति पुण्यक्षेत्रे च भारते ॥
तेषां यशश्च कीर्तिश्च धर्मैश्वर्य्यं च वर्द्धते ॥ 64 ॥
1.6.m:
Those who worship you, O mother, in the sacred land of Bhārata—
their honor, fame, virtue, and sovereignty will increase."

1.6.s:
ityuktvā prakṛtiṃ tasyai mantramekādaśākṣaram ..
dattvā sakāmabījaṃ ca mantrarājamanuttamam .. 65 ..
1.6.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रकृतिं तस्यै मन्त्रमेकादशाक्षरम् ॥
दत्त्वा सकामबीजं च मन्त्रराजमनुत्तमम् ॥ 65 ॥
1.6.m:
Having spoken thus to Prakṛti, [and] having given her the eleven-syllable mantra
with the desire seed-syllable, the unsurpassed king of mantras,

1.6.s:
cakāra vidhinā dhyānaṃ bhaktaṃ bhaktānukampayā ..
śrīmāyākāmabījāḍhyaṃ dadau mantraṃ daśākṣaram .. 66 ..
1.6.d:
चकार विधिना ध्यानं भक्तं भक्तानुकम्पया ॥
श्रीमायाकामबीजाढ्यं ददौ मन्त्रं दशाक्षरम् ॥ 66 ॥
1.6.m:
he properly taught the meditation out of compassion for his devotee; / he gave the ten-syllable mantra rich with the Śrī, Māyā, and Kāma seed-syllables.
The all-pervading Lord gave her the power suitable for creation, / the bestower of desires that grants all perfections,

1.6.s:
sṛṣṭyaupayaugikīṃ śaktiṃ sarvasiddhiṃ ca kāmadām ..
tadviśiṣṭotkṛṣṭatattvaṃ jñānaṃ tasyai dadau vibhuḥ .. 67 ..
1.6.d:
सृष्ट्यौपयौगिकीं शक्तिं सर्वसिद्धिं च कामदाम् ॥
तद्विशिष्टोत्कृष्टतत्त्वं ज्ञानं तस्यै ददौ विभुः ॥ 67 ॥
1.6.m:
and the knowledge of the excellent, supreme truth distinguished by that.
Having given the thirteen-syllable mantra to Śaṅkara, / along with the armour and hymn of praise, O twice-born,

1.6.s:
trayodaśākṣaraṃ mantraṃ dattvā tasmai jagatpatiḥ ..
kavacaṃ stotrasahitaṃ śaṅkarāya tathā dvija .. 68 ..
1.6.d:
त्रयोदशाक्षरं मन्त्रं दत्त्वा तस्मै जगत्पतिः ॥
कवचं स्तोत्रसहितं शङ्कराय तथा द्विज ॥ 68 ॥
1.6.m:
the Lord of the universe, having given that mantra and that very knowledge of perfection / to Dharma, to Kāma, to Fire, to Kubera, and to Vāyu—
having thus bestowed the supreme mantra and so forth upon Kubera and the others,

1.6.s:
dattvā dharmāya taṃ mantraṃ siddhijñānaṃ tadeva ca ..
kāmāya vahnaye caiva kuberāya ca vāyave .. 69 ..
1.6.d:
दत्त्वा धर्माय तं मन्त्रं सिद्धिज्ञानं तदेव च ॥
कामाय वह्नये चैव कुबेराय च वायवे ॥ 69 ॥
1.6.m:
the Ordainer of the creator spoke the rule to Brahmā for the sake of creation.
The Blessed Lord said:

1.6.s:
evaṃ kuberādibhyastu dattvā mantrādikaṃ param..
vidhiṃ provāca sṛṣṭyarthaṃ vidhāturvidhireva saḥ .. 1.6.70 ..
1.6.d:
एवं कुबेरादिभ्यस्तु दत्त्वा मन्त्रादिकं परम्॥
विधिं प्रोवाच सृष्ट्यर्थं विधातुर्विधिरेव सः ॥ 1.6.70 ॥
1.6.m:
"Having performed my austerity for a thousand divine years,
bring forth the varied, supreme creation, O fortunate Brahmā."

1.6.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
madīyaṃ ca tapaḥ kṛtvā divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ..
sṛṣṭiṃ kuru mahābhāga vidhe nānāvidhāṃ parām .. 71 ..
1.6.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
मदीयं च तपः कृत्वा दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥
सृष्टिं कुरु महाभाग विधे नानाविधां पराम् ॥ 71 ॥
1.6.m:
and went along with the gopīs and gopas to the Vṛndāvana forest.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'The Description of Creation', in the Brahmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Brahmavaivarta Mahāpurāṇa, in the dialogue between Sauti and Śaunaka.

1.6.s:
ityuktvā brahmaṇe kṛṣṇo dadau mālāṃ manoramām ..
jagāma sārddhaṃ gopībhirgopairvṛndāvanaṃ vanam .. 72 ..
1.6.d:
इत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मणे कृष्णो ददौ मालां मनोरमाम् ॥
जगाम सार्द्धं गोपीभिर्गोपैर्वृन्दावनं वनम् ॥ 72 ॥
1.6.m:
Sauti said:
Then Brahmā, having performed austerity and obtained the desired perfection,

1.7.s:
sautiruvāca ..
tadā brahmā tapaḥ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prāpya yathepsitām ..
sasṛje pṛthivīmādau madhukaiṭabhamedasā .. 1 ..
1.7.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
तदा ब्रह्मा तपः कृत्वा सिद्धिं प्राप्य यथेप्सिताम् ॥
ससृजे पृथिवीमादौ मधुकैटभमेदसा ॥ 1 ॥

1.7.s:
sasṛje parvatānaṣṭau pradhānānsumanoharān ..
kṣudrānasaṃkhyānkiṃ brūmaḥ pradhānākhyāṃ niśāmaya .. 2 ..
1.7.d:
ससृजे पर्वतानष्टौ प्रधानान्सुमनोहरान् ॥
क्षुद्रानसंख्यान्किं ब्रूमः प्रधानाख्यां निशामय ॥ 2 ॥

1.7.s:
sumeruṃ caiva kailāsaṃ malayaṃ ca himālayam..
udayaṃ ca tathā'staṃ ca suvelaṃ gandhamādanam .. 3 ..
1.7.d:
सुमेरुं चैव कैलासं मलयं च हिमालयम्॥
उदयं च तथाऽस्तं च सुवेलं गन्धमादनम् ॥ 3 ॥

1.7.s:
samudrānsasṛje sapta nadānkatividhā nadīḥ ..
vṛkṣāṃśca grāmanagaraṃ samudrākhyā niśāmaya .. 4 ..
1.7.d:
समुद्रान्ससृजे सप्त नदान्कतिविधा नदीः ॥
वृक्षांश्च ग्रामनगरं समुद्राख्या निशामय ॥ 4 ॥

1.7.s:
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalārṇavān ..
lakṣayojanamānena dviguṇāṃśca parātparān .. 5 ..
1.7.d:
लवणेक्षुसुरासर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलार्णवान् ॥
लक्षयोजनमानेन द्विगुणांश्च परात्परान् ॥ 5 ॥

1.7.s:
saptadvīpāṃśca tadbhūmimaṇḍale kamalākṛte ..
upadvīpāṃstathā saptasīmāśailāṃśca sapta ca .. 6 ..
1.7.d:
सप्तद्वीपांश्च तद्भूमिमण्डले कमलाकृते ॥
उपद्वीपांस्तथा सप्तसीमाशैलांश्च सप्त च ॥ 6 ॥

1.7.s:
nibodha vipra dvīpākhyāṃ purā yā vidhinā kṛtā ..
jambūśākakuśaplakṣakrauñcanyagrodhapauṣkarān .. 7 ..
1.7.d:
निबोध विप्र द्वीपाख्यां पुरा या विधिना कृता ॥
जम्बूशाककुशप्लक्षक्रौञ्चन्यग्रोधपौष्करान् ॥ 7 ॥

1.7.s:
meroraṣṭasu śṛṅgeṣu sasṛje'ṣṭau purī prabhuḥ ..
aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vihārāya manoharāḥ .. 8 ..
1.7.d:
मेरोरष्टसु शृङ्गेषु ससृजेऽष्टौ पुरी प्रभुः ॥
अष्टानां लोकपालानां विहाराय मनोहराः ॥ 8 ॥

1.7.s:
mūle'nantasya nagarīṃ nirmāya jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
ūrdhve svargāṃśca saptaiva teṣāmākhyā niśāmaya..9..
1.7.d:
मूलेऽनन्तस्य नगरीं निर्माय जगतां पतिः ॥
ऊर्ध्वे स्वर्गांश्च सप्तैव तेषामाख्या निशामय॥9॥

1.7.s:
bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ sumanoharam ..
janolokaṃ tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ ca śaunaka..1.7.10..
1.7.d:
भूर्लोकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं सुमनोहरम् ॥
जनोलोकं तपोलोकं सत्यलोकं च शौनक॥1.7.10॥
1.7.m: Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka, O Śaunaka.

1.7.s:
śṛṅgamūrdhni brahmalokaṃ jarādiparivarjitam ..
tadūrdhve dhruvalokaṃ ca sarvataḥ sumanoharam ..11..
1.7.d:
शृङ्गमूर्ध्नि ब्रह्मलोकं जरादिपरिवर्जितम् ॥
तदूर्ध्वे ध्रुवलोकं च सर्वतः सुमनोहरम् ॥11॥
1.7.m:
At the summit of the peak [is] Brahmaloka, free from old age and the like,
and above that, Dhruvaloka, delightful in every respect.

1.7.s:
tadadhaḥ sapta pātālānnirmame jagadīśvaraḥ ..
svargātiriktabhogāḍhyānadhodhaḥ kramato mune .. 12 ..
1.7.d:
तदधः सप्त पातालान्निर्ममे जगदीश्वरः ॥
स्वर्गातिरिक्तभोगाढ्यानधोधः क्रमतो मुने ॥ 12 ॥
1.7.m:
Beneath that, the Lord of the universe fashioned seven underworlds,
abounding in enjoyments exceeding those of heaven, one below the other in order, O sage:

1.7.s:
atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva sutalaṃ ca talātalam ..
mahātalaṃ ca pātālaṃ rasātalamadhastataḥ .. 13 ..
1.7.d:
अतलं वितलं चैव सुतलं च तलातलम् ॥
महातलं च पातालं रसातलमधस्ततः ॥ 13 ॥
1.7.m:
Atala, Vitala, Sutala, Talātala,
Mahātala, Pātāla, and Rasātala below that.

1.7.s:
saptadvīpaiḥ saptanākaiḥ saptapātālasaṃjñakaiḥ ..
ebhirlokaiśca brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmādhikṛtameva ca .. 14 ..
1.7.d:
सप्तद्वीपैः सप्तनाकैः सप्तपातालसंज्ञकैः ॥
एभिर्लोकैश्च ब्रह्माण्डं ब्रह्माधिकृतमेव च ॥ 14 ॥
1.7.m:
With seven continents, seven heavens, and seven designated as underworlds—
the cosmic egg with these realms is indeed ruled by Brahmā.

1.7.s:
evañcāsaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimameva ca ..
mahāviṣṇośca lomnāṃ ca vivareṣu ca śaunaka .. 15 ..
1.7.d:
एवञ्चासंख्यब्रह्माण्डं सर्वं कृत्रिममेव च ॥
महाविष्णोश्च लोम्नां च विवरेषु च शौनक ॥ 15 ॥
1.7.m:
And thus countless cosmic eggs, all artificially created,
exist within the pores of the body hair of Mahāviṣṇu, O Śaunaka.

1.7.s:
prativiśveṣu dikpālā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
surā narādayaḥ sarve santi kṛṣṇasya māyayā .. 16 ..
1.7.d:
प्रतिविश्वेषु दिक्पाला ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥
सुरा नरादयः सर्वे सन्ति कृष्णस्य मायया ॥ 16 ॥
1.7.m:
In every universe there are guardians of the directions, Brahmās, Viṣṇus, and Maheśvaras,
gods, humans, and all others, existing by the māyā of Kṛṣṇa.

1.7.s:
brāhmāṇḍagaṇanāṃ kartuṃ na kṣamo jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
na śaṅkaro na dharmaśca na ca viṣṇuśca ke surāḥ..17..
1.7.d:
ब्राह्माण्डगणनां कर्तुं न क्षमो जगतां पतिः ॥
न शङ्करो न धर्मश्च न च विष्णुश्च के सुराः॥17॥
1.7.m:
The Lord of the worlds is not able to count the cosmic eggs,
nor Śaṅkara, nor Dharma, nor Viṣṇu; what to say of the gods?

1.7.s:
saṃkhyātumīśvaraḥ śakto na saṃkhyātuṃ tathāpi saḥ ..
viśvākāśadiśāṃ caiva sarvato yadyapi kṣamaḥ .. 18 ..
1.7.d:
संख्यातुमीश्वरः शक्तो न संख्यातुं तथापि सः ॥
विश्वाकाशदिशां चैव सर्वतो यद्यपि क्षमः ॥ 18 ॥
1.7.m:
Though the Lord is capable, even he does not count [them],
even though he is able [to encompass] everything—the universes, space, and the directions.

1.7.s:
kṛtrimāṇi ca viśvāni viśvasthāni ca yāni ca ..
anityāni ca viprendra svapnavannaśvarāṇi ca .. 19 ..
1.7.d:
कृत्रिमाणि च विश्वानि विश्वस्थानि च यानि च ॥
अनित्यानि च विप्रेन्द्र स्वप्नवन्नश्वराणि च ॥ 19 ॥
1.7.m:
The created universes and whatever is located within the universes
are impermanent, O best of Brahmins, and perishable like a dream.

1.7.s:
vaikuṇṭhaḥ śivalokaśca golokaśca tayoḥ paraḥ ..
nityo viśvabahirbhūtaścātmākāśadiśo yathā .. 1.7.20 ..
1.7.d:
वैकुण्ठः शिवलोकश्च गोलोकश्च तयोः परः ॥
नित्यो विश्वबहिर्भूतश्चात्माकाशदिशो यथा ॥ 1.7.20 ॥
1.7.m:
Vaikuṇṭha, Śivaloka, and Goloka, which is beyond those two,
are eternal and exist outside the universe, like the self, space, and the directions.

1.8.s:
sautiruvāca ..
brahmā viśvaṃ vinirmāya sāvitryāṃ varayoṣiti ..
cakāra vīryyādhānaṃ ca kāmukyāṃ kāmuko yathā .. 1 ..
1.8.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
ब्रह्मा विश्वं विनिर्माय सावित्र्यां वरयोषिति ॥
चकार वीर्य्याधानं च कामुक्यां कामुको यथा ॥ 1 ॥

1.8.s:
sā divyaṃ śatavarṣaṃ ca dhṛtvā garbhaṃ sudussaham ..
suprasūtā ca suṣuve caturvedānmanoharān .. 2 ..
1.8.d:
सा दिव्यं शतवर्षं च धृत्वा गर्भं सुदुस्सहम् ॥
सुप्रसूता च सुषुवे चतुर्वेदान्मनोहरान् ॥ 2 ॥

1.8.s:
vividhāñśāstrasaṃghāṃśca tarkavyākaraṇādikān ..
ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃkhyakā divyā rāgiṇīḥ sumanoharāḥ .. 3 ..
1.8.d:
विविधाञ्शास्त्रसंघांश्च तर्कव्याकरणादिकान् ॥
षट्त्रिंशत्संख्यका दिव्या रागिणीः सुमनोहराः ॥ 3 ॥

1.8.s:
ṣaḍrāgānsundarāṃścaiva nānātāla samanvitān ..
satyatretādvāparāṃśca kaliṃ ca kalahapriyam .. 4 ..
1.8.d:
षड्रागान्सुन्दरांश्चैव नानाताल समन्वितान् ॥
सत्यत्रेताद्वापरांश्च कलिं च कलहप्रियम् ॥ 4 ॥

1.8.s:
varṣamāsamṛtuṃ caiva tithiṃ daṇḍakṣaṇādikam ..
dinaṃ rātriṃ ca vārāṃśca sandhyāmuṣasameva ca .. 5 ..
1.8.d:
वर्षमासमृतुं चैव तिथिं दण्डक्षणादिकम् ॥
दिनं रात्रिं च वारांश्च सन्ध्यामुषसमेव च ॥ 5 ॥

1.8.s:
puṣṭiṃ ca devasenāṃ ca medhāṃ ca vijayāṃ jayām ..
ṣaṭkṛttikāśca yogāṃśca karaṇaṃ ca tapo dhanaḥ .. 6 ..
1.8.d:
पुष्टिं च देवसेनां च मेधां च विजयां जयाम् ॥
षट्कृत्तिकाश्च योगांश्च करणं च तपो धनः ॥ 6 ॥

1.8.s:
devasenāṃ mahāṣaṣṭhīṃ kārttikeyapriyāṃ satīm ..
mātṛkāsu pradhānā sā bālānāmiṣṭadevatā .. 7 ..
1.8.d:
देवसेनां महाषष्ठीं कार्त्तिकेयप्रियां सतीम् ॥
मातृकासु प्रधाना सा बालानामिष्टदेवता ॥ 7 ॥

1.8.s:
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kalpatrayamidaṃ smṛtam ..
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva dviparārddhaṃ ca prākṛtam .. 8 ..
1.8.d:
ब्राह्मं पाद्मं च वाराहं कल्पत्रयमिदं स्मृतम् ॥
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं चैव द्विपरार्द्धं च प्राकृतम् ॥ 8 ॥

1.8.s:
caturvidhaṃ ca pralayaṃ kālaṃ vai mṛtyukanyakām ..
sarvānvyādhigaṇāṃścaiva sā prasūya stanaṃ dadau .. 9 ..
1.8.d:
चतुर्विधं च प्रलयं कालं वै मृत्युकन्यकाम् ॥
सर्वान्व्याधिगणांश्चैव सा प्रसूय स्तनं ददौ ॥ 9 ॥

1.8.s:
atha dhātuḥ pṛṣṭhadeśādadharmaḥ samajāyata..
alakṣmīstadvāmapārśvādbabhūvātyantakāminī ..1.8.10..
1.8.d:
अथ धातुः पृष्ठदेशादधर्मः समजायत॥
अलक्ष्मीस्तद्वामपार्श्वाद्बभूवात्यन्तकामिनी ॥1.8.10॥

1.8.s:
nābhideśādviśvakarmā jāto vai śilpināṃ guruḥ ..
mahāntau vasavo'ṣṭau ca mahābalaparākramāḥ .. 11 ..
1.8.d:
नाभिदेशाद्विश्वकर्मा जातो वै शिल्पिनां गुरुः ॥
महान्तौ वसवोऽष्टौ च महाबलपराक्रमाः ॥ 11 ॥

1.8.s:
atha dhātuśca manasa āvirbhūtāḥ kumārakāḥ ..
catvāraḥ pañcavarṣīyā jvalanto brahmatejasā .. 12 ..
1.8.d:
अथ धातुश्च मनस आविर्भूताः कुमारकाः ॥
चत्वारः पञ्चवर्षीया ज्वलन्तो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 12 ॥

1.8.s:
sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sanatkumāro bhagavāṃścaturtho jñānināṃ varaḥ ..13..
1.8.d:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः ॥
सनत्कुमारो भगवांश्चतुर्थो ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥13॥

1.8.s:
āvirbabhūva mukhataḥ kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ..
divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmānsastrīkaḥ sundaro yuvā .. 14 ..
1.8.d:
आविर्बभूव मुखतः कुमारः कनकप्रभः ॥
दिव्यरूपधरः श्रीमान्सस्त्रीकः सुन्दरो युवा ॥ 14 ॥

1.8.s:
kṣattriyāṇāṃ bījarūpo nāmnā svāyambhuvo manuḥ ..
yā strī sā śatarūpā ca rūpāḍhyā kamalā kalā ..15..
1.8.d:
क्षत्त्रियाणां बीजरूपो नाम्ना स्वायम्भुवो मनुः ॥
या स्त्री सा शतरूपा च रूपाढ्या कमला कला ॥15॥

1.8.s:
sastrīkaśca manustasthau dhātrājñā paripālakaḥ ..
svayaṃ vidhātā putrāṃśca tānuvāca praharṣitān .. 16 ..
1.8.d:
सस्त्रीकश्च मनुस्तस्थौ धात्राज्ञा परिपालकः ॥
स्वयं विधाता पुत्रांश्च तानुवाच प्रहर्षितान् ॥ 16 ॥

1.8.s:
sṛṣṭiṃ karttuṃ mahābhāgo mahābhāgavatāndvija ..
jagmuste ca nahītyuktvā taptuṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ .. 17 ..
1.8.d:
सृष्टिं कर्त्तुं महाभागो महाभागवतान्द्विज ॥
जग्मुस्ते च नहीत्युक्त्वा तप्तुं कृष्णपरायणाः ॥ 17 ॥

1.8.s:
cukopa hetunā tena vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
kopāsaktasya ca vidherjvalato brahmatejasā .. 18 ..
1.8.d:
चुकोप हेतुना तेन विधाता जगतां पतिः ॥
कोपासक्तस्य च विधेर्ज्वलतो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 18 ॥

1.8.s:
āvirbhūtā lalāṭācca rudrā ekādaśa prabho ..
kālāgnirudraḥ saṃhartā teṣāmekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
1.8.d:
आविर्भूता ललाटाच्च रुद्रा एकादश प्रभो ॥
कालाग्निरुद्रः संहर्ता तेषामेकः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 19 ॥

1.8.s:
sarveṣāmeva viśvānāṃ sa tāmasa iti smṛtaḥ ..
rājasaśca svayaṃ brahmā śivo viṣṇuśca sāttvikau .. 1.8.20 ..
1.8.d:
सर्वेषामेव विश्वानां स तामस इति स्मृतः ॥
राजसश्च स्वयं ब्रह्मा शिवो विष्णुश्च सात्त्विकौ ॥ 1.8.20 ॥

1.8.s:
golokanāthaḥ kṛṣṇaśca nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ..
paramajñānino mūrkhā vadantaṃ tāmasaṃ śivam .. 21 ..
1.8.d:
गोलोकनाथः कृष्णश्च निर्गुणः प्रकृतेः परः ॥
परमज्ञानिनो मूर्खा वदन्तं तामसं शिवम् ॥ 21 ॥

1.8.s:
śuddhasattvasvarūpaṃ ca nirmalaṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīm ..
śṛṇu nāmāni rudrāṇāṃ vedoktāni ca yāni ca .. 22 ..
1.8.d:
शुद्धसत्त्वस्वरूपं च निर्मलं वैष्णवाग्रणीम् ॥
शृणु नामानि रुद्राणां वेदोक्तानि च यानि च ॥ 22 ॥

1.8.s:
mahānmahātmā matimānbhīṣaṇaśca bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
ṛtudhvajaścordhvakeśaḥ piṅgalākṣo ruciḥ śuciḥ .. 23 ..
1.8.d:
महान्महात्मा मतिमान्भीषणश्च भयंकरः ॥
ऋतुध्वजश्चोर्ध्वकेशः पिङ्गलाक्षो रुचिः शुचिः ॥ 23 ॥

1.8.s:
pulastyo dakṣakarṇācca pulaho vāmakarṇataḥ ..
dakṣanetrāttathā'triśca vāmanetrātkratuḥ svayam .. 24 ..
1.8.d:
पुलस्त्यो दक्षकर्णाच्च पुलहो वामकर्णतः ॥
दक्षनेत्रात्तथाऽत्रिश्च वामनेत्रात्क्रतुः स्वयम् ॥ 24 ॥

1.8.s:
araṇirnāsikārandhrādaṅgirāśca mukhādruciḥ ..
bhṛguśca vāmapārśvācca dakṣo dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ .. 25 ..
1.8.d:
अरणिर्नासिकारन्ध्रादङ्गिराश्च मुखाद्रुचिः ॥
भृगुश्च वामपार्श्वाच्च दक्षो दक्षिणपार्श्वतः ॥ 25 ॥

1.8.s:
chāyāyāḥ kardamo jāto nābheḥ pañcaśikhastathā ..
vakṣasaścaiva voḍhuśca kaṇṭhadeśācca nāradaḥ .. 26 ..
1.8.d:
छायायाः कर्दमो जातो नाभेः पञ्चशिखस्तथा ॥
वक्षसश्चैव वोढुश्च कण्ठदेशाच्च नारदः ॥ 26 ॥

1.8.s:
marīciḥ skandhadeśāccaivāpāntaratamā galāt ..
vasiṣṭho rasanādeśātpracetā adharoṣṭhataḥ .. 27 ..
1.8.d:
मरीचिः स्कन्धदेशाच्चैवापान्तरतमा गलात् ॥
वसिष्ठो रसनादेशात्प्रचेता अधरोष्ठतः ॥ 27 ॥

1.8.s:
haṃsaśca vāmakukṣeśca dakṣakukṣeryatiḥ svayam ..
sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ sa vidhiścakārājñāṃ sutānprati ..
piturvākyaṃ samākarṇya tamuvāca sa nāradaḥ .. 28 ..
1.8.d:
हंसश्च वामकुक्षेश्च दक्षकुक्षेर्यतिः स्वयम् ॥
सृष्टिं विधातुं स विधिश्चकाराज्ञां सुतान्प्रति ॥
पितुर्वाक्यं समाकर्ण्य तमुवाच स नारदः ॥ 28 ॥

1.8.s:
nārada uvāca ..
pūrvamānaya majjyeṣṭhānsanakādīnpitāmaha ..
kārayitvā dārayuktānasmānvada jagatpate .. 29 ..
1.8.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
पूर्वमानय मज्ज्येष्ठान्सनकादीन्पितामह ॥
कारयित्वा दारयुक्तानस्मान्वद जगत्पते ॥ 29 ॥

1.8.s:
pitrā te tapase yuktāḥ saṃsārāya vayaṃ katham ..
aho hanta prabhorbuddhirviparītāya kalpate .. 1.8.30 ..
1.8.d:
पित्रा ते तपसे युक्ताः संसाराय वयं कथम् ॥
अहो हन्त प्रभोर्बुद्धिर्विपरीताय कल्पते ॥ 1.8.30 ॥

1.8.s:
kasmai putrāya pīyūṣātparaṃ dattaṃ tapo'dhunā ..
kasmai dadāsi viṣayaṃ viṣamaṃ ca viṣādhikam .. 31 ..
1.8.d:
कस्मै पुत्राय पीयूषात्परं दत्तं तपोऽधुना ॥
कस्मै ददासि विषयं विषमं च विषाधिकम् ॥ 31 ॥

1.8.s:
atīva nimne ghore ca bhavābdhau yaḥ patetpitaḥ ..
niṣkṛtistasya nāstīti koṭikalpe gate'pi ca .. 32 ..
1.8.d:
अतीव निम्ने घोरे च भवाब्धौ यः पतेत्पितः ॥
निष्कृतिस्तस्य नास्तीति कोटिकल्पे गतेऽपि च ॥ 32 ॥

1.8.s:
nistārabījaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījaṃ ca puruṣotamam ..
sarvadaṃ bhaktidaṃ dāsyapradaṃ satyaṃ kṛpāmayam .. 33 ..
1.8.d:
निस्तारबीजं सर्वेषां बीजं च पुरुषोतमम् ॥
सर्वदं भक्तिदं दास्यप्रदं सत्यं कृपामयम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.8.m: Puruṣottama, the giver of everything, the giver of devotion, the giver of servitude, true, full of compassion,

1.8.s:
bhaktaikaśaraṇaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃ svacchameva ca ..
bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktanāthaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam .. 34 ..
1.8.d:
भक्तैकशरणं भक्तवत्सलं स्वच्छमेव च ॥
भक्तप्रियं भक्तनाथं भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.8.m: the sole refuge of devotees, fond of his devotees, absolutely pure,

1.8.s:
bhaktārādhyaṃ bhaktasādhyaṃ vihāya parameśvaram ..
mano dadhāti ko mūḍho viṣaye nāśakāraṇe .. 35 ..
1.8.d:
भक्ताराध्यं भक्तसाध्यं विहाय परमेश्वरम् ॥
मनो दधाति को मूढो विषये नाशकारणे ॥ 35 ॥
1.8.m:
worshipped by devotees, attained by devotees—
what fool fixes his mind upon sense-objects, which cause destruction?

1.8.s:
vihāya kṛṣṇasevāṃ ca pīyūṣādadhikāṃ priyām ..
ko mūḍho viṣamaśnāti viṣamaṃ viṣayābhidham .. 36 ..
1.8.d:
विहाय कृष्णसेवां च पीयूषादधिकां प्रियाम् ॥
को मूढो विषमश्नाति विषमं विषयाभिधम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.8.m:
Abandoning service to Kṛṣṇa, which is dearer than nectar,
what fool eats the terrible poison named sense-objects?

1.8.s:
svapnavannaśvaraṃ tucchamasatyaṃ mṛtyukāraṇam ..
yathā dīpaśikhāgraṃ ca kīṭānāṃ sumanoharam ..37..
1.8.d:
स्वप्नवन्नश्वरं तुच्छमसत्यं मृत्युकारणम् ॥
यथा दीपशिखाग्रं च कीटानां सुमनोहरम् ॥37॥
1.8.m:
Perishable like a dream, trifling, unreal, the cause of death,
just as the tip of a lamp's flame is very enchanting to moths,

1.8.s:
yathā baḍiśamāṃsaṃ ca matsyāpātasukhapradam..
tathā viṣayiṇāṃ tāta viṣayaṃ mṛtyukāraṇam..38..
1.8.d:
यथा बडिशमांसं च मत्स्यापातसुखप्रदम्॥
तथा विषयिणां तात विषयं मृत्युकारणम्॥38॥
1.8.m:
and just as the meat on a fishhook brings immediate pleasure to fish,
even so, dear father, sense-objects are the cause of death for the worldly.

1.8.s:
ityuktvā nāradastatra virarāma vidheḥ puraḥ ..
tasthau tātaṃ namaskṛtya jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ..39..
1.8.d:
इत्युक्त्वा नारदस्तत्र विरराम विधेः पुरः ॥
तस्थौ तातं नमस्कृत्य ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः ॥39॥
1.8.m:
Having spoken thus, Nārada stopped there before the Creator;
bowing to his father, he stood like a blazing tongue of fire.

1.8.s:
brahmā kopaparītaśca śaśāpa tanayaṃ dvija ..
uvāca kampitāṅgaśca raktāsyaḥ sphuritādharaḥ .. 1.8.40 ..
1.8.d:
ब्रह्मा कोपपरीतश्च शशाप तनयं द्विज ॥
उवाच कम्पिताङ्गश्च रक्तास्यः स्फुरिताधरः ॥ 1.8.40 ॥
1.8.m:
Overcome with anger, Brahmā cursed his son, O twice-born;
with trembling limbs, red-faced, and with quivering lip, he spoke.

1.8.s:
brahmovāca ..
bhavitā jñānalopaste macchāpena ca nārada ..
krīḍāmṛgaśca tvaṃ sādhyo yoṣillubddhadhaśca lampaṭaḥ..41..
1.8.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
भविता ज्ञानलोपस्ते मच्छापेन च नारद ॥
क्रीडामृगश्च त्वं साध्यो योषिल्लुब्द्धधश्च लम्पटः॥41॥
1.8.m:
By my curse, Nārada, you will suffer the loss of your knowledge;
you will be an easily mastered pet beast, greedy for women, and a libertine,

1.8.s:
sthirayauvanayuktānāṃ rūpāḍhyānāṃ manoharaḥ ..
pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca bhartā ca prāṇavallabhaḥ..42..
1.8.d:
स्थिरयौवनयुक्तानां रूपाढ्यानां मनोहरः ॥
पञ्चाशत्कामिनीनां च भर्ता च प्राणवल्लभः॥42॥
1.8.m:
captivating women possessing enduring youth and endowed with beauty,
You shall become the husband and life-breath's beloved of fifty passionate women,

1.8.s:
śṛṅgāraśāstravettā ca mahāśṛṅgāralolupaḥ..
nānāprakāraśṛṅgāranipuṇānāṃ gurorguruḥ ..43..
1.8.d:
शृङ्गारशास्त्रवेत्ता च महाशृङ्गारलोलुपः॥
नानाप्रकारशृङ्गारनिपुणानां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥43॥
1.8.m:
knowing the treatises on erotic love and greatly longing for lovemaking,
the master of masters among those skilled in the diverse arts of love,

1.8.s:
gandharvāṇāṃ ca suvaraḥ susvaraśca sugāyanaḥ ..
vīṇāvādanasandarbhaniṣṇātaḥ sthirayauvanaḥ .. 44 ..
1.8.d:
गन्धर्वाणां च सुवरः सुस्वरश्च सुगायनः ॥
वीणावादनसन्दर्भनिष्णातः स्थिरयौवनः ॥ 44 ॥
1.8.m:
the foremost among the Gandharvas, having a sweet voice and singing beautifully,
an expert in the composition and playing of the vīṇā, endowed with constant youth,

1.8.s:
prājño madhuravāk śāntaḥ suśīlaḥ sundaraḥ sudhīḥ ..
bhaviṣyasi na sandeho nāmataścopabarhaṇaḥ .. 45 ..
1.8.d:
प्राज्ञो मधुरवाक् शान्तः सुशीलः सुन्दरः सुधीः ॥
भविष्यसि न सन्देहो नामतश्चोपबर्हणः ॥ 45 ॥
1.8.m:
wise, sweet-spoken, calm, good-natured, handsome, and of fine intellect.
You will become [him], beyond doubt, by name Upabarhaṇa.

1.8.s:
tābhirdivyaṃ lakṣayugaṃ vihṛtya nirjane vane ..
punarmadīyaśāpena dāsī putraśca tatparaḥ .. 46 ..
1.8.d:
ताभिर्दिव्यं लक्षयुगं विहृत्य निर्जने वने ॥
पुनर्मदीयशापेन दासी पुत्रश्च तत्परः ॥ 46 ॥
1.8.m:
Sporting with them in a lonely forest for a divine hundred thousand ages,
thereafter, again by my curse, you will become the son of a maidservant.

1.8.s:
vatsa vaiṣṇavasaṃsargādvaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt ..
punaḥ kṛṣṇaprasādena bhaviṣyasi mamātmajaḥ .. 47 ..
1.8.d:
वत्स वैष्णवसंसर्गाद्वैष्णवोच्छिष्टभोजनात् ॥
पुनः कृष्णप्रसादेन भविष्यसि ममात्मजः ॥ 47 ॥
1.8.m:
O child, by the association with Vaiṣṇavas and by eating the food-remnants of Vaiṣṇavas,
you will again become my son by the grace of Kṛṣṇa.

1.8.s:
jñānaṃ dāsyāmi te divyaṃ punareva purātanam ..
adhunā bhava naṣṭastvaṃ matsuto nipata dhuvam..48..
1.8.d:
ज्ञानं दास्यामि ते दिव्यं पुनरेव पुरातनम् ॥
अधुना भव नष्टस्त्वं मत्सुतो निपत धुवम्॥48॥
1.8.m:
I will give you once again the ancient, divine knowledge.
Now perish, fall away, cease to be my son, indeed!”

1.8.s:
brahmetyuktvā sutaṃ vipra virarāma jagatpatiḥ ..
ruroda nāradastātamavocatsaṃpuṭāñjaliḥ .. 49 ..
1.8.d:
ब्रह्मेत्युक्त्वा सुतं विप्र विरराम जगत्पतिः ॥
रुरोद नारदस्तातमवोचत्संपुटाञ्जलिः ॥ 49 ॥
1.8.m:
Having spoken thus to his son, O brāhmaṇa, Brahmā, the lord of the universe, fell silent.
Nārada wept and, joining his palms, addressed his father:

1.8.s:
nārada uvāca ..
krodhaṃ saṃhara saṃhartastāta tāta jagadguro ..
sraṣṭustapasvīśasyāho krodho'yaṃ mayyanākaraḥ .. 1.8.50 ..
1.8.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
क्रोधं संहर संहर्तस्तात तात जगद्गुरो ॥
स्रष्टुस्तपस्वीशस्याहो क्रोधोऽयं मय्यनाकरः ॥ 1.8.50 ॥
1.8.m:
“Subdue your wrath, O destroyer, O father, father, teacher of the universe!
Ah, how ungrounded is this wrath toward me from the creator, the lord of ascetics!

1.8.s:
śapetparityajedvidvānputramutpathagāminam ..
tapasvinaṃ sutaṃ śaptuṃ kathamarhasi paṃḍita .. 51 ..
1.8.d:
शपेत्परित्यजेद्विद्वान्पुत्रमुत्पथगामिनम् ॥
तपस्विनं सुतं शप्तुं कथमर्हसि पंडित ॥ 51 ॥
1.8.m:
A wise man should curse and abandon a son who treads the wrong path;
how is it fitting for you, O learned one, to curse an ascetic son?

1.8.s:
janirbhavatu me brahmanyāsu yāsu ca yoniṣu ..
na jahātu harerbhaktirmā vedaṃ dehi me varam ..52..
1.8.d:
जनिर्भवतु मे ब्रह्मन्यासु यासु च योनिषु ॥
न जहातु हरेर्भक्तिर्मा वेदं देहि मे वरम् ॥52॥
1.8.m:
O Brahmā, let my birth occur in whatever wombs it may;
grant me this boon: may devotion to Hari not forsake me!

1.8.s:
putraścejjagatāṃ dhāturnāsti bhaktirhareḥ pade..
sūkarādatiriktaśca so'dhamo bhārate bhuvi .. 53 ..
1.8.d:
पुत्रश्चेज्जगतां धातुर्नास्ति भक्तिर्हरेः पदे॥
सूकरादतिरिक्तश्च सोऽधमो भारते भुवि ॥ 53 ॥
1.8.m:
Even if he is the son of the creator of the worlds, if he has no devotion to the feet of Hari,
he is worse than a pig, a wretched man on the earth of Bhārata.

1.8.s:
jātismaro harerbhaktiyuktaḥ sūkarayoniṣu ..
janirlabhetsa pravaro golokaṃ yāti karmaṇā .. 54 ..
1.8.d:
जातिस्मरो हरेर्भक्तियुक्तः सूकरयोनिषु ॥
जनिर्लभेत्स प्रवरो गोलोकं याति कर्मणा ॥ 54 ॥
1.8.m:
One who remembers previous births, devoted to Hari, even though he takes birth in the wombs of swine,
is exalted and goes to Goloka by his deeds.

1.8.s:
govindacaraṇāmbhojabhaktimādhvīkamīpsitam ..
pibatāṃ vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ sparśapūtā vasundharā .. 55 ..
1.8.d:
गोविन्दचरणाम्भोजभक्तिमाध्वीकमीप्सितम् ॥
पिबतां वैष्णवादीनां स्पर्शपूता वसुन्धरा ॥ 55 ॥
1.8.m:
Drinking the coveted nectar of devotion to the lotus-feet of Govinda,
the earth is purified by the touch of the Vaiṣṇavas and others.

1.8.s:
tīrthāni sparśamicchanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ pitāmaha ..
pāpānāṃ pāpitattvānāṃ kṣālanāyātmanāmapi ..56..
1.8.d:
तीर्थानि स्पर्शमिच्छन्ति वैष्णवानां पितामह ॥
पापानां पापितत्त्वानां क्षालनायात्मनामपि ॥56॥
1.8.m:
O grandfather, the sacred shrines desire the touch of Vaiṣṇavas
in order to wash away even their own sins, the collected filth of the wicked.

1.8.s:
mantropadeśamātreṇa narā muktāśca bhārate ..
paraiśca koṭipuruṣaiḥ pūrvaiḥ sārdhaṃ hareraho .. 57 ..
1.8.d:
मन्त्रोपदेशमात्रेण नरा मुक्ताश्च भारते ॥
परैश्च कोटिपुरुषैः पूर्वैः सार्धं हरेरहो ॥ 57 ॥
1.8.m:
By the mere instruction of a mantra, men in Bhārata are liberated,
together with ten million ancestors and ten million descendants, dedicated to Hari—ah!

1.8.s:
koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmantragrahaṇamātrataḥ ..
muktāḥ śudhyanti yatpūrvaṃ karma nirmūlayanti ca ..58..
1.8.d:
कोटिजन्मार्जितात्पापान्मन्त्रग्रहणमात्रतः ॥
मुक्ताः शुध्यन्ति यत्पूर्वं कर्म निर्मूलयन्ति च ॥58॥
1.8.m:
From the sins accumulated across ten million births, by the mere reception of the mantra,
they are liberated and purified, and they eradicate their former karma.

1.8.s:
putrāndārāṃśca śiṣyāṃśca sevakānbāndhavāṃstathā ..
yo darśayati sanmārgaṃ sadgatistaṃ labheddhruvam ..59..
1.8.d:
पुत्रान्दारांश्च शिष्यांश्च सेवकान्बान्धवांस्तथा ॥
यो दर्शयति सन्मार्गं सद्गतिस्तं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥59॥
1.8.m:
He who shows the true path to sons, wives, disciples,
servants, and likewise kinsmen, certainly attains a good destination.

1.8.s:
yo darśayatyasanmārgaṃ śiṣyairviśvāsito guruḥ ..
kumbhīpāke sthitistasya yāvaccandradivākarau .. 1.8.60 ..
1.8.d:
यो दर्शयत्यसन्मार्गं शिष्यैर्विश्वासितो गुरुः ॥
कुम्भीपाके स्थितिस्तस्य यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 1.8.60 ॥
1.8.m:
The guru who, trusted by his disciples, shows the false path,
dwells in Kumbhīpāka as long as the moon and sun endure.

1.8.s:
sa kiṃguruḥ sa kiṃtātaḥ sa kiṃsvāmī sa kiṃsutaḥ..
yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapadāmbhoje bhaktiṃ dātumanīśvaraḥ .. 61 ..
1.8.d:
स किंगुरुः स किंतातः स किंस्वामी स किंसुतः॥
यः श्रीकृष्णपदाम्भोजे भक्तिं दातुमनीश्वरः ॥ 61 ॥
1.8.m:
Is he a guru, is he a father, is he a master, is he a son,
who is powerless to grant devotion to the lotus-feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa?

1.8.s:
śapto niraparādhena tvayā'haṃ caturānana ..
mayā śaptuṃ tvamucito ghnantaṃ ghnantyapi paṇḍitāḥ .. 62 ..
1.8.d:
शप्तो निरपराधेन त्वयाऽहं चतुरानन ॥
मया शप्तुं त्वमुचितो घ्नन्तं घ्नन्त्यपि पण्डिताः ॥ 62 ॥
1.8.m:
I, who am without fault, have been cursed by you, O Four-Faced One;
it is proper that you be cursed by me; the wise strike back even at one who strikes.

1.8.s:
kavacastotrapūjābhiḥ sahitaste manurmanoḥ ..
lupto bhavatu macchāpātprativiśveṣu niścitam .. 63 ..
1.8.d:
कवचस्तोत्रपूजाभिः सहितस्ते मनुर्मनोः ॥
लुप्तो भवतु मच्छापात्प्रतिविश्वेषु निश्चितम् ॥ 63 ॥
1.8.m:
Your mantra along with its armour, hymn of praise, and rituals of worship,
shall indeed be lost in every universe through my curse!

1.8.s:
apūjyo bhava viśveṣu yāvatkalpatrayaṃ pitaḥ ..
gateṣu triṣu kalpeṣu pūjyapūjyo bhaviṣyasi..64..
1.8.d:
अपूज्यो भव विश्वेषु यावत्कल्पत्रयं पितः ॥
गतेषु त्रिषु कल्पेषु पूज्यपूज्यो भविष्यसि॥64॥
1.8.m:
Become un-worshipped in the worlds for three kalpas, O father!
When three kalpas have elapsed, you will become worthy of worship by the venerable.

1.8.s:
adhunā yajñabhāgaste vratādiṣvapi suvrata ..
pūjanaṃ cāstu māmaikaṃ vandyo bhava surādibhiḥ .. 65 ..
1.8.d:
अधुना यज्ञभागस्ते व्रतादिष्वपि सुव्रत ॥
पूजनं चास्तु मामैकं वन्द्यो भव सुरादिभिः ॥ 65 ॥
1.8.m:
Now let your share of sacrifices and your part in observances and other rites remain, O you of noble vows,
and let worship be offered by me alone; be praiseworthy to the gods and others.”

1.8.s:
ityuktvā nāradastatra virarāma pituḥ puraḥ ..
tasthau sabhāyāṃ sa vidhirhṛdayena vidūyatā .. 66 ..
1.8.d:
इत्युक्त्वा नारदस्तत्र विरराम पितुः पुरः ॥
तस्थौ सभायां स विधिर्हृदयेन विदूयता ॥ 66 ॥
1.8.m:
Having spoken thus, Nārada fell silent before his father.
Brahmā remained in the assembly with an aching heart.

1.8.s:
upabarheṇa gandharvo nāradastena hetunā ..
dāsīputraśca śāpena pitureva ca śaunaka .. 67 ..
1.8.d:
उपबर्हेण गन्धर्वो नारदस्तेन हेतुना ॥
दासीपुत्रश्च शापेन पितुरेव च शौनक ॥ 67 ॥
1.8.m:
For that reason, Nārada became the Gandharva Upabarhaṇa,
and then the son of a maidservant, by the curse of his father alone, O Śaunaka.

1.8.s:
tataḥ punarnāradaśca sa babhūva mahānṛṣiḥ ..
jñānaṃ prāpya pituḥ paścātkathayiṣyāmi cādhunā .. 68 ..
1.8.d:
ततः पुनर्नारदश्च स बभूव महानृषिः ॥
ज्ञानं प्राप्य पितुः पश्चात्कथयिष्यामि चाधुना ॥ 68 ॥
1.8.m:
Then, once again, he became that great sage Nārada.
Having obtained knowledge from his father afterwards, I shall now narrate it.

1.9.s:
sautiruvāca ..
atha brahmā svaputrāṃstānādideśa ca sṛṣṭaye ..
sṛṣṭiṃ pracakruste sarve viprendra nāradaṃ vinā .. 1 ..
1.9.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
अथ ब्रह्मा स्वपुत्रांस्तानादिदेश च सृष्टये ॥
सृष्टिं प्रचक्रुस्ते सर्वे विप्रेन्द्र नारदं विना ॥ 1 ॥

1.9.s:
marīcermanaso jātaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ..
atrernetramalāccandraḥ kṣīrode ca babhūva ha .. 2 ..
1.9.d:
मरीचेर्मनसो जातः कश्यपश्च प्रजापतिः ॥
अत्रेर्नेत्रमलाच्चन्द्रः क्षीरोदे च बभूव ह ॥ 2 ॥

1.9.s:
pracetaso'pi manaso gautamaśca babhūva ha ..
pulastyamānasaḥ putro maitrāvaruṇa eva ca .. 3 ..
1.9.d:
प्रचेतसोऽपि मनसो गौतमश्च बभूव ह ॥
पुलस्त्यमानसः पुत्रो मैत्रावरुण एव च ॥ 3 ॥

1.9.s:
manośca śatarūpāyāṃ tisraḥ kanyāḥ prajajñire ..
ākūtirdevahūtiśca prasūtistāḥ pativratāḥ .. 4 ..
1.9.d:
मनोश्च शतरूपायां तिस्रः कन्याः प्रजज्ञिरे ॥
आकूतिर्देवहूतिश्च प्रसूतिस्ताः पतिव्रताः ॥ 4 ॥

1.9.s:
priyavratottānapādau dvau ca putrau manoharau ..
uttānapādatanayo dhruvaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ .. 5 ..
1.9.d:
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ द्वौ च पुत्रौ मनोहरौ ॥
उत्तानपादतनयो ध्रुवः परमधार्मिकः ॥ 5 ॥

1.9.s:
ākūtiṃ rucaye prādāddakṣāyātha prasūtikām ..
devahūtiṃ kardamāya yatputraḥ kapilaḥ svayam .. 6 ..
1.9.d:
आकूतिं रुचये प्रादाद्दक्षायाथ प्रसूतिकाम् ॥
देवहूतिं कर्दमाय यत्पुत्रः कपिलः स्वयम् ॥ 6 ॥

1.9.s:
prasūtyāṃ dakṣabījena ṣaṣṭikanyāḥ prajajñire ..
aṣṭau dharmāya sa dadau rudrāyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
1.9.d:
प्रसूत्यां दक्षबीजेन षष्टिकन्याः प्रजज्ञिरे ॥
अष्टौ धर्माय स ददौ रुद्रायैकादश स्मृताः ॥ 7 ॥

1.9.s:
śivāyaikāṃ satīṃ prādātkaśyapāya trayodaśa ..
saptaviṃśati kanyāśca dakṣaścandrāya dattavān .. 8 ..
1.9.d:
शिवायैकां सतीं प्रादात्कश्यपाय त्रयोदश ॥
सप्तविंशति कन्याश्च दक्षश्चन्द्राय दत्तवान् ॥ 8 ॥

1.9.s:
nāmāni dharmapatnīnāṃ matto vipra niśāmaya ..
śāntiḥ puṣṭirdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ kṣamā śraddhā matiḥ smṛtiḥ .. 9 ..
1.9.d:
नामानि धर्मपत्नीनां मत्तो विप्र निशामय ॥
शान्तिः पुष्टिर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः क्षमा श्रद्धा मतिः स्मृतिः ॥ 9 ॥

1.9.s:
śānteḥ putraśca santoṣaḥ puṣṭeḥ putro mahānabhūt ..
dhṛtedhairyyaṃ ca tuṣṭeśca harṣadarpau sutau smṛtau .. 1.9.10 ..
1.9.d:
शान्तेः पुत्रश्च सन्तोषः पुष्टेः पुत्रो महानभूत् ॥
धृतेधैर्य्यं च तुष्टेश्च हर्षदर्पौ सुतौ स्मृतौ ॥ 1.9.10 ॥

1.9.s:
kṣamāputraḥ sahiṣṇuśca śraddhāputraśca dhārmikaḥ ..
materjñānābhidhaḥ putraḥ smṛterjātismaro mahān .. 11 ..
1.9.d:
क्षमापुत्रः सहिष्णुश्च श्रद्धापुत्रश्च धार्मिकः ॥
मतेर्ज्ञानाभिधः पुत्रः स्मृतेर्जातिस्मरो महान् ॥ 11 ॥

1.9.s:
pūrvapatnyāṃ ca mūrtyāṃ ca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ..
babhūvurete dharmiṣṭhā dharmaputrāśca śaunaka .. 12 ..
1.9.d:
पूर्वपत्न्यां च मूर्त्यां च नरनारायणावृषी ॥
बभूवुरेते धर्मिष्ठा धर्मपुत्राश्च शौनक ॥ 12 ॥

1.9.s:
nāmāni rudrapatnīnāṃ sāvadhānaṃ nibodha me ..
kalā kalāvatī kāṣṭhā kālikā kalahapriyā .. 13 ..
1.9.d:
नामानि रुद्रपत्नीनां सावधानं निबोध मे ॥
कला कलावती काष्ठा कालिका कलहप्रिया ॥ 13 ॥

1.9.s:
kandalī bhīṣaṇā rāsnā pramocā bhūṣaṇā śukī ..
etāsāṃ bahavaḥ putrā babhūvuḥ śivapārṣadāḥ .. 14 ..
1.9.d:
कन्दली भीषणा रास्ना प्रमोचा भूषणा शुकी ॥
एतासां बहवः पुत्रा बभूवुः शिवपार्षदाः ॥ 14 ॥

1.9.s:
sā satī svāminindāyāṃ tanuṃ tatyāja yajñataḥ ..
punarbhūtvā śailaputrī lebhe sā śaṅkaraṃ patim .. 15 ..
1.9.d:
सा सती स्वामिनिन्दायां तनुं तत्याज यज्ञतः ॥
पुनर्भूत्वा शैलपुत्री लेभे सा शङ्करं पतिम् ॥ 15 ॥

1.9.s:
kaśyapasya priyāṇāṃ ca nāmāni śṛṇu dhārmika ..
aditirdevamātā vai daityamātā ditistathā..16..
1.9.d:
कश्यपस्य प्रियाणां च नामानि शृणु धार्मिक ॥
अदितिर्देवमाता वै दैत्यमाता दितिस्तथा॥16॥

1.9.s:
sarpamātā tathā kadrūrvinatā pakṣisūstathā ..
surabhiśca gavāṃ mātā mahiṣāṇāṃ ca niścitam .. 17 ..
1.9.d:
सर्पमाता तथा कद्रूर्विनता पक्षिसूस्तथा ॥
सुरभिश्च गवां माता महिषाणां च निश्चितम् ॥ 17 ॥

1.9.s:
sārameyādijantūnāṃ saramā sūścatuṣpadām ..
danuḥ prasūrdānavānāmanyāścetyevamādikāḥ .. 18 ..
1.9.d:
सारमेयादिजन्तूनां सरमा सूश्चतुष्पदाम् ॥
दनुः प्रसूर्दानवानामन्याश्चेत्येवमादिकाः ॥ 18 ॥

1.9.s:
indraśca dvādaśādityā upendrādyāḥ surā mune ..
kathitāścāditeḥ putrā mahābalaparākramāḥ..19..
1.9.d:
इन्द्रश्च द्वादशादित्या उपेन्द्राद्याः सुरा मुने ॥
कथिताश्चादितेः पुत्रा महाबलपराक्रमाः॥19॥

1.9.s:
indraputro jayantaśca brahmañśacyāmajāyata .. .
ādityasya savarṇāyāṃ kanyāyāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ..1.9.20..
1.9.d:
इन्द्रपुत्रो जयन्तश्च ब्रह्मञ्शच्यामजायत ॥ ।
आदित्यस्य सवर्णायां कन्यायां विश्वकर्मणः॥1.9.20॥

1.9.s:
śanaiścarayamau putrau kālindī kanyakā tathā ..
upeṃdravīryyātpṛthvyāṃ tu maṅgalaḥ samajāyata..21..
1.9.d:
शनैश्चरयमौ पुत्रौ कालिन्दी कन्यका तथा ॥
उपेंद्रवीर्य्यात्पृथ्व्यां तु मङ्गलः समजायत॥21॥

1.9.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kathaṃ saute sa copedrānmaṅgalaḥ samajāyata ..
vasundharāyāṃ balavāṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi ..22..
1.9.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
कथं सौते स चोपेद्रान्मङ्गलः समजायत ॥
वसुन्धरायां बलवांस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥22॥

1.9.s:
sautiruvāca ..
upendrarūpamālokya kāmārtā ca vasundharā ..
vidhāya sundarīveṣamakṣatā prauḍhayauvanā ..23..
1.9.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
उपेन्द्ररूपमालोक्य कामार्ता च वसुन्धरा ॥
विधाय सुन्दरीवेषमक्षता प्रौढयौवना ॥23॥

1.9.s:
malaye nirjane ramye cārucandanapallave ..
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam..24..
1.9.d:
मलये निर्जने रम्ये चारुचन्दनपल्लवे ॥
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं रत्नभूषणभूषितम्॥24॥

1.9.s:
taṃ suśīlaṃ śayānaṃ ca śāntaṃ sasmitamīpsitam ..
sasmitā tasya talpe ca sahasā samupasthitā..25..
1.9.d:
तं सुशीलं शयानं च शान्तं सस्मितमीप्सितम् ॥
सस्मिता तस्य तल्पे च सहसा समुपस्थिता॥25॥

1.9.s:
suramyāṃ mālatīmālāṃ dadau tasmai varānanā ..
sugandhi candanaṃ cāru kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ..26..
1.9.d:
सुरम्यां मालतीमालां ददौ तस्मै वरानना ॥
सुगन्धि चन्दनं चारु कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितम् ॥26॥

1.9.s:
upendrastanmano jñātvā kāminīṃ kāmapīḍitām ..
nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra ca tayā saha .. 27 ..
1.9.d:
उपेन्द्रस्तन्मनो ज्ञात्वा कामिनीं कामपीडिताम् ॥
नानाप्रकारशृङ्गारं चकार च तया सह ॥ 27 ॥

1.9.s:
tadaṅgasaṅgasaṃsaktā mūrchāṃ prāpa satī tadā ..
mṛteva nidritevāsau bījādhānaṃ kṛte harau .. 28 ..
1.9.d:
तदङ्गसङ्गसंसक्ता मूर्छां प्राप सती तदा ॥
मृतेव निद्रितेवासौ बीजाधानं कृते हरौ ॥ 28 ॥

1.9.s:
tāṃ vilagnāṃ ca suśroṇīṃ sukhasambhogamūrchitām ..
bṛhanmuktanitambāṃ ca sa smitāṃ vipulastanīm .. 29 ..
1.9.d:
तां विलग्नां च सुश्रोणीं सुखसम्भोगमूर्छिताम् ॥
बृहन्मुक्तनितम्बां च स स्मितां विपुलस्तनीम् ॥ 29 ॥

1.9.s:
kṣaṇaṃ vakṣasi kṛtvā tāṃ tadoṣṭhaṃ ca cucumba ha ..
vihāya tatra rahasi jagāma puruṣottamaḥ .. 1.9.30 ..
1.9.d:
क्षणं वक्षसि कृत्वा तां तदोष्ठं च चुचुम्ब ह ॥
विहाय तत्र रहसि जगाम पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ 1.9.30 ॥

1.9.s:
urvaśī pathi gacchantī bodhayāmāsa tāṃ mune ..
sā ca papraccha vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa bhūśca tām.. 31 ..
1.9.d:
उर्वशी पथि गच्छन्ती बोधयामास तां मुने ॥
सा च पप्रच्छ वृत्तान्तं कथयामास भूश्च ताम्॥ 31 ॥

1.9.s:
vīryyasaṃvaraṇaṃ kartuṃ sā cāśaktā ca durbalā ..
pravālasyākare trastā vīryyanyāsaṃ cakāra sā .. 32 ..
1.9.d:
वीर्य्यसंवरणं कर्तुं सा चाशक्ता च दुर्बला ॥
प्रवालस्याकरे त्रस्ता वीर्य्यन्यासं चकार सा ॥ 32 ॥

1.9.s:
tena pravālavarṇaśca kumāraḥ samapadyata ..
tejasā sūryyasadṛśo nārāyaṇa suto mahān .. 33 ..
1.9.d:
तेन प्रवालवर्णश्च कुमारः समपद्यत ॥
तेजसा सूर्य्यसदृशो नारायण सुतो महान् ॥ 33 ॥

1.9.s:
maṅgalasya priyā medhā tasya ghaṇṭeśvaro mahān..
vraṇadātā'titejasvī viṣṇutulyo babhūva ha ..34..
1.9.d:
मङ्गलस्य प्रिया मेधा तस्य घण्टेश्वरो महान्॥
व्रणदाताऽतितेजस्वी विष्णुतुल्यो बभूव ह ॥34॥

1.9.s:
diterhiraṇyakaśipuhiraṇyākṣau mahābalau ..
kanyā ca siṃhikā vipra saiṃhikeyaśca tatsutaḥ ..35..
1.9.d:
दितेर्हिरण्यकशिपुहिरण्याक्षौ महाबलौ ॥
कन्या च सिंहिका विप्र सैंहिकेयश्च तत्सुतः ॥35॥

1.9.s:
nirṛtiḥ siṃhikā sā ca tena rāhuśca nairṛtaḥ..
sūkareṇa hiraṇyākṣo'pyanapatyo mṛto yuvā .. 36 ..
1.9.d:
निरृतिः सिंहिका सा च तेन राहुश्च नैरृतः॥
सूकरेण हिरण्याक्षोऽप्यनपत्यो मृतो युवा ॥ 36 ॥

1.9.s:
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrādo vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ..
virocanaśca tatputrastatputraśca baliḥ svayam .. 37..
1.9.d:
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रः प्रह्रादो वैष्णवाग्रणीः ॥
विरोचनश्च तत्पुत्रस्तत्पुत्रश्च बलिः स्वयम् ॥ 37॥

1.9.s:
baleḥ putro mahāyogī jñānī śaṅkarakiṃkaraḥ ..
ditervaṃśaśca kathitaḥ kadrūvaṃśaṃ nibodha me .. 38 ..
1.9.d:
बलेः पुत्रो महायोगी ज्ञानी शङ्करकिंकरः ॥
दितेर्वंशश्च कथितः कद्रूवंशं निबोध मे ॥ 38 ॥

1.9.s:
anantaṃ vāsukiṃ caiva kālīyaṃ ca dhanañjayam ..
karkoṭakaṃ takṣakaṃ ca padmamairāvataṃ tathā .. 39 ..
1.9.d:
अनन्तं वासुकिं चैव कालीयं च धनञ्जयम् ॥
कर्कोटकं तक्षकं च पद्ममैरावतं तथा ॥ 39 ॥

1.9.s:
mahāpadmaṃ ca śaṃkuṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ tathā ..
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca durddharṣaṃ durjayaṃ durmukhaṃ balam .. 1.9.40 ..
1.9.d:
महापद्मं च शंकुं च शंखं संवरणं तथा ॥
धृतराष्ट्रं च दुर्द्धर्षं दुर्जयं दुर्मुखं बलम् ॥ 1.9.40 ॥

1.9.s:
gokṣaṃ gokārmukaṃ caiva virūpādīṃśca śaunaka ..
na teṣāṃ pravarāścaiva yāvatyaḥ sarpajātayaḥ .. 41 ..
1.9.d:
गोक्षं गोकार्मुकं चैव विरूपादींश्च शौनक ॥
न तेषां प्रवराश्चैव यावत्यः सर्पजातयः ॥ 41 ॥

1.9.s:
kanyakā manasā devī kamalāṃśasamudbhavā ..
tapasvinīnāṃ pravarā mahātejasvinī śubhā .. 42 ..
1.9.d:
कन्यका मनसा देवी कमलांशसमुद्भवा ॥
तपस्विनीनां प्रवरा महातेजस्विनी शुभा ॥ 42 ॥

1.9.s:
yatpatiśca jaratkārurnārāyaṇakulodbhavaḥ ..
āstīkastanayo yasyā viṣṇutulyaśca tejasā .. 43 ..
1.9.d:
यत्पतिश्च जरत्कारुर्नारायणकुलोद्भवः ॥
आस्तीकस्तनयो यस्या विष्णुतुल्यश्च तेजसा ॥ 43 ॥

1.9.s:
eteṣāṃ nāmamātreṇa nāsti nāgabhayaṃ nṛṇām ..
kadrūvaṃśo nigadito vinatāyāḥ śṛṇuṣva me .. 44 ..
1.9.d:
एतेषां नाममात्रेण नास्ति नागभयं नृणाम् ॥
कद्रूवंशो निगदितो विनतायाः शृणुष्व मे ॥ 44 ॥

1.9.s:
vainateyāruṇau putrau viṣṇutulyaparākramau ..
tau babhūvuḥ krameṇaiva yāvatyaḥ pakṣijātayaḥ .. 45 ..
1.9.d:
वैनतेयारुणौ पुत्रौ विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमौ ॥
तौ बभूवुः क्रमेणैव यावत्यः पक्षिजातयः ॥ 45 ॥

1.9.s:
gāvaśca mahiṣāścaiva surabhipravarā ime ..
sarve vai sārameyāśca babhūvuḥ saramāsutāḥ .. ..46 ..
1.9.d:
गावश्च महिषाश्चैव सुरभिप्रवरा इमे ॥
सर्वे वै सारमेयाश्च बभूवुः सरमासुताः ॥ ॥46 ॥

1.9.s:
dānavāśca danorvaṃśā anyāssāmānyajātayaḥ ..
uktaḥ kaśyapavaṃśaśca candrākhyānaṃ nibodha me .. 47 ..
1.9.d:
दानवाश्च दनोर्वंशा अन्यास्सामान्यजातयः ॥
उक्तः कश्यपवंशश्च चन्द्राख्यानं निबोध मे ॥ 47 ॥

1.9.s:
nāmāni candrapatnīnāṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ..
atyapūrvaṃ ca caritaṃ purāṇeṣu purātanam .. 48 ..
1.9.d:
नामानि चन्द्रपत्नीनां सावधानं निशामय ॥
अत्यपूर्वं च चरितं पुराणेषु पुरातनम् ॥ 48 ॥

1.9.s:
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā ..
mṛgaśīrṣā tathā''rdrā ca pūjyā sādhvī punarvasuḥ .. 49 ..
1.9.d:
अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिका रोहिणी तथा ॥
मृगशीर्षा तथा'ऽर्द्रा च पूज्या साध्वी पुनर्वसुः ॥ 49 ॥
1.9.m: Mṛgaśīrṣā, Ārdrā, and the venerable, virtuous Punarvasu,

1.9.s:
puṣyā''śleṣā maghā pūrvaphalgunyuttaraphalgunī ..
hastā citrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā .. 1.9.50 ..
1.9.d:
पुष्या'ऽश्लेषा मघा पूर्वफल्गुन्युत्तरफल्गुनी ॥
हस्ता चित्रा तथा स्वाती विशाखा चानुराधिका ॥ 1.9.50 ॥
1.9.m:
Puṣyā, Āśleṣā, Maghā, Pūrvaphalgunī, Uttaraphalgunī,
Hastā, Citrā, Svātī, Viśākhā, Anurādhā,

1.9.s:
jyeṣṭhā mūlā tathā pūrvā''ṣāḍhā caivottarā smṛtā ..
śravaṇā ca dhaniṣṭhā ca tathā śatabhiṣak śubhā .. 51 ..
1.9.d:
ज्येष्ठा मूला तथा पूर्वा'ऽषाढा चैवोत्तरा स्मृता ॥
श्रवणा च धनिष्ठा च तथा शतभिषक् शुभा ॥ 51 ॥
1.9.m:
Jyeṣṭhā, Mūlā, Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Uttarāṣāḍhā,
Śravaṇā, Dhaniṣṭhā, and the auspicious Śatabhiṣak,

1.9.s:
pūrvā bhādrottarābhādrā revatyantā vidhupriyāḥ ..
tāsāṃ madhye ca subhagā rohiṇī rasikā varā .. 52 ..
1.9.d:
पूर्वा भाद्रोत्तराभाद्रा रेवत्यन्ता विधुप्रियाः ॥
तासां मध्ये च सुभगा रोहिणी रसिका वरा ॥ 52 ॥
1.9.m:
Pūrvabhādrapadā, Uttarabhādrapadā, and ending with Revatī—these are the beloved wives of the Moon.
Among them, fortunate Rohiṇī was charming and the best;

1.9.s:
santataṃ rasabhāvena cakāra śaśinaṃ vaśam ..
rohiṇyupagataścandro na yātyanyāṃ ca kāminīm .. 53 ..
1.9.d:
सन्ततं रसभावेन चकार शशिनं वशम् ॥
रोहिण्युपगतश्चन्द्रो न यात्यन्यां च कामिनीम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.9.m:
by her constant loving passion she brought the Moon under her control.
Having approached Rohiṇī, the Moon would go to no other beloved woman.

1.9.s:
sarvā bhaginyaḥ pitaraṃ kathayāmāsurādṛtāḥ ..
sapatnīkṛtasantāpaṃ prāṇanāśakaraṃ param .. 54 ..
1.9.d:
सर्वा भगिन्यः पितरं कथयामासुरादृताः ॥
सपत्नीकृतसन्तापं प्राणनाशकरं परम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.9.m:
Respectfully, all her sisters told their father
of the torment caused by their co-wife, which was completely destructive of their life.

1.9.s:
dakṣaḥ prakupitaścandramaśapanmantrapūrvakam ..
drutaṃ śvaśuraśāpena yakṣmagrasto babhūva saḥ .. 55 ..
1.9.d:
दक्षः प्रकुपितश्चन्द्रमशपन्मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ॥
द्रुतं श्वशुरशापेन यक्ष्मग्रस्तो बभूव सः ॥ 55 ॥
1.9.m:
Enraged, Dakṣa cursed the Moon with incantations;
swiftly, by the curse of his father-in-law, he was seized by consumption.

1.9.s:
dine dine yakṣmaṇā sa kṣīyamāṇaśca duḥkhitaḥ ..
vapuṣyarddhaṃ kṣīyamāṇe śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 56 ..
1.9.d:
दिने दिने यक्ष्मणा स क्षीयमाणश्च दुःखितः ॥
वपुष्यर्द्धं क्षीयमाणे शंकरं शरणं ययौ ॥ 56 ॥
1.9.m:
Wasting away day by day from consumption, he became sorrowful;
when half his body had wasted away, he went to Śaṅkara for refuge.

1.9.s:
dṛṣṭvā candraṃ śaṃkaraśca kleśitaṃ śaraṇāgatam ..
karuṇāsāgarastasmai kṛpayā cābhayaṃ dadau .. 57 ..
1.9.d:
दृष्ट्वा चन्द्रं शंकरश्च क्लेशितं शरणागतम् ॥
करुणासागरस्तस्मै कृपया चाभयं ददौ ॥ 57 ॥
1.9.m:
Seeing the Moon distressed and come for refuge,
Śaṅkara, an ocean of compassion, mercifully granted him safety from fear.

1.9.s:
nirmuktaṃ yakṣmaṇā kṛtvā svakapole sthalaṃ dadau ..
amaro nirbhayo bhūtvā sa tasthau śivaśekhare .. 58 ..
1.9.d:
निर्मुक्तं यक्ष्मणा कृत्वा स्वकपोले स्थलं ददौ ॥
अमरो निर्भयो भूत्वा स तस्थौ शिवशेखरे ॥ 58 ॥
1.9.m:
Having freed him from consumption, he gave him a place upon his own cheek;
having become immortal and fearless, he remained upon Śiva’s crest.

1.9.s:
taṃ śivaḥ śekhare kṛtvā cābhavaccandraśekharaḥ ..
nāsti deveṣu lokeṣu śivāccharaṇapaṃjaraḥ .. 59 ..
1.9.d:
तं शिवः शेखरे कृत्वा चाभवच्चन्द्रशेखरः ॥
नास्ति देवेषु लोकेषु शिवाच्छरणपंजरः ॥ 59 ॥
1.9.m:
Placing him upon his crest, Śiva became Candraśekhara;
among the gods in all the worlds, there is no cage of refuge like Śiva.

1.9.s:
dakṣakanyāḥ patiṃ muktaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca ruruduḥ punaḥ ..
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ tātaṃ dakṣaṃ tejasvināṃ varam .. 1.9.60..
1.9.d:
दक्षकन्याः पतिं मुक्तं दृष्ट्वा च रुरुदुः पुनः ॥
आजग्मुः शरणं तातं दक्षं तेजस्विनां वरम् ॥ 1.9.60॥
1.9.m:
Seeing their husband freed [from the curse], the daughters of Dakṣa wept again;
they went for refuge to their father Dakṣa, the best among the radiant.

1.9.s:
uccaiśca rurudurgatvā nihatyāṅgaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ..
tamūcuḥ kātaraṃ dīnā dīnanāthaṃ vidheḥ sutam .. 61 ..
1.9.d:
उच्चैश्च रुरुदुर्गत्वा निहत्याङ्गं पुनः पुनः ॥
तमूचुः कातरं दीना दीननाथं विधेः सुतम् ॥ 61 ॥
1.9.m:
Having gone, they wept loudly, striking their limbs again and again.
Miserable and agitated, they spoke to the son of Brahmā, the protector of the helpless.

1.9.s:
dakṣakanyā ūcuḥ ..
svāmisaubhāgyalābhāya tvamukto'smābhireva ca ..
saubhāgyamastu nastāta gataḥ svāmī guṇānvitaḥ .. 62 ..
1.9.d:
दक्षकन्या ऊचुः ॥
स्वामिसौभाग्यलाभाय त्वमुक्तोऽस्माभिरेव च ॥
सौभाग्यमस्तु नस्तात गतः स्वामी गुणान्वितः ॥ 62 ॥
1.9.m:
"Indeed, you were addressed by us to obtain good fortune with our husband.
Let good fortune be ours, O father; our virtuous husband is gone!

1.9.s:
sthite cakṣuṣi he tāta dṛṣṭaṃ dhvāntamayaṃ jagat ..
vijñātamadhunā strīṇāṃ patireva hi locanam .. 63 ..
1.9.d:
स्थिते चक्षुषि हे तात दृष्टं ध्वान्तमयं जगत् ॥
विज्ञातमधुना स्त्रीणां पतिरेव हि लोचनम् ॥ 63 ॥
1.9.m:
Even while having eyes, O father, the world is seen as full of darkness;
now it is understood that the husband alone is the eye of women!

1.9.s:
patireva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ patiḥ prāṇāśca sampadaḥ ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ hetuḥ seturbhavārṇave .. 64 ..
1.9.d:
पतिरेव गतिः स्त्रीणां पतिः प्राणाश्च सम्पदः ॥
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां हेतुः सेतुर्भवार्णवे ॥ 64 ॥
1.9.m:
The husband alone is the refuge of women; the husband is life and riches;
he is the cause of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, a bridge over the ocean of worldly existence.

1.9.s:
patirnārāyaṇaḥ strīṇāṃ vrataṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
sarvaṃ karma vṛthā tāsāṃ svāmināṃ vimukhāśca yāḥ .. 65 ..
1.9.d:
पतिर्नारायणः स्त्रीणां व्रतं धर्मः सनातनः ॥
सर्वं कर्म वृथा तासां स्वामिनां विमुखाश्च याः ॥ 65 ॥
1.9.m:
The husband is Nārāyaṇa for women, their vow and eternal duty;
all the deeds of those who are turned away from their husbands are in vain.

1.9.s:
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇā ..
sarvadānāni puṇyāni vratāni niyamāśca ye .. 66 ..
1.9.d:
स्नानं च सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दक्षिणा ॥
सर्वदानानि पुण्यानि व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये ॥ 66 ॥
1.9.m: all pious gifts, vows, and observances that exist,

1.9.s:
devārcanaṃ cānaśanaṃ sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi ca ..
svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm .. 67 ..
1.9.d:
देवार्चनं चानशनं सर्वाणि च तपांसि च ॥
स्वामिनः पादसेवायाः कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥ 67 ॥
1.9.m:
worship of the gods, fasting, and all austerities—
they are not worth a sixteenth part of serving the husband's feet.

1.9.s:
sarveṣāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca priyaḥ putraśca yoṣitām ..
sa eva svāminoṃ'śaśca śataputrātparaḥ patiḥ .. 68 ..
1.9.d:
सर्वेषां बान्धवानां च प्रियः पुत्रश्च योषिताम् ॥
स एव स्वामिनोंऽशश्च शतपुत्रात्परः पतिः ॥ 68 ॥
1.9.m:
Among all relatives, a son is dear to women;
he is indeed a portion of the husband, and the husband is greater than a hundred sons.

1.9.s:
asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā sā dveṣṭi svāminaṃ sadā ..
yasyā manaścalaṃ duṣṭaṃ santataṃ parapūruṣe .. 69 ..
1.9.d:
असद्वंशप्रसूता या सा द्वेष्टि स्वामिनं सदा ॥
यस्या मनश्चलं दुष्टं सन्ततं परपूरुषे ॥ 69 ॥
1.9.m:
She who is born of a low family constantly hates her husband,
she whose mind is fickle and wicked, continually fixed on another man.

1.9.s:
patitaṃ rogiṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ nirdhanaṃ guṇahīnakam ..
yuvānaṃ caiva vṛddhaṃ vā bhajettaṃ na tyajetsatī .. 1.9.70 ..
1.9.d:
पतितं रोगिणं दुष्टं निर्धनं गुणहीनकम् ॥
युवानं चैव वृद्धं वा भजेत्तं न त्यजेत्सती ॥ 1.9.70 ॥
1.9.m:
Fallen, diseased, wicked, destitute, devoid of virtues,
young or old—a virtuous wife should serve him and not abandon him.

1.9.s:
saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāpi dveṣṭi yā saṃtyajetpatim ..
pacyate kālasūtre sā yāvaccaṃdradivākarau .. 71 ..
1.9.d:
सगुणं निर्गुणं वापि द्वेष्टि या संत्यजेत्पतिम् ॥
पच्यते कालसूत्रे सा यावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 71 ॥
1.9.m:
She who, whether he has virtues or lacks them, hates and abandons her husband,
is cooked in Kālasūtra as long as the moon and sun endure.

1.9.s:
kīṭaiḥ śunakatulyaiśca bhakṣitā sā divāniśam ..
bhuṅkte mṛtavasāmāṃsaṃ pibenmūtraṃ ca tṛṣṇayā .. 72 ..
1.9.d:
कीटैः शुनकतुल्यैश्च भक्षिता सा दिवानिशम् ॥
भुङ्क्ते मृतवसामांसं पिबेन्मूत्रं च तृष्णया ॥ 72 ॥
1.9.m:
Devoured day and night by worms resembling dogs,
she eats fat and flesh of corpses and drinks urine out of thirst.

1.9.s:
gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ..
śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni sā bhavedbandhuhā tataḥ .. 73 ..
1.9.d:
गृध्रः कोटिसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि सूकरः ॥
श्वापदः शतजन्मानि सा भवेद्बन्धुहा ततः ॥ 73 ॥
1.9.m: a beast of prey for a hundred births, and then a slayer of relatives.

1.9.s:
tato mānavajanmāni labheccetpūrvakarmaṇaḥ ..
vidhavā dhanahīnā ca rogayuktā bhaved dhruvam .. 74 ..
1.9.d:
ततो मानवजन्मानि लभेच्चेत्पूर्वकर्मणः ॥
विधवा धनहीना च रोगयुक्ता भवेद् ध्रुवम् ॥ 74 ॥
1.9.m:
If she then attains human births due to her past karma,
she certainly becomes a widow, destitute, and afflicted with disease.

1.9.s:
dehi naḥ kāntadānaṃ ca kāmapūraṃ vidheḥ suta ..
vidhātrā sadṛśastvaṃ ca punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ kṣamo jagat .. 75 ..
1.9.d:
देहि नः कान्तदानं च कामपूरं विधेः सुत ॥
विधात्रा सदृशस्त्वं च पुनः स्रष्टुं क्षमो जगत् ॥ 75 ॥
1.9.m:
Give us the gift of our beloved, which fulfills our desires, O son of Brahmā!
You are equal to the Creator, capable of creating the world anew!"

1.9.s:
kanyānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ śaṃkarasannidhim ..
jagāma śambhustaṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya nanāma ca .. 76 ..
1.9.d:
कन्यानां वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षः शंकरसन्निधिम् ॥
जगाम शम्भुस्तं दृष्ट्वा समुत्थाय ननाम च ॥ 76 ॥
1.9.m:
Having heard the words of his daughters, Dakṣa went into the presence of Śaṅkara.
Seeing him, Śambhu stood up and bowed down.

1.9.s:
dakṣastasyāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāca kṛpānidhim ..
tatyāja kopaṃ durddhaṣo dṛṣṭvā ca praṇataṃ śivam .. 77 ..
1.9.d:
दक्षस्तस्याशिषं कृत्वा समुवाच कृपानिधिम् ॥
तत्याज कोपं दुर्द्धषो दृष्ट्वा च प्रणतं शिवम् ॥ 77 ॥
1.9.m:
Dakṣa, giving him a blessing, addressed that treasure of mercy;
seeing Śiva bowed down, the fierce one relinquished his anger.

1.9.s:
dakṣa uvāca ..
dehi jāmātaraṃ śambho madīyaṃ prāṇavallabham ..
matsutānāṃ ca prāṇānāṃ parameva priyaṃ patim .. 78 ..
1.9.d:
दक्ष उवाच ॥
देहि जामातरं शम्भो मदीयं प्राणवल्लभम् ॥
मत्सुतानां च प्राणानां परमेव प्रियं पतिम् ॥ 78 ॥
1.9.m:
"Give back my son-in-law, O Śambhu, who is dear to my life,
the exceedingly dear husband of my daughters, who is their very breath!

1.9.s:
na ceddadāsi jāmātarmama jāmātaraṃ vidhum ..
dāsyāmi dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ tubhyaṃ tvaṃ kena mucyase .. 79 ..
1.9.d:
न चेद्ददासि जामातर्मम जामातरं विधुम् ॥
दास्यामि दारुणं शापं तुभ्यं त्वं केन मुच्यसे ॥ 79 ॥
1.9.m:
If you do not give the moon, my son-in-law, O son-in-law,
I will cast a dreadful curse upon you! By whom would you then be released?"

1.9.s:
dakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
sudhādhikaṃ ca vacanaṃ brahmañśaraṇapañjaraḥ .. 1.9.80 ..
1.9.d:
दक्षस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच कृपानिधिः ॥
सुधाधिकं च वचनं ब्रह्मञ्शरणपञ्जरः ॥ 1.9.80 ॥
1.9.m:
Hearing Dakṣa's words, that treasure of mercy,
the cage of refuge, spoke words sweeter than nectar, O Brahmin.

1.9.s:
śiva uvāca ..
karoṣi bhasmasāccenmāṃ dadyā vā śāpameva ca ..
nāhaṃ dātuṃ samarthaśca candraṃ ca śaraṇāgatam .. 81 ..
1.9.d:
शिव उवाच ॥
करोषि भस्मसाच्चेन्मां दद्या वा शापमेव च ॥
नाहं दातुं समर्थश्च चन्द्रं च शरणागतम् ॥ 81 ॥
1.9.m:
"Even if you turn me to ashes or pronounce a curse,
I am not able to give up the moon who has come to me for refuge."

1.9.s:
śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣastaṃ śaptumudyataḥ ..
śivaḥ sasmāra govindaṃ vipanmokṣaṇakārakam .. 82 ..
1.9.d:
शिवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षस्तं शप्तुमुद्यतः ॥
शिवः सस्मार गोविन्दं विपन्मोक्षणकारकम् ॥ 82 ॥
1.9.m:
Hearing Śiva's words, Dakṣa was prepared to curse him;
Śiva remembered Govinda, who brings release from misfortune.

1.9.s:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇo vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk..
samāyayau tayormūlaṃ tau taṃ ca namatuḥ kramāt .. 83 ..
1.9.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णो वृद्धब्राह्मणरूपधृक्॥
समाययौ तयोर्मूलं तौ तं च नमतुः क्रमात् ॥ 83 ॥
1.9.m:
In the meantime, Kṛṣṇa, assuming the form of an old Brahmin,
came near the two of them, and they both bowed to him in turn.

1.9.s:
dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau sa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanaḥ ..
uvāca śaṅkaraṃ pūrvaṃ paripūrṇatamo dvija .. 84 ..
1.9.d:
दत्त्वा शुभाशिषं तौ स ब्रह्मज्योतिः सनातनः ॥
उवाच शङ्करं पूर्वं परिपूर्णतमो द्विज ॥ 84 ॥
1.9.m:
Having bestowed auspicious blessings upon the two, he, the eternal light of Brahman,
the most complete one, first addressed Śaṅkara, O Brahmin.

1.9.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
na cātmanaḥ priyaḥ kaściccharva sarveṣu bandhuṣu ..
ātmānaṃ rakṣa dakṣāya dehi candraṃ sureśvara .. 85 ..
1.9.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥
न चात्मनः प्रियः कश्चिच्छर्व सर्वेषु बन्धुषु ॥
आत्मानं रक्ष दक्षाय देहि चन्द्रं सुरेश्वर ॥ 85 ॥
1.9.m:
"Among all relatives, none is dearer than oneself, O Śarva;
protect yourself, O lord of gods, and surrender the moon to Dakṣa!

1.9.s:
tapasvināṃ varaḥ śāntastvamevaṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ..
samaḥ sarveṣu jīveṣu hiṃsākrodhavivarjitaḥ .. 86 ..
1.9.d:
तपस्विनां वरः शान्तस्त्वमेवं वैष्णवाग्रणीः ॥
समः सर्वेषु जीवेषु हिंसाक्रोधविवर्जितः ॥ 86 ॥
1.9.m:
You are the best of ascetics, peaceful, the foremost among the Vaiṣṇavas,
impartial toward all living beings, free from injury and anger.

1.9.s:
dakṣaḥ krodhī ca durddharṣastejasvī brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ..
śiṣṭo bibheti durddharṣaṃ na durddharṣaśca kaṃcana .. 87 ..
1.9.d:
दक्षः क्रोधी च दुर्द्धर्षस्तेजस्वी ब्रह्मणः सुतः ॥
शिष्टो बिभेति दुर्द्धर्षं न दुर्द्धर्षश्च कंचन ॥ 87 ॥
1.9.m:
Dakṣa is wrathful, unassailable, splendid, the son of Brahmā;
the well-mannered person fears the unassailable, but the unassailable one fears nobody."

1.9.s:
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hasitvā śaṅkaraḥ svayam ..
uvāca nītisāraṃ ca nītibījaṃ parātparam .. 88 ..
1.9.d:
नारायणवचः श्रुत्वा हसित्वा शङ्करः स्वयम् ॥
उवाच नीतिसारं च नीतिबीजं परात्परम् ॥ 88 ॥
1.9.m:
Hearing Nārāyaṇa's words, Śaṅkara smiled
and spoke the essence of moral conduct, the seed of ethics, higher than the highest.

1.9.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
tapo dāsyāmi tejaśca sarvasiddhiṃ ca sampadam ..
prāṇāṃśca na samartho'haṃ pradātuṃ śaraṇāgatam .. 89 ..
1.9.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
तपो दास्यामि तेजश्च सर्वसिद्धिं च सम्पदम् ॥
प्राणांश्च न समर्थोऽहं प्रदातुं शरणागतम् ॥ 89 ॥
1.9.m:
"I will give up austerities, splendour, all supernormal powers, and wealth,
and my very life, but I am not able to give up one who has sought refuge!"

1.9.s:
yo dadāti bhayenaiva prapannaṃ śaraṇāgatam ..
taṃ ca dharmaḥ parityajya yāti śaptvā sudāruṇam .. 1.9.90 ..
1.9.d:
यो ददाति भयेनैव प्रपन्नं शरणागतम् ॥
तं च धर्मः परित्यज्य याति शप्त्वा सुदारुणम् ॥ 1.9.90 ॥
1.9.m:
Whoever, purely out of fear, gives up one who has approached him for shelter,
Dharma abandons him, and departs after having uttered a terrible curse.

1.9.s:
sarvaṃ tyaktuṃ samartho'haṃ na svadharmaṃ jagatprabho ..
yaḥ svadharmavihīnaśca sa ca sarvabahiṣkṛtaḥ .. 91 ..
1.9.d:
सर्वं त्यक्तुं समर्थोऽहं न स्वधर्मं जगत्प्रभो ॥
यः स्वधर्मविहीनश्च स च सर्वबहिष्कृतः ॥ 91 ॥
1.9.m:
I am able to abandon everything, O Lord of the universe, but not my own duty.
And he who is devoid of his own duty is an outcast from everything.

1.9.s:
yaśca dharmaṃ sadā rakṣeddharmastaṃ parirakṣati ..
dharmaṃ vedeśvara tvaṃ ca kiṃ māṃ brūhi svamāyayā .. 92 ..
1.9.d:
यश्च धर्मं सदा रक्षेद्धर्मस्तं परिरक्षति ॥
धर्मं वेदेश्वर त्वं च किं मां ब्रूहि स्वमायया ॥ 92 ॥
1.9.m:
And whoever always protects Dharma, Dharma protects him.
You are Dharma, O Lord of the Vedas; why do you speak to me through your māyā?

1.9.s:
tvaṃ sarvamātā sraṣṭā ca hantā ca pariṇāmataḥ ..
tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā yasya tasya kasmādbhayaṃ bhavet .. 93 ..
1.9.d:
त्वं सर्वमाता स्रष्टा च हन्ता च परिणामतः ॥
त्वयि भक्तिर्दृढा यस्य तस्य कस्माद्भयं भवेत् ॥ 93 ॥
1.9.m:
You are the mother of all, the creator, and the destroyer in the end;
from where can fear come to him whose devotion to you is steadfast?

1.9.s:
śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvabhāvavit ..
candraṃ candrādviniṣkṛṣya dakṣāya pradadau hariḥ .. 94 ..
1.9.d:
शङ्करस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्सर्वभाववित् ॥
चन्द्रं चन्द्राद्विनिष्कृष्य दक्षाय प्रददौ हरिः ॥ 94 ॥
1.9.m:
Having heard the words of Śaṅkara, the Blessed Lord, who knows all inner states,
Hari, having drawn out a moon from the moon, gave it to Dakṣa.

1.9.s:
pratasthāvarddhacandraśca nirvyādhiḥ śivaśekhare ..
nijagrāha paraṃ candraṃ viṣṇudattaṃ prajāpatiḥ .. 95 ..
1.9.d:
प्रतस्थावर्द्धचन्द्रश्च निर्व्याधिः शिवशेखरे ॥
निजग्राह परं चन्द्रं विष्णुदत्तं प्रजापतिः ॥ 95 ॥
1.9.m:
And a crescent moon, free from disease, remained on Śiva's crest;
the Prajāpati accepted the other moon given by Viṣṇu.

1.9.s:
yakṣmagrastaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā dakṣastuṣṭāva mādhavam ..
pakṣe pūrṇaṃ kṣataṃ pakṣe taṃ cakāra hariḥ svayam .. 96 ..
1.9.d:
यक्ष्मग्रस्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा दक्षस्तुष्टाव माधवम् ॥
पक्षे पूर्णं क्षतं पक्षे तं चकार हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 96 ॥
1.9.m:
And seeing him afflicted with consumption, Dakṣa praised Mādhava;
Hari himself made him full during one fortnight, and waning during the other fortnight.

1.9.s:
kṛṣṇastebhyo varaṃ dattvā jagāma svālayaṃ dvija ..
dakṣaścandraṃ gṛhītvā ca kanyābhyaḥ pradadau punaḥ .. 97 ..
1.9.d:
कृष्णस्तेभ्यो वरं दत्त्वा जगाम स्वालयं द्विज ॥
दक्षश्चन्द्रं गृहीत्वा च कन्याभ्यः प्रददौ पुनः ॥ 97 ॥
1.9.m:
Kṛṣṇa, having granted a boon to them, went to his own abode, O twice-born;
and Dakṣa, taking the moon, gave him once more to his daughters.

1.9.s:
candrastāśca pariprāpya vijahāra divāniśam ..
samaṃ dadarśa tāḥ sarvāstatprabhṛtyeva kampitaḥ .. 98 ..
1.9.d:
चन्द्रस्ताश्च परिप्राप्य विजहार दिवानिशम् ॥
समं ददर्श ताः सर्वास्तत्प्रभृत्येव कम्पितः ॥ 98 ॥
1.9.m:
The moon, having obtained them, sported day and night;
trembling ever since that time, he regarded all of them equally.

1.9.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiñcitsṛṣṭikramaṃ mune ..
śrutaṃ ca guruvaktreṇa puṣkare munisaṃsadi .. 99 ..
1.9.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं किञ्चित्सृष्टिक्रमं मुने ॥
श्रुतं च गुरुवक्त्रेण पुष्करे मुनिसंसदि ॥ 99 ॥
1.9.m:
Thus has the entire order of creation been briefly narrated, O sage;
and it was heard from the mouth of the guru at Puṣkara in an assembly of sages.

1.10.s:
sautiruvāca ..
bhṛgoḥ putraśca cyavanaḥ śukraśca jñānināṃ vara ..
kratorapi kriyā bhāryyā vālakhilyānasūyata .. 1 ..
1.10.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
भृगोः पुत्रश्च च्यवनः शुक्रश्च ज्ञानिनां वर ॥
क्रतोरपि क्रिया भार्य्या वालखिल्यानसूयत ॥ 1 ॥
1.10.m:
Sauti said:
Cyavana was the son of Bhṛgu, and Śukra was the best of the wise.
And Kriyā, the wife of Kratu, gave birth to the Vālakhilyas.
There were three sons of Aṅgiras, best among the sages:
Bṛhaspati, Utathya, and Śambara, O Śaunaka.
The son of Vasiṣṭha was Śakti; the son of Śakti was Parāśara;
the son of Parāśara was the glorious Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Hari;
the son of Vyāsa was an aṃśa of Śiva, Śuka, the best among the wise.
Viśvaśravas was the son of Pulastya, whose son was Dhaneśvara.
Śaunaka said:
Ah, the speech of knowers of the Purāṇa is extremely difficult to comprehend!
Not a word of what was said earlier concerning the origin of Dhaneśa was understood.
Just now, the birth of Dhaneśa from Īśvara was told;
how do you now tell me of his birth according to a different order?
Sauti said:
These guardians of the directions came into being formerly from the Supreme Lord;
and once more, through a curse of a brāhmaṇa, he became the son of Viśvaśravas.
In order to give dakṣiṇā to his guru, Utathya carefully begged Dhaneśvara
for a crore of gold pieces for the son of Pracetas.
Dhaneśa, having become reluctant, yet intending to give it to him,
was reduced to ashes, O brāhmaṇa; he took birth again.
Therefore, Kubera, the lord of wealth, is the son of Viśravas,
as are Rāvaṇa, Kumbhakarṇa, and the righteous Vibhīṣaṇa.
Vātsya was the son of Pulaha, and Śāṇḍilya was the son of Ruci;
Sāvarṇi was born from Gautama, an eminent sage indeed.
Kāśyapa was born from Kaśyapa; Bharadvāja was from Bṛhaspati;
Vātsya himself was from Pulaha, and likewise Sāvarṇi was from Gautama;
and Śāṇḍilya was the son of Ruci, a sage who was the best of the radiant.
There were five lineages among them, the most eminent in the world.
Other brāhmaṇa castes were born from the mouth of Brahmā;
they dwell in various regions, devoid of gotras, O Śaunaka.

1.10.s:
trayaḥ putrāścāṅgiraso babhūvurmunisattamāḥ ..
bṛhaspatirutathyaśca śambaraścāpi śaunaka .. 2 ..
1.10.d:
त्रयः पुत्राश्चाङ्गिरसो बभूवुर्मुनिसत्तमाः ॥
बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च शम्बरश्चापि शौनक ॥ 2 ॥

1.10.s:
vasiṣṭhasya sutaḥ śaktiḥ śakteḥ putraḥ parāśaraḥ ..
parāśarasutaḥ śrīmānkṛṣṇadvaipāyano hariḥ .. 3 ..
1.10.d:
वसिष्ठस्य सुतः शक्तिः शक्तेः पुत्रः पराशरः ॥
पराशरसुतः श्रीमान्कृष्णद्वैपायनो हरिः ॥ 3 ॥

1.10.s:
vyāsaputraḥ śivāṃśaśca śukaśca jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
viśvaśravāḥ pulastyasya yasya putro dhaneśvaraḥ .. 4 ..
1.10.d:
व्यासपुत्रः शिवांशश्च शुकश्च ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥
विश्वश्रवाः पुलस्त्यस्य यस्य पुत्रो धनेश्वरः ॥ 4 ॥

1.10.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
aho purāṇa vaduṣāmatyantaṃ durgamaṃ vacaḥ ..
na buddhaṃ vacanaṃ kiṃciddhaneśotpattipūrvakam .. 5 ..
1.10.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
अहो पुराण वदुषामत्यन्तं दुर्गमं वचः ॥
न बुद्धं वचनं किंचिद्धनेशोत्पत्तिपूर्वकम् ॥ 5 ॥

1.10.s:
adhunā kathitaṃ janma dhaneśasyeśvarādidam ..
punarbhiṃnnakramaṃ janma bravīṣi kathameva mām .. 6 ..
1.10.d:
अधुना कथितं जन्म धनेशस्येश्वरादिदम् ॥
पुनर्भिंन्नक्रमं जन्म ब्रवीषि कथमेव माम् ॥ 6 ॥

1.10.s:
sautiruvāca ..
babhūvurete dikpālāḥ purā ca parameśvarāt ..
punaśca brahmaśāpena sa ca viśvaśravassutaḥ .. 7 ..
1.10.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
बभूवुरेते दिक्पालाः पुरा च परमेश्वरात् ॥
पुनश्च ब्रह्मशापेन स च विश्वश्रवस्सुतः ॥ 7 ॥

1.10.s:
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dātumutathyaśca dhaneśvaram ..
yayāce koṭisauvarṇaṃ yatnataśca pracetase .. 8 ..
1.10.d:
गुरवे दक्षिणां दातुमुतथ्यश्च धनेश्वरम् ॥
ययाचे कोटिसौवर्णं यत्नतश्च प्रचेतसे ॥ 8 ॥

1.10.s:
dhaneśo viraso bhūtvā tasmai taddātumudyataḥ ..
cakāra bhasmasādvipra punarjanma lalābha saḥ .. 9 ..
1.10.d:
धनेशो विरसो भूत्वा तस्मै तद्दातुमुद्यतः ॥
चकार भस्मसाद्विप्र पुनर्जन्म ललाभ सः ॥ 9 ॥

1.10.s:
tena viśravasaḥ putraḥ kuberaśca dhanādhipaḥ ..
rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca dhārmikaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ .. 1.10.10 ..
1.10.d:
तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः कुबेरश्च धनाधिपः ॥
रावणः कुम्भकर्णश्च धार्मिकश्च विभीषणः ॥ 1.10.10 ॥

1.10.s:
pulahasya suto vātsyaḥ śāṇḍilyaśca ruceḥ sutaḥ ..
sāvarṇirgautamājjajñe munipravara eva saḥ .. 11 ..
1.10.d:
पुलहस्य सुतो वात्स्यः शाण्डिल्यश्च रुचेः सुतः ॥
सावर्णिर्गौतमाज्जज्ञे मुनिप्रवर एव सः ॥ 11 ॥

1.10.s:
kāśyapaḥ kaśyapājjāto bharadvājo bṛhaspateḥ ..
svayaṃ vātsyaśca pulahātsāvarṇirgautamāttathā .. 12 ..
1.10.d:
काश्यपः कश्यपाज्जातो भरद्वाजो बृहस्पतेः ॥
स्वयं वात्स्यश्च पुलहात्सावर्णिर्गौतमात्तथा ॥ 12 ॥

1.10.s:
śāṇḍilyaśca ruceḥ putro munistejasvināṃ varaḥ ..
babhūvuḥ pañcagotrāśca eteṣāṃ pravarā bhave .. 13 ..
1.10.d:
शाण्डिल्यश्च रुचेः पुत्रो मुनिस्तेजस्विनां वरः ॥
बभूवुः पञ्चगोत्राश्च एतेषां प्रवरा भवे ॥ 13 ॥

1.10.s:
babhūvurbrahmaṇo vaktrādanyā brāhmaṇajātayaḥ..
tāḥ sthitā deśabhedeṣu gotraśūnyāśca śaunaka .. 14 ..
1.10.d:
बभूवुर्ब्रह्मणो वक्त्रादन्या ब्राह्मणजातयः॥
ताः स्थिता देशभेदेषु गोत्रशून्याश्च शौनक ॥ 14 ॥

1.10.s:
candrādityamanūnāṃ ca pravarāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
brahmaṇo bāhudeśāccaivānyāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ .. 15 ..
1.10.d:
चन्द्रादित्यमनूनां च प्रवराः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः ॥
ब्रह्मणो बाहुदेशाच्चैवान्याः क्षत्रियजातयः ॥ 15 ॥
1.10.m:
The kṣatriyas descended from the Moon, the Sun, and the Manus are considered the foremost;
and other kṣatriya castes arose from the arms of Brahmā.
And the vaiśyas arose from the thighs, and the śūdra castes from the feet.
From intermixture among them, the mixed castes arose:
cowherds, barbers, and Bhillas, as well as Modakas and Kūbaras,
betel-sellers, goldsmiths, and merchant castes as well;
such as these, O chief among the twice-born, are proclaimed good śūdras.
The karaṇa is from a śūdra woman and a vaiśya; the ambaṣṭha is from a vaiśya woman and a twice-born man.
And Viśvakarman deposited his semen into a śūdra woman;
from that, these nine artisan sons were born:
the garland-maker, the conch-cutter, the blacksmith, the weaver,
the potter, and the brazier—these six are the best among artisans.
The carpenter, the painter, and likewise the goldsmith;
these are degraded by a curse of a brāhmaṇa, excluded from rituals, of mixed caste.
Śaunaka said:
How did the god Viśvakarman deposit his semen
in a base śūdra woman, and how did those three become fallen?
How did the curse of a brāhmaṇa fall upon them, and for what reason?
O best among the knowers of the Purāṇa, you ought to tell that to us.
Sauti said:
Ghṛtācī, at will, assumed a charming appearance out of passion;
Viśvakarman saw her going on the road at Puṣkara.
From the sight of her he approached, his mind blossoming with pleasure;
his mind stolen by desire, he begged her for lovemaking.
She was adorned with jewelled ornaments, delicate in all her limbs,
appearing as a sixteen-year-old, her youth constantly steadfast,
afflicted by the weight of her large hips, charming the minds of sages,
fickle with an intensely swift glance, deeply tormented by passion;
having seen her firm hips, with her garments blown away by the wind,
her pair of breasts extremely high, firm, and extraordinarily round,
and her smiling, lovely face, surpassing the autumn moon—

1.10.s:
ūrudeśācca vaiśyāśca pādataḥ śūdrajātayaḥ ..
tāsāṃ saṅkarajātena babhūvurvarṇasaṅkarāḥ .. 16 ..
1.10.d:
