ऊरुदेशाच्च वैश्याश्च पादतः शूद्रजातयः ॥
तासां सङ्करजातेन बभूवुर्वर्णसङ्कराः ॥ 16 ॥

1.10.s:
gopanāpitabhillāśca tathā modakakūbarau ..
tāmbūlisvarṇakārau ca vaṇigjātaya eva ca .. 17 ..
1.10.d:
गोपनापितभिल्लाश्च तथा मोदककूबरौ ॥
ताम्बूलिस्वर्णकारौ च वणिग्जातय एव च ॥ 17 ॥

1.10.s:
ityevamādyā viprendra sacchūdrāḥ parikīrttitāḥ ..
śūdrāviśostu karaṇo'mbaṣṭho vaiśyadvijanmanoḥ .. 18 ..
1.10.d:
इत्येवमाद्या विप्रेन्द्र सच्छूद्राः परिकीर्त्तिताः ॥
शूद्राविशोस्तु करणोऽम्बष्ठो वैश्यद्विजन्मनोः ॥ 18 ॥

1.10.s:
viśvakarmā ca śūdrāyāṃ vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
tato babhūvuḥ putrāśca navaite śilpakāriṇaḥ .. 19 ..
1.10.d:
विश्वकर्मा च शूद्रायां वीर्य्याधानं चकार सः ॥
ततो बभूवुः पुत्राश्च नवैते शिल्पकारिणः ॥ 19 ॥

1.10.s:
mālākāraḥ śaṅkhakāraḥ karmakāraḥ kuvindakaḥ ..
kumbhakāraḥ kāṃsyakāraḥ ṣaḍete śilpināṃ varāḥ .. 1.10.20 ..
1.10.d:
मालाकारः शङ्खकारः कर्मकारः कुविन्दकः ॥
कुम्भकारः कांस्यकारः षडेते शिल्पिनां वराः ॥ 1.10.20 ॥

1.10.s:
sūtrakāraścitrakāraḥ svarṇakārastathaiva ca ..
patitāste brahmaśāpādayājyā varṇasaṅkarāḥ .. ..21..
1.10.d:
सूत्रकारश्चित्रकारः स्वर्णकारस्तथैव च ॥
पतितास्ते ब्रह्मशापादयाज्या वर्णसङ्कराः ॥ ॥21॥

1.10.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kathaṃ devo viśvakarmā vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
śūdrāyāmadhamāyāṃ ca kathaṃ te patitāstrayaḥ .. 22 ..
1.10.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
कथं देवो विश्वकर्मा वीर्य्याधानं चकार सः ॥
शूद्रायामधमायां च कथं ते पतितास्त्रयः ॥ 22 ॥

1.10.s:
kathaṃ teṣu brahmaśāpo hyabhavatkena hetunā ..
he purāṇavidāṃ śreṣṭha tannaḥ śaṃsitumarhasi .. 23 ..
1.10.d:
कथं तेषु ब्रह्मशापो ह्यभवत्केन हेतुना ॥
हे पुराणविदां श्रेष्ठ तन्नः शंसितुमर्हसि ॥ 23 ॥

1.10.s:
sautiruvāca ..
ghṛtācī kāmataḥ kāmaṃ veṣaṃ cakre manoharam ..
tāmapaśyadviśvakarmā gacchantīṃ puṣkare pathi .. 24 ..
1.10.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
घृताची कामतः कामं वेषं चक्रे मनोहरम् ॥
तामपश्यद्विश्वकर्मा गच्छन्तीं पुष्करे पथि ॥ 24 ॥

1.10.s:
āgacchattadvilokācca prasādotphullamānamaḥ ..
tāṃ yayāce sa śṛṅgāraṃ kāmena hṛtacetanaḥ .. 25 ..
1.10.d:
आगच्छत्तद्विलोकाच्च प्रसादोत्फुल्लमानमः ॥
तां ययाचे स शृङ्गारं कामेन हृतचेतनः ॥ 25 ॥

1.10.s:
ratnālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyāṃ sarvāvayavakomalām ..
yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ..26..
1.10.d:
रत्नालङ्कारभूषाढ्यां सर्वावयवकोमलाम् ॥
यथा षोडशवर्षीयां शश्वत्सुस्थिरयौवनाम् ॥26॥

1.10.s:
bṛhannitamba bhārārtāṃ munimānasamohinīm ..
ativegakaṭākṣeṇa lolāṃ kāmātipīḍitām ..27..
1.10.d:
बृहन्नितम्ब भारार्तां मुनिमानसमोहिनीम् ॥
अतिवेगकटाक्षेण लोलां कामातिपीडिताम् ॥27॥

1.10.s:
tacchroṇīṃ kaṭhināṃ dṛṣṭvā vāyunā'pahṛtāṃśukām ..
atīvoccaiḥ stanayugaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vartulaṃ param .. 28 ..
1.10.d:
तच्छ्रोणीं कठिनां दृष्ट्वा वायुनाऽपहृतांशुकाम् ॥
अतीवोच्चैः स्तनयुगं कठिनं वर्तुलं परम् ॥ 28 ॥

1.10.s:
susmitaṃ cāru vaktraṃ ca śaraccandravinindakam ..
pakvabimbaphalāraktasvoṣṭhādharamanoharam .. 29 ..
1.10.d:
सुस्मितं चारु वक्त्रं च शरच्चन्द्रविनिन्दकम् ॥
पक्वबिम्बफलारक्तस्वोष्ठाधरमनोहरम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.10.m: [Her face,] charming with lips red like ripe bimba fruit, / marked with a drop of vermilion and dotted with musk, / with radiant cheeks and wearing ever-precious gem-earrings— / to that beloved, gentle woman, he who was skilled in the science of love, / striving to kindle the fire of desire, spoke words lovely to the ear. / Viśvakarman said: / 'Ah, where are you going, delicate one, beloved dearer than my life? / Having stolen my life-breaths, stay for a moment, beautiful and auspicious one! / Searching for you alone, I wander the surface of the earth. / Not seeing you, I wished to abandon my life into the fire. / Hearing from Rambhā's mouth that you were going to the realm of Kāma, / I came this very day and stood upon this path. / Ah, upon the bank of the Sarasvatī, in a charming flower garden, / made fragrant by a gentle, cool breeze carrying sweet scents, / unite with me, fair one, with me, a youthful lover, O lovely woman! / The union of a clever woman with a clever man brings excellence. / Endowed with enduring youth, you are indeed long-lived, / passionate, tender-limbed, and the most beautiful among beauties! / By the boon of Mṛtyuṃjaya alone, Death’s daughter was conquered by me; / going to Kubera’s dwelling, wealth was obtained from Kubera; / a garland of gems from Varuṇa, an ornament of feminine gems from Vāyu; / a pair of fire-purified garments was obtained from the mighty Agni; / the science of love that delights women [was obtained] from Kāmadeva; / and whatever rare art of amorous pleasure [exists] was obtained from Candra. / A gem-garland, a pair of garments, and all ornaments— / it was resolved in my heart to give them to you, and they were obtained that very moment. / Having placed them at home, I came searching [for you] in the world. / Now, when our delightful dalliance ends, I will give them to you.' / Hearing the words of the lustful one, O sage, Ghṛtācī smiled / and quickly gave a lovely reply filled with moral duty. / Ghṛtācī said:

1.10.s:
sindūrabindusaṃyuktaṃ kastūrībindusaṃyutam ..
kapolamujjvalaṃ śaśvanmahārhamaṇikuṇḍalam .. 1.10.30 ..
1.10.d:
सिन्दूरबिन्दुसंयुक्तं कस्तूरीबिन्दुसंयुतम् ॥
कपोलमुज्ज्वलं शश्वन्महार्हमणिकुण्डलम् ॥ 1.10.30 ॥

1.10.s:
tāmuvāca priyāṃ śāntāṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
kāmāgnivarddhanodyogi vacanaṃ śrutisundaram .. 31 ..
1.10.d:
तामुवाच प्रियां शान्तां कामशास्त्रविशारदः ॥
कामाग्निवर्द्धनोद्योगि वचनं श्रुतिसुन्दरम् ॥ 31 ॥

1.10.s:
viśvakarmovāca ..
ayi kva yāsi lalite mama prāṇādhike priye ..
mama prāṇāṃścāpahatya tiṣṭha kānte kṣaṇaṃ śubhe .. 32 ..
1.10.d:
विश्वकर्मोवाच ॥
अयि क्व यासि ललिते मम प्राणाधिके प्रिये ॥
मम प्राणांश्चापहत्य तिष्ठ कान्ते क्षणं शुभे ॥ 32 ॥

1.10.s:
tavaivānveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhramāmi jagatītalam ..
svaprāṇāṃstyaktumiṣṭo'haṃ tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā hutāśane ..33..
1.10.d:
तवैवान्वेषणं कृत्वा भ्रमामि जगतीतलम् ॥
स्वप्राणांस्त्यक्तुमिष्टोऽहं त्वां न दृष्ट्वा हुताशने ॥33॥

1.10.s:
tvaṃ kāmalokaṃ yāsīti śrutvā rambhāmukhoditam ..
āgacchamahamevādya cāsminvartmanyavasthitaḥ .. 34 ..
1.10.d:
त्वं कामलोकं यासीति श्रुत्वा रम्भामुखोदितम् ॥
आगच्छमहमेवाद्य चास्मिन्वर्त्मन्यवस्थितः ॥ 34 ॥

1.10.s:
aho sarasvatītīre puṣpodyāne manohare ..
sugandhimandaśītena vāyunā surabhīkṛte .. 35 ..
1.10.d:
अहो सरस्वतीतीरे पुष्पोद्याने मनोहरे ॥
सुगन्धिमन्दशीतेन वायुना सुरभीकृते ॥ 35 ॥

1.10.s:
yabha kānte mayā sārddhaṃ yūnā kāntena śobhane..
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet ..36..
1.10.d:
यभ कान्ते मया सार्द्धं यूना कान्तेन शोभने॥
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन सङ्गमो गुणवान्भवेत् ॥36॥

1.10.s:
sthirayauvanasaṃyuktā tvameva cirajīvinī..
kāmukī komalāṅgī ca sundarīṣu ca sundarī..37..
1.10.d:
स्थिरयौवनसंयुक्ता त्वमेव चिरजीविनी॥
कामुकी कोमलाङ्गी च सुन्दरीषु च सुन्दरी॥37॥

1.10.s:
mṛtyuṃjayavareṇaiva mṛtyukanyā jitā mayā ..
kuberabhavanaṃ gatvā dhanaṃ labdhaṃ kuberataḥ..38..
1.10.d:
मृत्युंजयवरेणैव मृत्युकन्या जिता मया ॥
कुबेरभवनं गत्वा धनं लब्धं कुबेरतः॥38॥

1.10.s:
ratnamālā ca varuṇādvāyoḥ strīratnabhūṣaṇam ..
vahniśuddhaṃ vastrayugaṃ vahneḥ prāptaṃ mahaujasaḥ..39..
1.10.d:
रत्नमाला च वरुणाद्वायोः स्त्रीरत्नभूषणम् ॥
वह्निशुद्धं वस्त्रयुगं वह्नेः प्राप्तं महौजसः॥39॥

1.10.s:
kāmaśāstraṃ kāmadevādyoṣidrañjanakāram..
śṛṅgāraśilpaṃ yatkiñcillabdhaṃ candrācca durlabham .. 1.10.40 ..
1.10.d:
कामशास्त्रं कामदेवाद्योषिद्रञ्जनकारम्॥
शृङ्गारशिल्पं यत्किञ्चिल्लब्धं चन्द्राच्च दुर्लभम् ॥ 1.10.40 ॥

1.10.s:
ratnamālāṃ vastrayugmaṃ sarvāṇyābharaṇāni ca ..
tubhyaṃ dātuṃ hṛdi kṛtaṃ prāptaṃ tatkṣaṇameva ca .. 41 ..
1.10.d:
रत्नमालां वस्त्रयुग्मं सर्वाण्याभरणानि च ॥
तुभ्यं दातुं हृदि कृतं प्राप्तं तत्क्षणमेव च ॥ 41 ॥

1.10.s:
gṛhe tāni ca saṃsthāpya cāgato'nveṣaṇe bhave ..
virāme sukhasambhoge tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sāmpratam .. 42 ..
1.10.d:
गृहे तानि च संस्थाप्य चागतोऽन्वेषणे भवे ॥
विरामे सुखसम्भोगे तुभ्यं दास्यामि साम्प्रतम् ॥ 42 ॥

1.10.s:
kāmukasya vacaḥ śrutvā ghṛtācī sasmitā mune ..
dadau pratyuttaraṃ śīghraṃ nītiyuktaṃ manoharam .. 43 ..
1.10.d:
कामुकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा घृताची सस्मिता मुने ॥
ददौ प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं नीतियुक्तं मनोहरम् ॥ 43 ॥

1.10.s:
ghṛtācyuvāca ..
tvayā yaduktaṃ bhadraṃ tatsvīkaromyadhunā param .. .
kintu sāmayikaṃ vākyaṃ bravīṣyāmi smarātura .. 44 ..
1.10.d:
घृताच्युवाच ॥
त्वया यदुक्तं भद्रं तत्स्वीकरोम्यधुना परम् ॥ ।
किन्तु सामयिकं वाक्यं ब्रवीष्यामि स्मरातुर ॥ 44 ॥

1.10.s:
kāmadevālayaṃ yāmi kṛtaveṣā ca tatkṛte ..
yaddine yatkṛte yāmo vayaṃ teṣāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ..45..
1.10.d:
कामदेवालयं यामि कृतवेषा च तत्कृते ॥
यद्दिने यत्कृते यामो वयं तेषां च योषितः ॥45॥

1.10.s:
adyāhaṃ kāmapatnī ca gurupatnī tavādhunā ..
tvayoktamadhunedaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ kāmadevataḥ .. 46 ..
1.10.d:
अद्याहं कामपत्नी च गुरुपत्नी तवाधुना ॥
त्वयोक्तमधुनेदं च पठितं कामदेवतः ॥ 46 ॥

1.10.s:
vidyādātā mantradātā gururlakṣaguṇaiḥ pituḥ ..
mātuḥ sahasraguṇavānnāstyanyastatsamo guruḥ ..47..
1.10.d:
विद्यादाता मन्त्रदाता गुरुर्लक्षगुणैः पितुः ॥
मातुः सहस्रगुणवान्नास्त्यन्यस्तत्समो गुरुः ॥47॥

1.10.s:
guroḥ śataguṇaiḥ pūjyā gurupatnī śrutau śrutā..
pituḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyā yathā mātā vicakṣaṇa ..48..
1.10.d:
गुरोः शतगुणैः पूज्या गुरुपत्नी श्रुतौ श्रुता॥
पितुः शतगुणं पूज्या यथा माता विचक्षण ॥48॥

1.10.s:
mātrā samāgame sūnoryāvāndoṣaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ..
tato lakṣaguṇo doṣo gurupatnīsamāgame .. 49 ..
1.10.d:
मात्रा समागमे सूनोर्यावान्दोषः श्रुतौ श्रुतः ॥
ततो लक्षगुणो दोषो गुरुपत्नीसमागमे ॥ 49 ॥

1.10.s:
mātarityeva śabdena yāṃ ca sambhāṣate naraḥ ..
sa mātṛtulyā satyena dharmaḥ sākṣī satāmapi .. 1.10.50 ..
1.10.d:
मातरित्येव शब्देन यां च सम्भाषते नरः ॥
स मातृतुल्या सत्येन धर्मः साक्षी सतामपि ॥ 1.10.50 ॥

1.10.s:
tayā hi saṃgato yassyātkālasūtraṃ prayāti saḥ ..
tatra ghore vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau .. 51 ..
1.10.d:
तया हि संगतो यस्स्यात्कालसूत्रं प्रयाति सः ॥
तत्र घोरे वसत्येव यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 51 ॥

1.10.s:
mātrā saha samāyoge tato doṣaścaturguṇaḥ ..
sārddhaṃ ca gurupatnyā ca tallakṣaguṇa eva ca..52..
1.10.d:
मात्रा सह समायोगे ततो दोषश्चतुर्गुणः ॥
सार्द्धं च गुरुपत्न्या च तल्लक्षगुण एव च॥52॥

1.10.s:
kumbhīpāke patatyeva yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ..
prāyaścittaṃ pāpinaśca tasya naiva śrutau śrutam ..53..
1.10.d:
कुम्भीपाके पतत्येव यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः ॥
प्रायश्चित्तं पापिनश्च तस्य नैव श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥53॥

1.10.s:
cakrākāraṃ kulālasya tīkṣṇadhāraṃ ca khaṅgavat ..
vasāmūtrapurīṣaiśca paripūrṇaṃ sudustaram .. 54 ..
1.10.d:
चक्राकारं कुलालस्य तीक्ष्णधारं च खङ्गवत् ॥
वसामूत्रपुरीषैश्च परिपूर्णं सुदुस्तरम् ॥ 54 ॥

1.10.s:
śūlavatkṛmisaṃyuktaṃ taptamagnisamaṃ dravat ..
pāpināṃ tadvihāraṃ ca kumbhīpākaprakīrtitam .. 55 ..
1.10.d:
शूलवत्कृमिसंयुक्तं तप्तमग्निसमं द्रवत् ॥
पापिनां तद्विहारं च कुम्भीपाकप्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 55 ॥

1.10.s:
yāvāndoṣo hi puṃsāṃ ca gurupatnīsamāgame ..
tāvāṃśca gurupatnyāṃ vai tatra cetkāmukī yadi .. 56 ..
1.10.d:
यावान्दोषो हि पुंसां च गुरुपत्नीसमागमे ॥
तावांश्च गुरुपत्न्यां वै तत्र चेत्कामुकी यदि ॥ 56 ॥

1.10.s:
adya yāsyāmi kāmasya mandiraṃ tasya kāminī ..
veṣaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi tvatkṛte'haṃ dināntare ..57..
1.10.d:
अद्य यास्यामि कामस्य मन्दिरं तस्य कामिनी ॥
वेषं कृत्वा गमिष्यामि त्वत्कृतेऽहं दिनान्तरे ॥57॥

1.10.s:
ghṛtācīvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā ruroṣa tām ..
śaśāpa śūdrayoniṃ ca vrajeti jagatītale ..58..
1.10.d:
घृताचीवचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा रुरोष ताम् ॥
शशाप शूद्रयोनिं च व्रजेति जगतीतले ॥58॥
1.10.m: 'What you have spoken is fine; I accept that later. / But I shall speak words fitting for this moment, O you afflicted by desire! / I am going to the abode of Kāmadeva, dressed in finery for his sake; / on whichever day, for whoever’s sake we go, on that day we are their women. / Today I am Kāma’s wife, and now your teacher’s wife, / for you just stated that you studied under Kāmadeva. / The giver of knowledge, the giver of mantra, the guru is a hundred thousand times greater than a father, / and a thousand times greater than a mother; no other guru equals him. / A guru’s wife is heard in the scriptures to be worshipped a hundred times more than the guru, / just as a mother is worshipped a hundred times more than a father, O wise one! / As great a fault as is heard in the scriptures regarding union with a mother, / a hundred thousand times greater than that is the fault in union with a guru’s wife. / Whichever woman a man addresses with the word "Mother", / she is truly equal to a mother; Dharma is the witness even for the virtuous. / Indeed, he who unites with her goes to Kālasūtra; / he dwells in that terrible place as long as the moon and sun endure. / The fault in uniting with one's mother is fourfold; / and along with a guru’s wife, it is a hundred thousandfold. / He falls into Kumbhīpāka for as long as Brahmā's lifespan; / and no expiation for that sinner is heard of in the scriptures! / Shaped like a potter's wheel, sharp-edged like a sword, / filled with fat, urine, and feces, exceedingly difficult to cross, / filled with spike-like worms, boiling hot like fire, molten— / such is the place of torment for sinners, renowned as Kumbhīpāka. / As great as is the sin for men in union with a guru’s wife, / so great it is for the guru’s wife if she is lustful therein. / Today I shall go to Kāma’s mansion as his beloved; / having adorned myself, I shall come for your sake on another day.' / Hearing Ghṛtācī's words, Viśvakarman was enraged at her; / he cursed her: 'Go to a Śūdra womb on the surface of the earth!'

1.10.s:
ghṛtācī tadvacaḥ śrutvā taṃ śaśāpa sudāruṇam ..
labha janma bhave tvaṃ ca svargabhraṣṭo bhaveti ca .. 59 ..
1.10.d:
घृताची तद्वचः श्रुत्वा तं शशाप सुदारुणम् ॥
लभ जन्म भवे त्वं च स्वर्गभ्रष्टो भवेति च ॥ 59 ॥
1.10.m: Hearing his words, Ghṛtācī uttered a terrible curse upon him: / 'Take birth in the mortal world, and be fallen from heaven!' / Having spoken thus to the artisan, Ghṛtācī went to Kāma’s palace; / having made love with Kāma, she related that story [to him]. / By Kāma’s instruction, she took birth in Bhārata, O Śaunaka, / in the city of Prayāga, as the wife of the cowherd Madana. / Born there, she remembered her previous births and became an ascetic woman; / exceedingly virtuous, she chose no husband, but set her mind upon austerities. / Resembling molten gold through her penance, she performed austerities / for a divine hundred years on the charming bank of the Gaṅgā. / Giving birth to nine sons through the seed of the divine artisan, / she went back to her own realm and became Ghṛtācī once more. / Śaunaka said: / 'How did that ascetic woman receive the seed of the divine artisan / and give birth to nine sons, or where and for how many days?' / Sauti said: / 'Hearing that curse, Viśvakarman, filled with wrath, / went to Brahmā's abode, his senses stolen by sorrow. / Having bowed and praised Brahmā, he recounted that story; / by the command of the Creator, he took birth on earth from a brāhmaṇa woman. / Becoming a brāhmaṇa himself, he was the artisan upon earth; / he crafted various works of art for kings and householders. / He caused wondrous works of art to be made for everyone, everywhere, at all times— / diverse, varied, astonishing, and exceedingly charming. / Once, having completed artisanal work for a king at Prayāga, / he went to the Gaṅgā to bathe and there saw the lovely woman— / Ghṛtācī in a youthful form, a young ascetic woman. / Remembering his own past births, O twice-born, he recognized that she too remembered hers. / Seeing her, he suddenly became filled with desire, his mind captivated; / composed, he spoke sweetly to that gentle ascetic woman. / The brāhmaṇa said:'

1.10.s:
ghṛtācī kārumuktvā ca sā'gacchatkāmamandiram ..
kāmena surataṃ kṛtvā kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām ..1.10.60 ..
1.10.d:
घृताची कारुमुक्त्वा च साऽगच्छत्काममन्दिरम् ॥
कामेन सुरतं कृत्वा कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥1.10.60 ॥

1.10.s:
sā bhārate ca kāmoktyā gopasya madanasya ca ..
patnyāṃ prayāge nagare lebhe janma ca śaunaka .. 61 ..
1.10.d:
सा भारते च कामोक्त्या गोपस्य मदनस्य च ॥
पत्न्यां प्रयागे नगरे लेभे जन्म च शौनक ॥ 61 ॥

1.10.s:
jātismarā tatprasūtā babhūva ca tapasvinī ..
varaṃ na vavre dharmiṣṭhā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhau .. 62 ..
1.10.d:
जातिस्मरा तत्प्रसूता बभूव च तपस्विनी ॥
वरं न वव्रे धर्मिष्ठा तपस्यायां मनो दधौ ॥ 62 ॥

1.10.s:
tapaścakāra tapasā taptakāñcanasannibhā ..
divyaṃ ca śatavarṣaṃ sā gaṅgātīre manorame .. 63 ..
1.10.d:
तपश्चकार तपसा तप्तकाञ्चनसन्निभा ॥
दिव्यं च शतवर्षं सा गङ्गातीरे मनोरमे ॥ 63 ॥

1.10.s:
vīryeṇa surakārośca nava putrānprasūya sā ..
punaḥ svalokaṃ gatvā ca sā ghṛtācī babhūva ha .. 64 ..
1.10.d:
वीर्येण सुरकारोश्च नव पुत्रान्प्रसूय सा ॥
पुनः स्वलोकं गत्वा च सा घृताची बभूव ह ॥ 64 ॥

1.10.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kathaṃ vīryyaṃ sā dadhāra surakārostapasvinī ..
putrānnava prasūtā ca kutra vā kati vāsarān.. 65 ..
1.10.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
कथं वीर्य्यं सा दधार सुरकारोस्तपस्विनी ॥
पुत्रान्नव प्रसूता च कुत्र वा कति वासरान्॥ 65 ॥

1.10.s:
sautiruvāca ..
viśvakarmā tu tacchāpaṃ samākarṇya ruṣā'nvitaḥ ..
jagāma brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ .. 66 ..
1.10.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
विश्वकर्मा तु तच्छापं समाकर्ण्य रुषाऽन्वितः ॥
जगाम ब्रह्मणः स्थानं शोकेन हृतचेतनः ॥ 66 ॥

1.10.s:
natvā stutvā ca brahmāṇaṃ kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām ..
lalābha janma brāhmaṇyāṃ pṛthivyāmājñayā vidheḥ .. 67 ..
1.10.d:
नत्वा स्तुत्वा च ब्रह्माणं कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥
ललाभ जन्म ब्राह्मण्यां पृथिव्यामाज्ञया विधेः ॥ 67 ॥

1.10.s:
sa eva brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bhuvi kārurbabhūva ha ..
nṛpāṇāṃ ca gṛhasthānāṃ nānāśilpaṃ cakāra ha ..68..
1.10.d:
स एव ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा भुवि कारुर्बभूव ह ॥
नृपाणां च गृहस्थानां नानाशिल्पं चकार ह ॥68॥

1.10.s:
śilpaṃ ca kārayāmāsa sarvebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sadā .
vicitraṃ vividhaṃ śilpamāścaryyaṃ sumanoharam .. 69 ..
1.10.d:
शिल्पं च कारयामास सर्वेभ्यः सर्वतः सदा ।
विचित्रं विविधं शिल्पमाश्चर्य्यं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 69 ॥

1.10.s:
ekadā tu prayāge ca śilpaṃ kṛtvā nṛpasya ca ..
snātuṃ jagāma gaṅgāṃ sa cāpaśyattatra kāminīm..1.10.70..
1.10.d:
एकदा तु प्रयागे च शिल्पं कृत्वा नृपस्य च ॥
स्नातुं जगाम गङ्गां स चापश्यत्तत्र कामिनीम्॥1.10.70॥

1.10.s:
ghṛtācīṃ navarūpāṃ ca yuvatiṃ tāṃ tapasvinīm ..
jātismarāṃ tāṃ bubudhe sa ca jātismaro dvija .. 71 ..
1.10.d:
घृताचीं नवरूपां च युवतिं तां तपस्विनीम् ॥
जातिस्मरां तां बुबुधे स च जातिस्मरो द्विज ॥ 71 ॥

1.10.s:
dṛṣṭvā sakāmaḥ sahasā babhūva hṛtacetanaḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ tāṃ ca tapasvinīm..72..
1.10.d:
दृष्ट्वा सकामः सहसा बभूव हृतचेतनः ॥
उवाच मधुरं शान्तः शान्तां तां च तपस्विनीम्॥72॥

1.10.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca ..
aho'dhunā tvamatraiva ghṛtāci sumanohare ..
mā māṃ smarasi rambhoru viśvakarmā'hameva ca..73..
1.10.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच ॥
अहोऽधुना त्वमत्रैव घृताचि सुमनोहरे ॥
मा मां स्मरसि रम्भोरु विश्वकर्माऽहमेव च॥73॥
1.10.m:
“Ah, now you are right here, Ghṛtācī, very beautiful! / Do you not remember me, O woman with thighs like plantain stems? I am indeed Viśvakarmā.
I will bring about an end to your curse; cherish me, my beautiful one! / For your sake, that god of love truly burns my mind exceedingly.”
Having heard the words of the twice-born, Ghṛtācī, now having taken a new form, / peaceful, spoke supreme words endowed with proper conduct:
The cowherdess said:
“On that day I was the beloved of Kāma, but now I am an ascetic. / How could I unite with you here on the bank of the Gaṅgā in Bhārata?
O Viśvakarmā, this Bhārata is a sacred realm of actions. / Whatever action is performed here, the experiencing of its good and bad results is elsewhere.
A righteous person, having obtained birth through the fruit of austerities for the sake of liberation, / bound fast, performs action, deluded by the māyā of Viṣṇu.
When that māyā, Nārāyaṇī, the sovereign lady, becomes completely pleased with someone, / Lord Kṛṣṇa gives him devotion and the mantra he desires.
The fool who is attached to sense objects, though born in Bhārata, / abandoning Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of all, is bewildered by the māyā of Viṣṇu.
O god, I remember everything, ah! I remember my past lives from before: / formerly I was Ghṛtācī, the courtesan of the gods; now I am a cowherd girl.
I perform austerities for the sake of liberation on the bank of the Gaṅgā which grants great merit; / this is not a place for love-play; be calm, O lustful one!
A sin committed elsewhere is destroyed in the Gaṅgā, / but a sin committed on the bank of the Gaṅgā immediately becomes multiplied a hundred-thousandfold.
Even that is destroyed through austerities in the sacred place of Nārāyaṇa, / if, having done it out of passion, one should indeed turn back again.”
Having heard the words of Ghṛtācī, Viśvakarmā, having taken the form of the wind, / taking her, went to the Malaya mountain, the abode of sandalwood.
In the charming valley of Malaya, upon a lovely couch of flowers, / which was constantly perfumed by breezes bearing flower-scents and sandalwood,
he made joyful love with her in that solitary forest.

1.10.s:
śāpamokṣaṃ kariṣyāmi bhaja māṃ tava sundari..
tvatkṛte'tidahatyeva mano me sa ca manmathaḥ.. .. 74 ..
1.10.d:
शापमोक्षं करिष्यामि भज मां तव सुन्दरि॥
त्वत्कृतेऽतिदहत्येव मनो मे स च मन्मथः॥ ॥ 74 ॥

1.10.s:
dvijasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ghṛtācī navarūpiṇī..
uvāca madhuraṃ śāntā nītiyuktaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ..75..
1.10.d:
द्विजस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा घृताची नवरूपिणी॥
उवाच मधुरं शान्ता नीतियुक्तं परं वचः ॥75॥

1.10.s:
gopikovāca..
taddine kāmakāntā'hamadhunā ca tapasvinī ..
kathaṃ tvayā saṃgatā syāṃ gaṃgātīre ca bhārate .. 76 ..
1.10.d:
गोपिकोवाच॥
तद्दिने कामकान्ताऽहमधुना च तपस्विनी ॥
कथं त्वया संगता स्यां गंगातीरे च भारते ॥ 76 ॥

1.10.s:
viśvakarmannidaṃ puṇyaṃ karmakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ..
atra yatkriyate karma bhogo'nyatra śubhāśubham .. 77 ..
1.10.d:
विश्वकर्मन्निदं पुण्यं कर्मक्षेत्रं च भारतम् ॥
अत्र यत्क्रियते कर्म भोगोऽन्यत्र शुभाशुभम् ॥ 77 ॥

1.10.s:
dharmī mokṣakṛte janma pralabhya tapasaḥ phalāt ..
nibaddhaḥ kurute karma mohito viṣṇumāyayā .. 78 ..
1.10.d:
धर्मी मोक्षकृते जन्म प्रलभ्य तपसः फलात् ॥
निबद्धः कुरुते कर्म मोहितो विष्णुमायया ॥ 78 ॥

1.10.s:
māyā nārāyaṇīśānā parituṣṭā ca yaṃ bhavet ..
tasmai dadāti śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktiṃ tanmantramīpsitam .. 79 ..
1.10.d:
माया नारायणीशाना परितुष्टा च यं भवेत् ॥
तस्मै ददाति श्रीकृष्णो भक्तिं तन्मन्त्रमीप्सितम् ॥ 79 ॥

1.10.s:
yo mūḍho viṣayāsakto labdhajanmā ca bhārate ..
vihāya kṛṣṇaṃ sarveśaṃ sa mugdho viṣṇumāyayā .. 1.10.80 ..
1.10.d:
यो मूढो विषयासक्तो लब्धजन्मा च भारते ॥
विहाय कृष्णं सर्वेशं स मुग्धो विष्णुमायया ॥ 1.10.80 ॥

1.10.s:
sarvaṃ smarāmi devāhamaho jātismarā purā ..
ghṛtācī suraveśyā'hamadhunā gopakanyakā .. 81 ..
1.10.d:
सर्वं स्मरामि देवाहमहो जातिस्मरा पुरा ॥
घृताची सुरवेश्याऽहमधुना गोपकन्यका ॥ 81 ॥

1.10.s:
tapaḥ karomi mokṣārthaṃ gaṅgātīre supuṇyade ..
nātra sthalaṃ ca krīḍāyāḥ sthirastvaṃ bhava kāmuka .. 82 ..
1.10.d:
तपः करोमि मोक्षार्थं गङ्गातीरे सुपुण्यदे ॥
नात्र स्थलं च क्रीडायाः स्थिरस्त्वं भव कामुक ॥ 82 ॥

1.10.s:
anyatra yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ tadvinaśyati ..
gaṃgātīre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet .. 83 ..
1.10.d:
अन्यत्र यत्कृतं पापं गंगायां तद्विनश्यति ॥
गंगातीरे कृतं पापं सद्यो लक्षगुणं भवेत् ॥ 83 ॥

1.10.s:
tattu nārāyaṇakṣetre tapasā ca vinaśyati ..
yadyeva kāmataḥ kṛtvā nivṛttaśca bhavetpunaḥ .. 84 ..
1.10.d:
तत्तु नारायणक्षेत्रे तपसा च विनश्यति ॥
यद्येव कामतः कृत्वा निवृत्तश्च भवेत्पुनः ॥ 84 ॥

1.10.s:
ghṛtācīvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā'nilākṛtiḥ ..
jagāma tāṃ gṛhītvā ca malayaṃ candanālayam .. 85 ..
1.10.d:
घृताचीवचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्माऽनिलाकृतिः ॥
जगाम तां गृहीत्वा च मलयं चन्दनालयम् ॥ 85 ॥

1.10.s:
ramyāyāṃ malayadroṇyāṃ puṣpatalpe manorame .. .
puṣpacandanavātena saṃtataṃ surabhīkṛte..86..
1.10.d:
रम्यायां मलयद्रोण्यां पुष्पतल्पे मनोरमे ॥ ।
पुष्पचन्दनवातेन संततं सुरभीकृते॥86॥

1.10.s:
cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ tayā sa vijane vane ..
pūrṇaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ ca bubudhe na divāniśam..87..
1.10.d:
चकार सुखसम्भोगं तया स विजने वने ॥
पूर्णं द्वादशवर्षं च बुबुधे न दिवानिशम्॥87॥

1.10.s:
babhūva garbhaḥ kāminyāḥ paripūrṇaḥ sudurvahaḥ..
sā suṣāva ca tatraiva putrānnava manoharān..88..
1.10.d:
बभूव गर्भः कामिन्याः परिपूर्णः सुदुर्वहः॥
सा सुषाव च तत्रैव पुत्रान्नव मनोहरान्॥88॥

1.10.s:
kṛtaśikṣitaśilpāṃśva jñānayuktāṃśca śaunaka..
pūrṇaprāktanato yugyānbalayuktānvicakṣaṇān .. 89 ..
1.10.d:
कृतशिक्षितशिल्पांश्व ज्ञानयुक्तांश्च शौनक॥
पूर्णप्राक्तनतो युग्यान्बलयुक्तान्विचक्षणान् ॥ 89 ॥

1.10.s:
mālākārānkarmakārāñchaṅkhakārānkuvindakān ..
kumbhakārānsūtrakārānsvarṇacitrakarāṃstathā .. 1.10.90 ..
1.10.d:
मालाकारान्कर्मकाराञ्छङ्खकारान्कुविन्दकान् ॥
कुम्भकारान्सूत्रकारान्स्वर्णचित्रकरांस्तथा ॥ 1.10.90 ॥

1.10.s:
tau ca tebhyo varaṃ dattvā tānsaṃsthāpya mahītale ..
mānavīṃ tanumutsṛjya jagmaturnijamandiram .. 91 ..
1.10.d:
तौ च तेभ्यो वरं दत्त्वा तान्संस्थाप्य महीतले ॥
मानवीं तनुमुत्सृज्य जग्मतुर्निजमन्दिरम् ॥ 91 ॥

1.10.s:
svarṇakāraḥ svarṇacauryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottama ..
babhūva patitaḥ sadyo brahmaśāpena karmaṇā .. 92 ..
1.10.d:
स्वर्णकारः स्वर्णचौर्याद्ब्राह्मणानां द्विजोत्तम ॥
बभूव पतितः सद्यो ब्रह्मशापेन कर्मणा ॥ 92 ॥

1.10.s:
sūtrakāro dvijānāṃ tu śāpena patito bhuvi ..
śīghraṃ ca yajñakāṣṭhāni na dadau tena hetunā..93..
1.10.d:
सूत्रकारो द्विजानां तु शापेन पतितो भुवि ॥
शीघ्रं च यज्ञकाष्ठानि न ददौ तेन हेतुना॥93॥

1.10.s:
vyatikrameṇa citrāṇāṃ sadyaścitrakarastathā ..
patito brahmaśāpena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kopataḥ..94.
1.10.d:
व्यतिक्रमेण चित्राणां सद्यश्चित्रकरस्तथा ॥
पतितो ब्रह्मशापेन ब्राह्मणानां च कोपतः॥94.
1.10.m:
For twelve full years he was not aware of day or night.
A fetus developed in the passionate woman, full and exceedingly heavy to carry. / And there she gave birth to nine charming sons,
trained and instructed in crafts, endowed with knowledge, O Śaunaka, / capable from their full past deeds, endowed with strength, and clever:
garland-makers, blacksmiths, conch-shell workers, weavers, / potters, carpenters, as well as goldsmiths and painters.
Those two, having granted boons to them and settled them upon the surface of the earth, / cast off their mortal bodies and went to their own abodes.
The goldsmith, because of the theft of gold belonging to brāhmaṇas, O best of the twice-born, / immediately became fallen through that action and by a brāhmaṇa’s curse.
The carpenter, indeed, became fallen on earth by a curse of the twice-born, / for he did not promptly provide the sacrificial wood; for that reason.
Likewise, through the violation of the proper rules of painting, the painter / immediately became fallen by a brāhmaṇa’s curse and the anger of the brāhmaṇas.

1.10.s:
kaścidvaṇigviśeṣaśca saṃsargātsvarṇakāriṇaḥ ..
svarṇacauryyādidoṣeṇa patito brahmaśāpataḥ ..95..
1.10.d:
कश्चिद्वणिग्विशेषश्च संसर्गात्स्वर्णकारिणः ॥
स्वर्णचौर्य्यादिदोषेण पतितो ब्रह्मशापतः ॥95॥
1.10.m:
And a certain merchant, through association with the goldsmith,
through the fault of gold theft and the like, became fallen by a brāhmaṇa’s curse.

1.10.s:
kulaṭāyāṃ ca śūdrāyāṃ citrakārasya vīryyataḥ ..
babhūvāṭṭālikākāraḥ patito jāradoṣataḥ .. 96 ..
1.10.d:
कुलटायां च शूद्रायां चित्रकारस्य वीर्य्यतः ॥
बभूवाट्टालिकाकारः पतितो जारदोषतः ॥ 96 ॥
1.10.m:
And from an unchaste Śūdra woman, by the seed of the painter,
the mansion-builder was born, fallen due to the fault of adultery.

1.10.s:
aṭṭālikākārabījātkumbhakārasya yoṣiti ..
babhūva koṭakaḥ sadyaḥ patito gṛhakārakaḥ .. 97 ..
1.10.d:
अट्टालिकाकारबीजात्कुम्भकारस्य योषिति ॥
बभूव कोटकः सद्यः पतितो गृहकारकः ॥ 97 ॥
1.10.m:
From the seed of the mansion-builder in a woman of the potter [caste],
there immediately arose the Koṭaka, a house-builder, who was fallen.

1.10.s:
kumbhakārasya bījena sadyaḥ koṭakayoṣiti ..
babhūva tailakāraśca kuṭilaḥ patito bhuvi.. .. 98 ..
1.10.d:
कुम्भकारस्य बीजेन सद्यः कोटकयोषिति ॥
बभूव तैलकारश्च कुटिलः पतितो भुवि॥ ॥ 98 ॥
1.10.m:
By the seed of the potter in the wife of a Koṭaka,
an oil-presser was immediately born, crooked and fallen upon the earth.

1.10.s:
sadyaḥ kṣatriyabījena rājaputrasya yoṣiti ..
babhūva tīvaraścaiva patito jāradoṣataḥ .. 99 ..
1.10.d:
सद्यः क्षत्रियबीजेन राजपुत्रस्य योषिति ॥
बभूव तीवरश्चैव पतितो जारदोषतः ॥ 99 ॥
1.10.m:
a Tīvara was born, fallen due to the fault of adultery.
Immediately from the seed of a Kṣatriya in the wife of a Rājaputra,

1.10.s:
tīvarasya tu bījena tailakārasya yoṣiti..
babhūva patito dasyurleṭaśca parikīrtitaḥ .. 1.10.100 ..
1.10.d:
तीवरस्य तु बीजेन तैलकारस्य योषिति॥
बभूव पतितो दस्युर्लेटश्च परिकीर्तितः ॥ 1.10.100 ॥
1.10.m:
From the seed of a Tīvara in the wife of an oil-presser,
a fallen robber was born, who is proclaimed as the Leṭa.

1.10.s:
leṭastīvarakanyāyāṃ janayāmāsa ṣaṭ sutān ..
māllaṃ mantraṃ mātaraṃ ca bhaṇḍaṃ kolaṃ kalandaram .. 101 ..
1.10.d:
लेटस्तीवरकन्यायां जनयामास षट् सुतान् ॥
माल्लं मन्त्रं मातरं च भण्डं कोलं कलन्दरम् ॥ 101 ॥
1.10.m:
The Leṭa begot six sons upon a Tīvara woman:
the Mālla, the Mantra, the Mātara, the Bhaṇḍa, the Kola, and the Kalandara.

1.10.s:
brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdravīryyeṇa patito jāradoṣataḥ ..
sadyo babhūva caṇḍālaḥ sarvasmādadhamo'śuciḥ .. .. 102 ..
1.10.d:
ब्राह्मण्यां शूद्रवीर्य्येण पतितो जारदोषतः ॥
सद्यो बभूव चण्डालः सर्वस्मादधमोऽशुचिः ॥ ॥ 102 ॥
1.10.m:
In a brāhmaṇa woman by the seed of a Śūdra, fallen due to the fault of adultery,
a Caṇḍāla was immediately born, lowest of all and impure.

1.10.s:
tīvareṇa ca caṇḍālyāṃ carmakāro babhūva ha ..
carmakāryyāṃ ca caṇḍālānmāṃsacchedo babhūva ha .. 103 ..
1.10.d:
तीवरेण च चण्डाल्यां चर्मकारो बभूव ह ॥
चर्मकार्य्यां च चण्डालान्मांसच्छेदो बभूव ह ॥ 103 ॥
1.10.m:
And by a Tīvara in a Caṇḍāla woman, a leather-worker was born;
and in a leather-worker woman from a Caṇḍāla, a butcher was born.

1.10.s:
māṃsacchedyāṃ tīvareṇa koñcaśca parikīrtitaḥ ..
koñcastriyāṃ tu kaivarttātkarttāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 104 ..
1.10.d:
मांसच्छेद्यां तीवरेण कोञ्चश्च परिकीर्तितः ॥
कोञ्चस्त्रियां तु कैवर्त्तात्कर्त्तारः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 104 ॥
1.10.m:
In a butcher woman by a Tīvara, the Koñca is proclaimed;
and in a Koñca woman from a Kaivartta, the Karttāras are proclaimed.

1.10.s:
sadyaścaṇḍālakanyāyāṃ leṭavīryyeṇa śaunaka ..
babhūvatustau dvau putrau duṣṭau haḍḍiḍamau tathā ..105..
1.10.d:
सद्यश्चण्डालकन्यायां लेटवीर्य्येण शौनक ॥
बभूवतुस्तौ द्वौ पुत्रौ दुष्टौ हड्डिडमौ तथा ॥105॥
1.10.m:
Immediately in a Caṇḍāla girl by the seed of a Leṭa, O Śaunaka,
those two sons, the wicked Haḍḍi and Ḍama, were born.

1.10.s:
krameṇa haḍḍikanyāyāṃ sadyaścaṇḍālavīryyataḥ ..
babhūvuḥ pañca putrāśca duṣṭā vanacarāśca te .. 106 ..
1.10.d:
क्रमेण हड्डिकन्यायां सद्यश्चण्डालवीर्य्यतः ॥
बभूवुः पञ्च पुत्राश्च दुष्टा वनचराश्च ते ॥ 106 ॥
1.10.m:
In due order, in a Haḍḍi girl immediately by the seed of a Caṇḍāla,
there arose five sons, wicked forest-dwellers.

1.10.s:
leṭāttīvarakanyāyāṃ gaṅgātīre ca śaunaka ..
babhūva sadyo yo bālo gaṅgāputraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 107 ..
1.10.d:
लेटात्तीवरकन्यायां गङ्गातीरे च शौनक ॥
बभूव सद्यो यो बालो गङ्गापुत्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 107 ॥
1.10.m:
From a Leṭa in a Tīvara girl on the bank of the Gaṅgā, O Śaunaka,
the boy who was immediately born is proclaimed as the Gaṅgāputra.

1.10.s:
gaṅgāputrasya kanyāyāṃ vīryyādvai veṣadhāriṇaḥ ..
babhūva veṣadhārī ca putro yuṅgī prakīrtitaḥ .. 108 ..
1.10.d:
गङ्गापुत्रस्य कन्यायां वीर्य्याद्वै वेषधारिणः ॥
बभूव वेषधारी च पुत्रो युङ्गी प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 108 ॥
1.10.m:
In a daughter of a Gaṅgāputra, from the seed indeed of a religious masquerader,
a masquerading son was born, proclaimed as the Yuṅgī.

1.10.s:
vaiśyāttīvarakanyāyāṃ sadyaḥ śuṇḍī babhūva ha ..
śuṇḍīyoṣiti vaiśyānu pauṇḍrakaśca babhūva ha .. 109 ..
1.10.d:
वैश्यात्तीवरकन्यायां सद्यः शुण्डी बभूव ह ॥
शुण्डीयोषिति वैश्यानु पौण्ड्रकश्च बभूव ह ॥ 109 ॥
1.10.m:
From a Vaiśya in a Tīvara girl, a distiller was immediately born;
and in a distiller woman from a Vaiśya, a Pauṇḍraka was born.

1.10.s:
kṣatrātkaraṇakanyāyāṃ rājaputro babhūva ha ..
rājaputryāṃ tu karaṇādāgarīti prakīrtitaḥ .. 1.10.110 ..
1.10.d:
क्षत्रात्करणकन्यायां राजपुत्रो बभूव ह ॥
राजपुत्र्यां तु करणादागरीति प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 1.10.110 ॥
1.10.m:
From a Kṣatriya in a Karaṇa girl, a Rājaputra was born;
and in a Rājaputra girl from a Karaṇa, one proclaimed as Āgarī [was born].

1.10.s:
kṣatravīryyeṇa vaiśyāyāṃ kaivarttaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
kalau tīvarasaṃsargāddhīvaraḥ patito bhuvi .. 111 ..
1.10.d:
क्षत्रवीर्य्येण वैश्यायां कैवर्त्तः परिकीर्तितः ॥
कलौ तीवरसंसर्गाद्धीवरः पतितो भुवि ॥ 111 ॥
1.10.m:
By the seed of a Kṣatriya in a Vaiśya woman, the Kaivartta is proclaimed;
in the Kali age, due to association with the Tīvaras, the Dhīvara fisherman became fallen on earth.

1.10.s:
tīvaryāṃ dhīvarātputro babhūva rajakaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
rajakyāṃ tīvarāccaiva koyālīti babhūva ha .. 112 ..
1.10.d:
तीवर्यां धीवरात्पुत्रो बभूव रजकः स्मृतः ॥
रजक्यां तीवराच्चैव कोयालीति बभूव ह ॥ 112 ॥
1.10.m:
In a Tīvara woman from a Dhīvara, a son was born who is known as a washerman;
and in a washerman woman from a Tīvara, the Koyālī was born.

1.10.s:
nāpitādgopakanyāyāṃ sarvasvī tasya yoṣiti ..
kṣatrādbabhūva vyādhaśca balavānmṛgahiṃsakaḥ .. 113 ..
1.10.d:
नापिताद्गोपकन्यायां सर्वस्वी तस्य योषिति ॥
क्षत्राद्बभूव व्याधश्च बलवान्मृगहिंसकः ॥ 113 ॥
1.10.m:
From a barber in a cowherd girl, the Sarvasvī [was born]; and in his wife,
from a Kṣatriya, was born a hunter, strong and a slayer of wild animals.

1.10.s:
tīvarācchuṇḍikanyāyāṃ babhūvuḥ sapta putrakāḥ ..
te kalau haḍḍisaṃsargādbabhūvurdasyavaḥ sadā .. 114 ..
1.10.d:
तीवराच्छुण्डिकन्यायां बभूवुः सप्त पुत्रकाः ॥
ते कलौ हड्डिसंसर्गाद्बभूवुर्दस्यवः सदा ॥ 114 ॥
1.10.m:
From a Tīvara in a distiller girl, seven sons were born;
in the Kali age, through association with Haḍḍis, they always became robbers.

1.10.s:
brāhmaṇyāmṛṣivīryyeṇa ṛtoḥ prathamavāsare ..
kutsitaścodare jātaḥ kūdarastena kīrtitaḥ .. 115 ..
1.10.d:
ब्राह्मण्यामृषिवीर्य्येण ऋतोः प्रथमवासरे ॥
कुत्सितश्चोदरे जातः कूदरस्तेन कीर्तितः ॥ 115 ॥
1.10.m:
In a brāhmaṇa woman, by the seed of a seer on the first day of her season,
a deformed [son] was born in the womb; therefore he is proclaimed as Kūdara.

1.10.s:
tadaśaucaṃ vipratulyaṃ patitaścartudoṣataḥ ..
sadyaḥ koṭakasaṃsargādadhamo jagatītale .. 116 ..
1.10.d:
तदशौचं विप्रतुल्यं पतितश्चर्तुदोषतः ॥
सद्यः कोटकसंसर्गादधमो जगतीतले ॥ 116 ॥
1.10.m:
His impurity is equal to that of a brāhmaṇa, but he is fallen due to the fault of the time of the season;
immediately through association with Koṭakas, he became lowest on the surface of the earth.

1.10.s:
kṣatravīryyeṇa vaiśyāyāmṛtoḥ prathamavāsare ..
jātaḥ putro mahādasyurbalavāṃśca dhanurddharaḥ .. 117 ..
1.10.d:
क्षत्रवीर्य्येण वैश्यायामृतोः प्रथमवासरे ॥
जातः पुत्रो महादस्युर्बलवांश्च धनुर्द्धरः ॥ 117 ॥
1.10.m:
By the seed of a Kṣatriya in a Vaiśya woman on the first day of her season,
a son was born who was a great robber, strong, and a wielder of the bow.

1.10.s:
cakāra vāgatītaṃ ca kṣatriyeṇāpi vāritaḥ ..
tena jātyāḥ sa putraśca vāgatītaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 118 ..
1.10.d:
चकार वागतीतं च क्षत्रियेणापि वारितः ॥
तेन जात्याः स पुत्रश्च वागतीतः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 118 ॥
1.10.m:
Even though restrained by the Kṣatriya, he did what was beyond words;
therefore, by caste, that son was called Vāgatīta. // 118

1.10.s:
kṣattravīryyeṇa śūdrāyāmṛtudoṣeṇa pāpataḥ ..
balavanto durantāśca babhūvurmlecchajātayaḥ .. 119 ..
1.10.d:
क्षत्त्रवीर्य्येण शूद्रायामृतुदोषेण पापतः ॥
बलवन्तो दुरन्ताश्च बभूवुर्म्लेच्छजातयः ॥ 119 ॥
1.10.m:
From the semen of a Kṣatriya upon a Śūdra woman, through the fault of the menstrual season and through sin,
there arose the powerful and unmanageable Mleccha castes: // 119

1.10.s:
aviddhakarṇāḥ krūrāśca nirbhayā raṇadurjayāḥ ..
śaucācāravihīnāśca durddharṣā dharmavarjitāḥ .. 1.10.120 ..
1.10.d:
अविद्धकर्णाः क्रूराश्च निर्भया रणदुर्जयाः ॥
शौचाचारविहीनाश्च दुर्द्धर्षा धर्मवर्जिताः ॥ 1.10.120 ॥
1.10.m:
unpierced-eared, cruel, fearless, unconquerable in battle,
devoid of purity and conduct, irrepressible, and abandoned by dharma. // 120

1.10.s:
mlecchātkuvindakanyāyāṃ jolā jātirbabhūva ha.. .
jolātkuvindakanyāyāṃ śarāṅkaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 121 ..
1.10.d:
म्लेच्छात्कुविन्दकन्यायां जोला जातिर्बभूव ह॥ ।
जोलात्कुविन्दकन्यायां शराङ्कः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 121 ॥
1.10.m: From a Mleccha upon a weaver girl the Jolā caste arose; / from a Jolā upon a weaver girl the Śarāṅka is proclaimed. // 121

1.10.s:
varṇasaṅkaradoṣeṇa bahvyaścāśrutajātaya ..
tāsāṃ nāmāni saṃkhyāśca ko vā vaktuṃ kṣamo dvija .. 122 ..
1.10.d:
वर्णसङ्करदोषेण बह्व्यश्चाश्रुतजातय ॥
तासां नामानि संख्याश्च को वा वक्तुं क्षमो द्विज ॥ 122 ॥
1.10.m:
Through the fault of the mixture of castes, many castes were never heard of [before];
who indeed is able to tell their names and numbers, O twice-born? // 122

1.10.s:
vaidyo'śvinīkumāreṇa jāto viprasya yoṣiti ..
vaidyavīryyeṇa śūdrāyāṃ babhūvurbahavo janāḥ .. 123 ..
1.10.d:
वैद्योऽश्विनीकुमारेण जातो विप्रस्य योषिति ॥
वैद्यवीर्य्येण शूद्रायां बभूवुर्बहवो जनाः ॥ 123 ॥
1.10.m:
The Vaidya was born from the Aśvinīkumāra upon the wife of a Vipra.
From the semen of the Vaidya upon a Śūdra woman arose many people; // 123

1.10.s:
te ca grāmyaguṇajñāśca mantrauṣadhiparāyaṇāḥ ..
tebhyaśca jātāḥ śūdrāyāṃ ye vyālagrāhiṇo bhuvi .. 124 ..
1.10.d:
ते च ग्राम्यगुणज्ञाश्च मन्त्रौषधिपरायणाः ॥
तेभ्यश्च जाताः शूद्रायां ये व्यालग्राहिणो भुवि ॥ 124 ॥
1.10.m:
they know rural virtues and are devoted to incantations and herbs.
From them, born upon a Śūdra woman, are those who are snake-catchers on earth. // 124

1.10.s:
śaunaka uvāca ..
kathaṃ brāhmaṇapatnyāṃ tu sūryyaputro'śvinīsutaḥ ..
aho kenāvivekena vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 125 ..
1.10.d:
शौनक उवाच ॥
कथं ब्राह्मणपत्न्यां तु सूर्य्यपुत्रोऽश्विनीसुतः ॥
अहो केनाविवेकेन वीर्य्याधानं चकार ह ॥ 125 ॥
1.10.m:
How did the son of the Sun, the child of Aśvinī,
impart semen into the wife of a brāhmaṇa? Alas, through what lack of discernment? // 125

1.10.s:
sautiruvāca ..
gacchantīṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ravinandanaḥ ..
dadarśa kāmukaḥ śāntaḥ puṣpodyāne ca nirjane .. 126 ..
1.10.d:
सौतिरुवाच ॥
गच्छन्तीं तीर्थयात्रायां ब्राह्मणीं रविनन्दनः ॥
ददर्श कामुकः शान्तः पुष्पोद्याने च निर्जने ॥ 126 ॥
1.10.m:
The son of the Sun saw a brāhmaṇa woman going on a pilgrimage,
in an uninhabited flower garden—she being calm, and he lustful. // 126

1.10.s:
tayā nivārito yatnādbalena balavānsuraḥ ..
atīva sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ .. 127 ..
1.10.d:
तया निवारितो यत्नाद्बलेन बलवान्सुरः ॥
अतीव सुन्दरीं दृष्ट्वा वीर्य्याधानं चकार सः ॥ 127 ॥
1.10.m:
Restrained by her with effort, the powerful god, by force,
seeing her exceedingly beautiful, discharged his semen. // 127

1.10.s:
drutaṃ tatyāja garbhaṃ sā puṣpodyāne manohare ..
sadyo babhūva putraśca taptakāñcanasa nnibhaḥ .. 128 ..
1.10.d:
द्रुतं तत्याज गर्भं सा पुष्पोद्याने मनोहरे ॥
सद्यो बभूव पुत्रश्च तप्तकाञ्चनस न्निभः ॥ 128 ॥
1.10.m:
She quickly cast off the embryo in that charming flower garden,
and immediately there arose a son resembling molten gold. // 128

1.10.s:
saputrā svāmino gehaṃ jagāma vrīḍitā sadā ..
svāminaṃ kathayāmāsa yanmārge daivasaṅkaṭam .. 129 ..
1.10.d:
सपुत्रा स्वामिनो गेहं जगाम व्रीडिता सदा ॥
स्वामिनं कथयामास यन्मार्गे दैवसङ्कटम् ॥ 129 ॥
1.10.m:
With her son, she went to her husband's home, ever bashful;
she told her husband of the calamity caused by fate on the road. // 129

1.10.s:
vipro roṣeṇa tatyāja taṃ ca putraṃ svakāminīm ..
saridbabhūva yogena sā ca godāvarī smṛtā .. 1.10.130 ..
1.10.d:
विप्रो रोषेण तत्याज तं च पुत्रं स्वकामिनीम् ॥
सरिद्बभूव योगेन सा च गोदावरी स्मृता ॥ 1.10.130 ॥
1.10.m:
The Vipra angrily abandoned both the son and his beloved wife.
Through yoga she became a river, and is remembered as the Godāvarī. // 130

1.10.s:
putraṃ cikitsāśāstraṃ ca pāṭhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ..
nānāśilpaṃ ca maṃtraṃ ca svayaṃ sa ravinandanaḥ .. 131 ..
1.10.d:
पुत्रं चिकित्साशास्त्रं च पाठयामास यत्नतः ॥
नानाशिल्पं च मंत्रं च स्वयं स रविनन्दनः ॥ 131 ॥
1.10.m:
The son of the Sun himself diligently taught the son the science of medicine,
as well as various crafts and incantations. // 131

1.10.s:
vipraśca vetanājyotirgaṇanācca nirantaram ..
vedadharmaparityakto babhūva gaṇako bhuvi .. 132 ..
1.10.d:
विप्रश्च वेतनाज्योतिर्गणनाच्च निरन्तरम् ॥
वेदधर्मपरित्यक्तो बभूव गणको भुवि ॥ 132 ॥
1.10.m:
And a Vipra who constantly calculated stars for wages,
abandoned by Vedic dharma, became an astrologer on earth. // 132

1.10.s:
lobhī vipraśca śūdrāṇāmagre dānaṃ gṛhītavān ..
grahaṇe mṛtadānānāmagrādāno babhūva saḥ .. 133 ..
1.10.d:
लोभी विप्रश्च शूद्राणामग्रे दानं गृहीतवान् ॥
ग्रहणे मृतदानानामग्रादानो बभूव सः ॥ 133 ॥
1.10.m:
A greedy Vipra who accepted gifts before the Śūdras,
became an Agrādāna through the acceptance of gifts given for the dead. // 133

1.10.s:
kaścitpumānbrahmayajñe yajñakuṇḍātsamutthitaḥ ..
sa sūto dharmavaktā ca matpūrvapuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 134 ..
1.10.d:
कश्चित्पुमान्ब्रह्मयज्ञे यज्ञकुण्डात्समुत्थितः ॥
स सूतो धर्मवक्ता च मत्पूर्वपुरुषः स्मृतः ॥ 134 ॥
1.10.m:
A certain man arose from the sacrificial pit at a sacrifice to Brahman;
he was the Sūta, speaker of dharma, remembered as my forefather. // 134

1.10.s:
purāṇaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa taṃ ca brahmā kṛpānidhiḥ ..
purāṇavaktā sūtaśca yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavaḥ .. 135 ..
1.10.d:
पुराणं पाठयामास तं च ब्रह्मा कृपानिधिः ॥
पुराणवक्ता सूतश्च यज्ञकुण्डसमुद्भवः ॥ 135 ॥
1.10.m:
Brahmā, the treasury of compassion, taught him the Purāṇa;
the Sūta, speaker of the Purāṇa, arose from the sacrificial pit. // 135

1.10.s:
vaiśyāyāṃ sūtavīryyeṇa pumāneko babhūva ha ..
sa bhaṭṭo vāvadūkaśca sarveṣāṃ stutipāṭhakaḥ .. 136 ..
1.10.d:
वैश्यायां सूतवीर्य्येण पुमानेको बभूव ह ॥
स भट्टो वावदूकश्च सर्वेषां स्तुतिपाठकः ॥ 136 ॥
1.10.m:
From the semen of the Sūta upon a Vaiśya woman arose a single man;
he was the Bhaṭṭa, eloquent and a reciter of praises for all. // 136

1.10.s:
evaṃ te kathitaḥ kiṃcitpṛthivyāṃ jātinirṇaya ..
varṇasaṅkaradoṣeṇa bahvyo'nyāḥ santi jātayaḥ.. 137..
1.10.d:
एवं ते कथितः किंचित्पृथिव्यां जातिनिर्णय ॥
वर्णसङ्करदोषेण बह्व्योऽन्याः सन्ति जातयः॥ 137॥
1.10.m:
Thus the determination of castes on earth has been described somewhat to you;
through the fault of the mixture of castes, there are many other castes. // 137

1.10.s:
sabandho yeṣu yeṣāṃ yaḥ sarvajātiṣu sarvataḥ ..
tattvaṃ bravīmi vedoktaṃ brahmaṇā kathitaṃ purā .. 138 ..
1.10.d:
सबन्धो येषु येषां यः सर्वजातिषु सर्वतः ॥
तत्त्वं ब्रवीमि वेदोक्तं ब्रह्मणा कथितं पुरा ॥ 138 ॥
1.10.m:
Whatever kinship belongs to whomsoever among all the castes everywhere,
I tell that truth stated in the Veda, spoken formerly by Brahmā: // 138

1.10.s:
pitā tātastu janako janmadātā prakīrtitaḥ ..
ambā mātā ca jananī janayitrī prasūrapi .. 139 ..
1.10.d:
पिता तातस्तु जनको जन्मदाता प्रकीर्तितः ॥
अम्बा माता च जननी जनयित्री प्रसूरपि ॥ 139 ॥
1.10.m:
The 'father', tātá, is called janaka ('begetter') and janmadātā ('giver of birth');
[a mother is called] ambā, mātā, jananī, janayitrī, and prasū. // 139

1.10.s:
pitāmahaḥ pitṛpitā tatpitā prapitāpahaḥ ..
ata ūrdhvaṃ jñātayaśca sagotrāḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 1.10.140 ..
1.10.d:
पितामहः पितृपिता तत्पिता प्रपितापहः ॥
अत ऊर्ध्वं ज्ञातयश्च सगोत्राः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 1.10.140 ॥
1.10.m:
The pitāmaha is the father's father; his father is the prapitāmaha.
Beyond that, they are proclaimed as agnates (jñāti) belonging to the same clan (sagotra). // 140

1.10.s:
mātāmahaḥ pitā mātuḥ pramātāmaha eva ca ..
mātāmahasya janakastatpitā vṛddhapūrvakaḥ .. 141 ..
1.10.d:
मातामहः पिता मातुः प्रमातामह एव च ॥
मातामहस्य जनकस्तत्पिता वृद्धपूर्वकः ॥ 141 ॥
1.10.m:
The mātāmaha is the mother's father; the pramātāmaha indeed
is the begetter of the mātāmaha; his father is designated by 'vṛddha' prefixed. // 141

1.10.s:
pitāmahī piturmātā tacchvaśrūḥ prapitāmahī ..
tacchvaśrūśca parijñeyā sā vṛddhaprapitāmahī .. 142 ..
1.10.d:
पितामही पितुर्माता तच्छ्वश्रूः प्रपितामही ॥
तच्छ्वश्रूश्च परिज्ञेया सा वृद्धप्रपितामही ॥ 142 ॥
1.10.m:
The pitāmahī is the father's mother; her mother-in-law is the prapitāmahī;
her mother-in-law should be known as the vṛddhaprapitāmahī. // 142

1.10.s:
mātāmahī mātṛmātā mātṛtulyā ca pūjitā ..
pramātāmahīti jñeyā pramātāmahakāminī .. 143 ..
1.10.d:
मातामही मातृमाता मातृतुल्या च पूजिता ॥
प्रमातामहीति ज्ञेया प्रमातामहकामिनी ॥ 143 ॥
1.10.m:
The mātāmahī is the mother's mother, revered as equal to a mother;
the wife of the pramātāmaha should be known as pramātāmahī. // 143

1.10.s:
vṛddhamātāmahī jñeyā patpituḥ kāminī tathā ..
pitṛbhrātā pitṛ vyaśca mātṛbhrātā ca mātulaḥ .. 144 ..
1.10.d:
वृद्धमातामही ज्ञेया पत्पितुः कामिनी तथा ॥
पितृभ्राता पितृ व्यश्च मातृभ्राता च मातुलः ॥ 144 ॥
1.10.m:
The wife of that one's father should be known as the vṛddhamātāmahī;
a father's brother is a pitṛvya, and a mother's brother is a mātula. // 144

1.10.s:
pitṛṣvasā piturmātṛṣvasā mātussvasā smṛtā ..
sūnuśca tanayaḥ putro dāyādaścātmajastathā.. .. 145 ..
1.10.d:
पितृष्वसा पितुर्मातृष्वसा मातुस्स्वसा स्मृता ॥
सूनुश्च तनयः पुत्रो दायादश्चात्मजस्तथा॥ ॥ 145 ॥
1.10.m:
The father's sister is remembered as a pitṛṣvasṛ; the mother's sister as a mātṛṣvasṛ.
Sūnu, tanaya, putra, dāyāda, and ātmaja

1.10.s:
dhanabhāgvīryyajaścaiva puṃsi janye ca varttate ..
janyāyāṃ duhitā kanyā cātmajā parikīrtitā .. 146 ..
1.10.d:
धनभाग्वीर्य्यजश्चैव पुंसि जन्ये च वर्त्तते ॥
जन्यायां दुहिता कन्या चात्मजा परिकीर्तिता ॥ 146 ॥
1.10.m:
mean 'heir' and 'born of semen', applied to male offspring;
for female offspring, duhitā, kanyā, and ātmajā are proclaimed. // 146

1.10.s:
putrapatnī vadhū jñeyā jāmātā duhituḥ patiḥ ..
patiḥ priyaśca bhartā ca svāmīkānte ca vartate .. 147 ..
1.10.d:
पुत्रपत्नी वधू ज्ञेया जामाता दुहितुः पतिः ॥
पतिः प्रियश्च भर्ता च स्वामीकान्ते च वर्तते ॥ 147 ॥
1.10.m:
The son's wife is known as vadhū; the daughter's husband is the jāmātṛ.
"Husband" (patiḥ), "beloved" (priyaḥ), "supporter" (bhartā), and "master" (svāmī) are applied to a husband.

1.10.s:
devaraḥ svāmino bhrātā nanāṃdā svāminaḥ svasā ..
śvaśuraḥ svāminastātaḥ śvaśrūśca svāminaḥ prasūḥ .. 148 ..
1.10.d:
देवरः स्वामिनो भ्राता ननांदा स्वामिनः स्वसा ॥
श्वशुरः स्वामिनस्तातः श्वश्रूश्च स्वामिनः प्रसूः ॥ 148 ॥
1.10.m:
A husband's brother is a brother-in-law (devara); a husband's sister is a sister-in-law (nanāndā).
A husband's father is a father-in-law (śvaśura), and a husband's mother is a mother-in-law (śvaśrūḥ).

1.10.s:
bhāryyā jāyā priyā kāntā strī va patnī prakīrtitā ..
patnībhrātā śyālakaśca svasā patnyāśca śyālikā .. 149 ..
1.10.d:
भार्य्या जाया प्रिया कान्ता स्त्री व पत्नी प्रकीर्तिता ॥
पत्नीभ्राता श्यालकश्च स्वसा पत्न्याश्च श्यालिका ॥ 149 ॥
1.10.m:
She is proclaimed as wife (bhāryā, jāyā), beloved (priyā, kāntā), woman (strī), or spouse (patnī).
A wife's brother is a brother-in-law (śyālaka), and a wife's sister is a sister-in-law (śyālikā).

1.10.s:
patnīmātā tathā śvaśrūstatpitā śvaśuraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sagarbhaḥ sodaro bhrātā sagarbhā bhaginī smṛtā .. 1.10.150 ..
1.10.d:
पत्नीमाता तथा श्वश्रूस्तत्पिता श्वशुरः स्मृतः ॥
सगर्भः सोदरो भ्राता सगर्भा भगिनी स्मृता ॥ 1.10.150 ॥
1.10.m:
Likewise, a wife's mother is considered a mother-in-law (śvaśrūḥ), and her father a father-in-law (śvaśuraḥ).
A brother from the same womb is a full brother (sodara), and a sister from the same womb is considered a full sister (sagarbhā).

1.10.s:
bhaginījo bhāgineyo bhrātṛjo bhrātṛputrakaḥ ..
āvutto bhaginīkānto bhaginīpatireva ca .. 151 ..
1.10.d:
भगिनीजो भागिनेयो भ्रातृजो भ्रातृपुत्रकः ॥
आवुत्तो भगिनीकान्तो भगिनीपतिरेव च ॥ 151 ॥
1.10.m:
One born of a sister is a nephew (bhāgineya); one born of a brother is a nephew (bhrātṛputraka).
A sister's beloved, or a sister's husband, is called an āvutta.

1.10.s:
śyālīpatistu bhrātā ca śvaśuraikatvahetunā ..
śvaśurastu pitā jñeyo janmadātuḥ samo mune ..152..
1.10.d:
श्यालीपतिस्तु भ्राता च श्वशुरैकत्वहेतुना ॥
श्वशुरस्तु पिता ज्ञेयो जन्मदातुः समो मुने ॥152॥
1.10.m:
The husband of a wife's sister is [regarded as] a brother, because of having the same father-in-law.
A father-in-law, O sage, should be known as a father equal to the giver of birth.

1.10.s:
annadātā bhayatrātā patnītātastathaiva ca ..
vidyādātā janmadātā paṃcaite pitaro nṛṇām .. 153..
1.10.d:
अन्नदाता भयत्राता पत्नीतातस्तथैव च ॥
विद्यादाता जन्मदाता पंचैते पितरो नृणाम् ॥ 153॥
1.10.m:
The giver of food, the protector from fear, and likewise the wife's father,
the giver of knowledge, and the giver of birth—these five are fathers to men.

1.10.s:
annadātuśca yā patnī bhaginī gurukāminī
mātā ca tatsapatnī ca kanyā putrapriyā tathā ..154..
1.10.d:
अन्नदातुश्च या पत्नी भगिनी गुरुकामिनी
माता च तत्सपत्नी च कन्या पुत्रप्रिया तथा ॥154॥
1.10.m: The wife of the giver of food, a sister, the wife of one's guru, / one's mother, her co-wife, a daughter, and likewise a son's beloved [wife],

1.10.s:
māturmātā piturmātā śvaśrūpitroḥ svasā tathā..
pitṛvyastrī mātulānī mātaraśca cartudaśa..155..
1.10.d:
मातुर्माता पितुर्माता श्वश्रूपित्रोः स्वसा तथा॥
पितृव्यस्त्री मातुलानी मातरश्च चर्तुदश॥155॥
1.10.m:
a mother's mother, a father's mother, a mother-in-law, and likewise the sister of either parent,
a paternal uncle's wife, and a maternal uncle's wife—these fourteen are [reckoned as] mothers.

1.10.s:
pautrastu putraputre ca prapautrastatsute'pi ca ..
tatputrādyāśca ye vaṃśyāḥ kulajāśca prakīrtitāḥ..156..
1.10.d:
पौत्रस्तु पुत्रपुत्रे च प्रपौत्रस्तत्सुतेऽपि च ॥
तत्पुत्राद्याश्च ये वंश्याः कुलजाश्च प्रकीर्तिताः॥156॥
1.10.m:
A grandson (pautra) is applied to a son's son, and a great-grandson (prapautra) to his son.
His sons and subsequent descendants are proclaimed as members of the lineage (vaṃśyāḥ) and born of the family (kulajāḥ).

1.10.s:
kanyāputraśca dauhitrastatputrādyāśca bāṃdhavāḥ..
bhāgineyasutādyāśca puruṣā bāṃdhavāḥ smṛtāḥ..157..
1.10.d:
कन्यापुत्रश्च दौहित्रस्तत्पुत्राद्याश्च बांधवाः॥
भागिनेयसुताद्याश्च पुरुषा बांधवाः स्मृताः॥157॥
1.10.m:
A daughter's son is a grandson through a daughter (dauhitra); his sons and subsequent descendants are kinsmen (bāndhavāḥ).
The sons and subsequent descendants of a sister's son are considered male kinsmen (bāndhavāḥ).

1.10.s:
bhrātṛputrasya putrādyāste punarjñātayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
guruputrastathā bhrātā poṣyaḥ paramabāndhavaḥ..158..
1.10.d:
भ्रातृपुत्रस्य पुत्राद्यास्ते पुनर्ज्ञातयः स्मृताः ॥
गुरुपुत्रस्तथा भ्राता पोष्यः परमबान्धवः॥158॥
1.10.m:
The sons and subsequent descendants of a brother's son, on the other hand, are considered agnates (jñātayaḥ).
Likewise, a guru's son is a brother, a dependent, and an intimate kinsman.

1.10.s:
gurukanyā ca bhaginī poṣyā mātṛsamā mune..
putrasya ca gururbhrātā poṣyaḥ susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ..159..
1.10.d:
गुरुकन्या च भगिनी पोष्या मातृसमा मुने॥
पुत्रस्य च गुरुर्भ्राता पोष्यः सुस्निग्धबान्धवः ॥159॥
1.10.m:
A guru's daughter is a sister, a dependent, and equal to a mother, O sage.
A son's teacher is [regarded as] a brother, a dependent, and an affectionate kinsman.

1.10.s:
putrasya śvaśuro bhrātā bandhurvaivāhikaḥ smṛtaḥ..
kanyāyāḥ śvaśure caiva tatsambandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..1.10.160..
1.10.d:
पुत्रस्य श्वशुरो भ्राता बन्धुर्वैवाहिकः स्मृतः॥
कन्यायाः श्वशुरे चैव तत्सम्बन्धः प्रकीर्तितः॥1.10.160॥
1.10.m:
A son's father-in-law is considered a brother and an affine relation (vaivāhika).
The same relationship is proclaimed with regard to a daughter's father-in-law.

1.10.s:
guruśca kanyakāyāśca bhrātā susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ..
guruśvaśurabhrātṝṇāṃ gurutulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 161..
1.10.d:
गुरुश्च कन्यकायाश्च भ्राता सुस्निग्धबान्धवः ॥
गुरुश्वशुरभ्रातॄणां गुरुतुल्यः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 161॥
1.10.m:
The teacher of a daughter is [regarded as] a brother and an affectionate kinsman.
Among the brothers of a guru's father-in-law, he is proclaimed to be equal to a guru.

1.10.s:
bandhutā yena sārddha ca tanmitraṃ parikīrtitam ..
mitraṃ sukhapradaṃ jñeyaṃ duḥkhado ripurucyate .. 162 ..
1.10.d:
बन्धुता येन सार्द्ध च तन्मित्रं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
मित्रं सुखप्रदं ज्ञेयं दुःखदो रिपुरुच्यते ॥ 162 ॥
1.10.m:
He with whom there is kinship is proclaimed to be a friend (mitra).
A friend should be known as a bringer of happiness; a bringer of grief is called an enemy.

1.10.s:
bāndhavo duḥkhado daivānnissambandho'sukhapradaḥ ..
sambandhāstrividhāḥ puṃsāṃ viprendra jagatītale .. 163 ..
1.10.d:
बान्धवो दुःखदो दैवान्निस्सम्बन्धोऽसुखप्रदः ॥
सम्बन्धास्त्रिविधाः पुंसां विप्रेन्द्र जगतीतले ॥ 163 ॥
1.10.m:
A kinsman may bring grief by fate; one with no connection brings unhappiness.
Relationships of men on the surface of the earth are of three kinds, O best of brahmins:

1.10.s:
vidyājo yonijaścaiva prītijaśca prakīrtitaḥ ..
mitraṃ tu prītijaṃ jñeyaṃ sa sambadhaḥ sudurlabhaḥ .. 164 ..
1.10.d:
विद्याजो योनिजश्चैव प्रीतिजश्च प्रकीर्तितः ॥
मित्रं तु प्रीतिजं ज्ञेयं स सम्बधः सुदुर्लभः ॥ 164 ॥
1.10.m:
they are proclaimed as born of learning, born of the womb, and born of affection.
A friend is known as born of affection; that relationship is very hard to obtain.

1.10.s:
mitramātā mitrabhāryyā mātṛtulyā na saṃśayaḥ..
mitrabhrātā mitrapitā bhrātṛtātasamau nṛṇām ..165..
1.10.d:
मित्रमाता मित्रभार्य्या मातृतुल्या न संशयः॥
मित्रभ्राता मित्रपिता भ्रातृतातसमौ नृणाम् ॥165॥
1.10.m:
A friend's mother and a friend's wife are equal to a mother, without a doubt.
A friend's brother and a friend's father are equal to a brother and a father to men.

1.10.s:
caturthaṃ nāmasambandhamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ..
jāraścopapartirbandhurduṣṭā sambhogakarttari .. 166 ..
1.10.d:
चतुर्थं नामसम्बन्धमित्याह कमलोद्भवः॥
जारश्चोपपर्तिर्बन्धुर्दुष्टा सम्भोगकर्त्तरि ॥ 166 ॥
1.10.m:
The Lotus-Born [Brahmā] stated that nominal relationship is a fourth.
A paramour (jāra) or secondary husband (upapati) is a lover, a corrupt partner in sexual enjoyment.

1.10.s:
upapatnyāṃ navajñā ca preyasī cittahāriṇī ..
svāmitulyaśca jāraśca navajñā gṛhiṇī samā .. 167 ..
1.10.d:
उपपत्न्यां नवज्ञा च प्रेयसी चित्तहारिणी ॥
स्वामितुल्यश्च जारश्च नवज्ञा गृहिणी समा ॥ 167 ॥
1.10.m:
A secondary wife (upapatnī) is a mistress (navajñā), a beloved who captivates the heart.
A paramour is treated like a husband, and a mistress is treated like a housewife.

1.10.s:
sambandho deśabhede ca sarvadeśe vigarhitaḥ ..
avaidiko ninditastu viśvāmitreṇa nirmitaḥ .. 168 ..
1.10.d:
सम्बन्धो देशभेदे च सर्वदेशे विगर्हितः ॥
अवैदिको निन्दितस्तु विश्वामित्रेण निर्मितः ॥ 168 ॥
1.10.m:
Such a relationship is found in certain regions, but is condemned in all regions.
Non-Vedic and censured, it was established by Viśvāmitra.

1.10.s:
dustyajaśca mahadbhistu deśabhede vidhīyate ..
akīrtijanakaḥ puṃsāṃ yoṣitāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 169 ..
1.10.d:
दुस्त्यजश्च महद्भिस्तु देशभेदे विधीयते ॥
अकीर्तिजनकः पुंसां योषितां च विशेषतः ॥ 169 ॥
1.10.m:
Though hard to abandon by the great, it is practiced in certain regions.
It produces ill fame for men, and especially for women.

1.10.s: tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vidyamāne yuge yuge .. 1.10.170 ..
1.10.d: तेजीयसां न दोषाय विद्यमाने युगे युगे ॥ 1.10.170 ॥
1.10.m: Yet for the exceedingly powerful it brings no fault, existing age after age.

1.11.s:
śaunaka uvāca..
dvijaḥ sa bhāryyāṃ saṃtyajya kiñcakāra viśeṣataḥ..
aśvinorvā mahābhāga kiṃ nāma kasya vaṃśajau..1..
1.11.d:
शौनक उवाच॥
द्विजः स भार्य्यां संत्यज्य किञ्चकार विशेषतः॥
अश्विनोर्वा महाभाग किं नाम कस्य वंशजौ॥1॥

1.11.s:
sotiruvāca..
dvijaśca sutapā nāma bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ..
tapaścakāra kṛṣṇasya lakṣavarṣaṃ himāliye..2..
1.11.d:
सोतिरुवाच॥
द्विजश्च सुतपा नाम भारद्वाजो महामुनिः॥
तपश्चकार कृष्णस्य लक्षवर्षं हिमालिये॥2॥

1.11.s:
mahātapasvī tejasvī prajvalanbrahmatejasā..
jyotirdadarśa kṛṣṇasya gagane sahasā kṣaṇam..3..
1.11.d:
महातपस्वी तेजस्वी प्रज्वलन्ब्रह्मतेजसा॥
ज्योतिर्ददर्श कृष्णस्य गगने सहसा क्षणम्॥3॥

1.11.s:
varaṃ sa vavre nirliptamātmānaṃ prakṛteḥ param..
na ca mokṣaṃ yayāce taṃ dāsyaṃ bhaktiṃ ca niścalām ..4..
1.11.d:
वरं स वव्रे निर्लिप्तमात्मानं प्रकृतेः परम्॥
न च मोक्षं ययाचे तं दास्यं भक्तिं च निश्चलाम् ॥4॥

1.11.s:
babhūvākāśavāṇīti kuru dāraparigraham..
paścāddāsyaṃ pradāsyāmi bhaktiṃ bhogakṣaye dvija..5..
1.11.d:
बभूवाकाशवाणीति कुरु दारपरिग्रहम्॥
पश्चाद्दास्यं प्रदास्यामि भक्तिं भोगक्षये द्विज॥5॥

1.11.s:
pitṝṇāṃ mānasīṃ kanyāṃ dadau tasmai vidhiḥ svayam..
tasyāṃ kalyāṇamitraśca babhūva munipuṅgava..6..
1.11.d:
पितॄणां मानसीं कन्यां ददौ तस्मै विधिः स्वयम्॥
तस्यां कल्याणमित्रश्च बभूव मुनिपुङ्गव॥6॥

1.11.s:
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa na bhavetkuliśādbhayam..
na draṣṭavyaṃ bandhumātraṃ nūnaṃ tatsmaraṇāllabhet..7..
1.11.d:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण न भवेत्कुलिशाद्भयम्॥
न द्रष्टव्यं बन्धुमात्रं नूनं तत्स्मरणाल्लभेत्॥7॥

1.11.s:
kalyāṇamitrajananīṃ parityajya mahāmuniḥ..
śaśāpa sūryyaputraṃ ca yajñabhāgvarjjito bhava..8..
1.11.d:
कल्याणमित्रजननीं परित्यज्य महामुनिः॥
शशाप सूर्य्यपुत्रं च यज्ञभाग्वर्ज्जितो भव॥8॥

1.11.s:
sa sodaraśca vā pūjyo bhaveti ca surādhama..
vyādhigrasto jaḍāṅgaśca bhūyātte'kīrtimāniti..9..
1.11.d:
स सोदरश्च वा पूज्यो भवेति च सुराधम॥
व्याधिग्रस्तो जडाङ्गश्च भूयात्तेऽकीर्तिमानिति॥9॥

1.11.s:
ityuktvā sutapā gehaṃ pratasthe sūnunā saha..
aśvibhyāṃ sahitaḥ sūryyaḥ prayayau ca tadantikam.. 1.11.10..
1.11.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सुतपा गेहं प्रतस्थे सूनुना सह॥
अश्विभ्यां सहितः सूर्य्यः प्रययौ च तदन्तिकम्॥ 1.11.10॥

1.11.s:
putrābhyāṃ vyādhiyuktābhyāṃ sūryyastrijagatāṃ patiḥ..
munīndraṃ vai sutapasaṃ sa tuṣṭāva ca śaunaka..11..
1.11.d:
पुत्राभ्यां व्याधियुक्ताभ्यां सूर्य्यस्त्रिजगतां पतिः॥
मुनीन्द्रं वै सुतपसं स तुष्टाव च शौनक॥11॥

1.11.s:
sūryya uvāca..
kṣamasva bhagavanvipra viṣṇurūpa yuge yuge ..
mama putrāparādhaṃ ca bhāradvāja munīśvara ..12..
1.11.d:
सूर्य्य उवाच॥
क्षमस्व भगवन्विप्र विष्णुरूप युगे युगे ॥
मम पुत्रापराधं च भारद्वाज मुनीश्वर ॥12॥

1.11.s:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ surāḥ sarve ca santatam..
bhuñjate vipradattaṃ tu phalapuṣpajalādikam..13..
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाद्याः सुराः सर्वे च सन्ततम्॥
भुञ्जते विप्रदत्तं तु फलपुष्पजलादिकम्॥13॥

1.11.s:
brāhmaṇāvāhitā devāḥ śaśvadviśveṣu pūjitāḥ..
na ca viprātparo devo viprarūpī svayaṃ hariḥ..14..
1.11.d:
ब्राह्मणावाहिता देवाः शश्वद्विश्वेषु पूजिताः॥
न च विप्रात्परो देवो विप्ररूपी स्वयं हरिः॥14॥

1.11.s:
brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam..
nārāyaṇe ca santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ..15..
1.11.d:
ब्राह्मणे परितुष्टे च तुष्टो नारायणः स्वयम्॥
नारायणे च सन्तुष्टे सन्तुष्टाः सर्वदेवताः॥15॥

1.11.s:
nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na ca kṛṣṇātparaḥ suraḥ..
na śaṅkarādvaiṣṇavaśca na sahiṣṇurdharā parā..16..
1.11.d:
नास्ति गङ्गासमं तीर्थं न च कृष्णात्परः सुरः॥
न शङ्कराद्वैष्णवश्च न सहिष्णुर्धरा परा॥16॥

1.11.s:
na ca satyātparo dharmo na sādhvī pārvatīparā..
na daivādbalavānkaścinna ca putrātparaḥ priyaḥ ..17..
1.11.d:
न च सत्यात्परो धर्मो न साध्वी पार्वतीपरा॥
न दैवाद्बलवान्कश्चिन्न च पुत्रात्परः प्रियः ॥17॥

1.11.s:
na ca vyādhisamaḥ śatrurna ca pūjyo guroḥ paraḥ..
nāsti mātṛsamo bandhurna ca mitraṃ pituḥ param.. 18..
1.11.d:
न च व्याधिसमः शत्रुर्न च पूज्यो गुरोः परः॥
नास्ति मातृसमो बन्धुर्न च मित्रं पितुः परम्॥ 18॥

1.11.s:
ekādaśīvratānnānyattapo nānaśanātparam ..
paraṃ sarvadhanaṃ ratnaṃ vidyā ratnaṃ paraṃ tataḥ ..19..
1.11.d:
एकादशीव्रतान्नान्यत्तपो नानशनात्परम् ॥
परं सर्वधनं रत्नं विद्या रत्नं परं ततः ॥19॥

1.11.s:
sarvāśramaiḥ paro vipro nāsti viprasamo guruḥ..
vedavedāṅgatattvajña ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ.. 1.11.20..
1.11.d:
सर्वाश्रमैः परो विप्रो नास्ति विप्रसमो गुरुः॥
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञ इत्याह कमलोद्भवः॥ 1.11.20॥

1.11.s:
sūryyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo nanāma tam..
nīrujau cāpi tatputrau cakāra tapasaḥ phalāt.. 21..
1.11.d:
सूर्य्यस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भारद्वाजो ननाम तम्॥
नीरुजौ चापि तत्पुत्रौ चकार तपसः फलात्॥ 21॥

1.11.s:
paścācca tava putrau ca yajñabhājau bhaviṣyataḥ..
ityuktvā taṃ ca sutapāḥ praṇamyāhaskaraṃ muniḥ.. 22..
1.11.d:
पश्चाच्च तव पुत्रौ च यज्ञभाजौ भविष्यतः॥
इत्युक्त्वा तं च सुतपाः प्रणम्याहस्करं मुनिः॥ 22॥
1.11.m:
“And later your two sons shall partake of shares in sacrifices.”
Having spoken thus and bowed to the maker of day, the sage Sutapas

1.11.s:
jagāma gaṅgāṃ saṃtrasto harisevanatatparaḥ..
putrābhyāṃ sahitaḥ sūryyo jagāma nija mandiram.. 23..
1.11.d:
जगाम गङ्गां संत्रस्तो हरिसेवनतत्परः॥
पुत्राभ्यां सहितः सूर्य्यो जगाम निज मन्दिरम्॥ 23॥
1.11.m:
went in agitation to the Gaṅgā, devoted to the service of Hari.
Together with his two sons, the Sun went to his own abode.

1.11.s:
babhūvatustau pūjyau ca yajñabhājau dvijāśiṣā..
etatsūryakṛtaṃ viprastotraṃ yo mānavaḥ paṭhet..
viprapādaprasādena sarvatra vijayī bhavet ..24..
1.11.d:
बभूवतुस्तौ पूज्यौ च यज्ञभाजौ द्विजाशिषा॥
एतत्सूर्यकृतं विप्रस्तोत्रं यो मानवः पठेत्॥
विप्रपादप्रसादेन सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् ॥24॥
1.11.m:
By the blessing of the twice-born, the two became worthy of worship and partakers of sacrifice.
Whatever man recites this hymn of praise to brahmins composed by the Sun,
shall be victorious everywhere through the grace of the brahmins' feet.

1.11.s:
brāhmaṇebhyo nama iti prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet..
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ..25..
1.11.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नम इति प्रातरुत्थाय यः पठेत्॥
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षितः॥25॥
1.11.m: He who rises at dawn and recites, “Salutation to the brahmins,”

1.11.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare ..
sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca..26..
1.11.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि तानि तीर्थानि सागरे ॥
सागरे यानि तीर्थानि विप्रपादेषु तानि च॥26॥

1.11.s:
viprapādodakaṃ pītvā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ..
tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pibaṃti pitaro jalam ..27..
1.11.d:
विप्रपादोदकं पीत्वा यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी ॥
तावत्पुष्करपात्रेषु पिबंति पितरो जलम् ॥27॥
1.11.m:
Having drunk the water from the feet of a brahmin, as long as the earth stands,
so long the ancestors drink water from lotus-leaf vessels.

1.11.s:
viprapādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ pibet ..
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ..28..
1.11.d:
विप्रपादोदकं पुण्यं भक्तियुक्तश्च यः पिबेत् ॥
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षितः॥28॥
1.11.m: He who, endowed with devotion, drinks the sacred water of a brahmin's feet,

1.11.s:
mahārogī yadi pibedviprapādodakaṃ dvija..
mucyate sarvarogācca māsamekaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ..29..
1.11.d:
महारोगी यदि पिबेद्विप्रपादोदकं द्विज॥
मुच्यते सर्वरोगाच्च मासमेकं तु भक्तितः॥29॥
1.11.m:
If a person with a severe disease should drink the water from a brahmin's feet, O twice-born,
with devotion for one month, he is released from all disease.

1.11.s:
avidyo vā savidyo vā saṃdhyāpūto hi yo dvijaḥ..
sa eva viṣṇusadṛśo na harau vimukho yadi .. 1.11.30..
1.11.d:
अविद्यो वा सविद्यो वा संध्यापूतो हि यो द्विजः॥
स एव विष्णुसदृशो न हरौ विमुखो यदि ॥ 1.11.30॥
1.11.m:
Whether without learning or with learning, the twice-born who is purified by twilight prayers
is indeed like Viṣṇu, if he is not averse to Hari.

1.11.s:
ghnantaṃ vipraṃ śapantaṃ vā na hanyānna ca taṃ śapet.
gobhyaḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyo haribhaktaśca sa smṛtaḥ..31..
1.11.d:
घ्नन्तं विप्रं शपन्तं वा न हन्यान्न च तं शपेत्।
गोभ्यः शतगुणं पूज्यो हरिभक्तश्च स स्मृतः॥31॥
1.11.m: One should not strike a brahmin who strikes, nor curse one who curses; / he is held to be a devotee of Hari, a hundred times more worthy of worship than cows.

1.11.s:
pādodakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhuṅkte viprasya yo dvija..
nityaṃ naivedyabhojī yo rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet..32..
1.11.d:
पादोदकं च नैवेद्यं भुङ्क्ते विप्रस्य यो द्विज॥
नित्यं नैवेद्यभोजी यो राजसूयफलं लभेत्॥32॥
1.11.m:
The twice-born who partakes of the foot-water and food offering of a brahmin,
who constantly eats food offerings, obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

1.11.s:
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṅkte yo nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayet..
tasya pādodakaṃ prāpya sthalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhaved dhruvam.. 33..
1.11.d:
एकादश्यां न भुङ्क्ते यो नित्यं कृष्णं समर्चयेत्॥
तस्य पादोदकं प्राप्य स्थलं तीर्थं भवेद् ध्रुवम्॥ 33॥
1.11.m:
One who does not eat on Ekādaśī and constantly worships Kṛṣṇa—
by obtaining the water from his feet, any place surely becomes a sacred ford.

1.11.s:
yo bhuṅkte bhojanocchiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ naivedyabhojanam..
kṛṣṇadevasya pūto'sau jīvanmukto mahītale..34..
1.11.d:
यो भुङ्क्ते भोजनोच्छिष्टं नित्यं नैवेद्यभोजनम्॥
कृष्णदेवस्य पूतोऽसौ जीवन्मुक्तो महीतले॥34॥
1.11.m:
He who eats the food remnants, constantly eating the food offerings
of Lord Kṛṣṇa, is purified and liberated while living on the surface of the earth.

1.11.s:
annaṃ viṣṭhā payo mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam..
dvijānāṃ kulajātānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ..35..
1.11.d:
अन्नं विष्ठा पयो मूत्रं यद्विष्णोरनिवेदितम्॥
द्विजानां कुलजातानामित्याह कमलोद्भवः॥35॥
1.11.m:
Food, if not offered to Viṣṇu, is feces, and milk is urine,
for the high-born twice-born—so said the lotus-born [Brahmā].

1.11.s:
brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca sarve viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ..
brāhmaṇastatkule jāto vimukhaśca harau katham..36..
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मा च ब्रह्मपुत्राश्च सर्वे विष्णुपरायणाः॥
ब्राह्मणस्तत्कुले जातो विमुखश्च हरौ कथम्॥36॥
1.11.m:
Brahmā and the sons of Brahmā are all devoted to Viṣṇu.
how then is a brāhmaṇa born in their family averse to Hari?

1.11.s:
pitrormātāmahādīnāṃ saṃsargasya gurośca vā..
doṣeṇa vimukhāḥ kṛṣṇe viprā jīvanmṛtāśca te.. 37..
1.11.d:
पित्रोर्मातामहादीनां संसर्गस्य गुरोश्च वा॥
दोषेण विमुखाः कृष्णे विप्रा जीवन्मृताश्च ते॥ 37॥
1.11.m:
By the fault of parents, maternal grandfathers, and others, / or of association with a guru,
vipras become averse to Kṛṣṇa, and they are living dead.

1.11.s:
sa kiṃguruḥ sa kiṃtātaḥ sa kiṃputraḥ sa kiṃsakhā..
sa kiṃrājā sa kiṃbandhurna dadyādyo harau matim ..38..
1.11.d:
स किंगुरुः स किंतातः स किंपुत्रः स किंसखा॥
स किंराजा स किंबन्धुर्न दद्याद्यो हरौ मतिम् ॥38॥
1.11.m:
Is he a guru? Is he a father? Is he a son? Is he a friend?
Is he a king? Is he a kinsman, who would not direct one's mind to Hari?

1.11.s:
avaiṣṇavāddvijādvipra caṇḍālo vaiṣṇavo varaḥ..
sagaṇaḥ śvapaco mukto brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet..39..
1.11.d:
अवैष्णवाद्द्विजाद्विप्र चण्डालो वैष्णवो वरः॥
सगणः श्वपचो मुक्तो ब्राह्मणो नरकं व्रजेत्॥39॥
1.11.m:
Better than a non-Vaiṣṇava dvija, O vipra, is a Vaiṣṇava caṇḍāla:
the dog-eater is liberated along with his kin; the brāhmaṇa goes to hell.

1.11.s:
sandhyāhīno'śucirnityaṃ kṛṣṇe vā vimukho dvijaḥ..
sa eva brāhmaṇābhāso viṣahīno yathoragaḥ.. 1.11.40..
1.11.d:
सन्ध्याहीनोऽशुचिर्नित्यं कृष्णे वा विमुखो द्विजः॥
स एव ब्राह्मणाभासो विषहीनो यथोरगः॥ 1.11.40॥
1.11.m:
A dvija lacking the twilight prayers, constantly impure, or averse to Kṛṣṇa—
he is merely a semblance of a brāhmaṇa, like a serpent without venom.

1.11.s:
guruvaktrādviṣṇumaṃtro yasya karṇe praviśyati..
taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ jīvanmuktaṃ vadedvidhiḥ..41..
1.11.d:
गुरुवक्त्राद्विष्णुमंत्रो यस्य कर्णे प्रविश्यति॥
तं वैष्णवं महापूतं जीवन्मुक्तं वदेद्विधिः॥41॥
1.11.m:
Into whose ear enters the Viṣṇu mantra from the mouth of a guru,
him Brahmā declares to be a Vaiṣṇava, exceedingly pure, liberated while living.

1.11.s:
puṃsāṃ mātāmahādīnāṃ śataiḥ sārddhaṃ hareḥ padam..
prayāti vaiṣṇavaḥ puṃsāmātmanaḥ kulakoṭibhiḥ..42..
1.11.d:
पुंसां मातामहादीनां शतैः सार्द्धं हरेः पदम्॥
प्रयाति वैष्णवः पुंसामात्मनः कुलकोटिभिः॥42॥
1.11.m:
Along with hundreds of ancestors, maternal grandfathers, and others,
a Vaiṣṇava goes to the abode of Hari along with ten million lineages of his own men.

1.11.s:
brahmakṣattriyaviṭśūdrāścatasro jātayo yathā ..
svatantrā jātirekā ca viśvasminvaiṣṇavābhidhā .. 43..
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रियविट्शूद्राश्चतस्रो जातयो यथा ॥
स्वतन्त्रा जातिरेका च विश्वस्मिन्वैष्णवाभिधा ॥ 43॥
1.11.m:
Just as there are four castes—brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra—
there is also one independent caste in the universe named Vaiṣṇava.

1.11.s:
dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvadgovindapadapaṅkajam..
dhyāyate tāṃśca govindaḥ śaśvatteṣāṃ ca sannidhau..44..
1.11.d:
ध्यायन्ति वैष्णवाः शश्वद्गोविन्दपदपङ्कजम्॥
ध्यायते तांश्च गोविन्दः शश्वत्तेषां च सन्निधौ॥44॥
1.11.m:
Vaiṣṇavas constantly meditate upon Govinda's lotus feet,
and Govinda constantly meditates on them and stays in their presence.

1.11.s:
sudarśanaṃ saṃniyojya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca..
tathāpi na hi niścinto'vatiṣṭhedbhaktasannidhau..45..
1.11.d:
सुदर्शनं संनियोज्य भक्तानां रक्षणाय च॥
तथापि न हि निश्चिन्तोऽवतिष्ठेद्भक्तसन्निधौ॥45॥
1.11.m:
Having assigned Sudarśana to protect his devotees,
still he is not free from concern, and remains near the devotee.
